title: 河口鹽水入侵控制
summary: 用鹽質量分層動力與排水限制評估河口阻鹽策略。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Evaluate estuary salt control with mass balance, stratification and drainage constraints. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。假設淡水流100增加10%至110m³/s，鹹流仍10m³/s且35kg/m³，混合濃度由3.1818降至350/120=2.9167kg/m³，下降8.333%；不直接表示鹽楔縮短同樣比例。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³. Increasing freshwater10% from100to110m³/s while saline input remains10m³/s at35kg/m³ lowers mixed concentration3.1818to2.9167kg/m³, a8.333% reduction, without an equivalent salt-wedge length change. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Hydrology, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「完全混合與鹽收支」與「斷面鹽通量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Complete mixing and salt balance" and "Section salt transport": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 完全混合與鹽收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and salt balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「完全混合與鹽收支」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete mixing and salt balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。穩態完全混合模型以入流鹽質量守恆求出口濃度，但真實河口常有底層鹽楔及潮汐逆流；平均濃度不能描述取水口所在深度的短時暴露。 假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「完全混合與鹽收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers. A steady completely mixed balance equates incoming and outgoing salt mass, whereas real estuaries may contain a bottom wedge and reversing tides. Mean concentration therefore cannot describe short-term exposure at a particular intake depth or establish a spatial intrusion boundary by itself. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Complete mixing and salt balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「完全混合與鹽收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Complete mixing and salt balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完全混合與鹽收支
knowledge.text: 淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。穩態完全混合模型以入流鹽質量守恆求出口濃度，但真實河口常有底層鹽楔及潮汐逆流；平均濃度不能描述取水口所在深度的短時暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers. A steady completely mixed balance equates incoming and outgoing salt mass, whereas real estuaries may contain a bottom wedge and reversing tides.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完全混合與鹽收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Complete mixing and salt balance" is correct?
options: 河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。
淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。
一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。
optionsEn: Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake.
Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers.
Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport.
quiz.explanation: 淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 完全混合與鹽收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and salt balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「完全混合與鹽收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Complete mixing and salt balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「完全混合與鹽收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Complete mixing and salt balance", which statement holds?
options: 一個容積除流量的時間後所有原有鹽水都必定完全排出。
體積理查森數大於某個固定數字就證明整個河口完全沒有紊流。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: After one volume-divided-by-flow interval, every original parcel of saltwater has certainly left.
A bulk Richardson number above one fixed value proves that the entire estuary is turbulence-free.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 完全混合與鹽收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and salt balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「完全混合與鹽收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Complete mixing and salt balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。
knowledge.textEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。
knowledge.textEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「完全混合與鹽收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Complete mixing and salt balance"?
options: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排口鹽濃度提高就能證明整個河口工程在所有功能上都更好。
optionsEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function.
quiz.explanation: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 完全混合與鹽收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and salt balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「完全混合與鹽收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Complete mixing and salt balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。即使整體平均降低，局部取水點仍可能遇到短暫高濃度水團。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. Even a falling system mean can coexist with a brief high-concentration water mass reaching a particular intake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。即使整體平均降低，局部取水點仍可能遇到短暫高濃度水團。
knowledge.textEn: Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. Even a falling system mean can coexist with a brief high-concentration water mass reaching a particular intake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「完全混合與鹽收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Complete mixing and salt balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。
一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions.
Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport.

steps.title: 斷面鹽通量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section salt transport” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鹽通量是流速與濃度在斷面的共同積分，漲退潮方向和分層會讓兩者呈現相關性。平均濃度乘淨流量只適用均勻或明定近似，零淨水量也可能有非零淨鹽輸送；因此要同時觀測水流與鹽分，不能只靠一支鹽度儀解讀入侵。 假設截面均勻且向陸流量20m³/s、鹽質量濃度15kg/m³，向陸鹽通量QC=300kg/s；實際分層需積分uC。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斷面鹽通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Salt flux integrates velocity times concentration across a section. Tidal direction and stratification correlate these variables, so mean concentration times net discharge is valid only under a stated approximation. Zero net water exchange can still produce net salt transport. Simultaneous flow and concentration observations are therefore essential; one salinity sensor cannot independently reveal the full direction or magnitude of intrusion. Assume uniform landward flow20m³/s and salt concentration15kg/m³. Landward flux QC=300kg/s; stratified flow requires section integration of uC. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section salt transport” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「斷面鹽通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 斷面鹽通量：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設截面均勻且向陸流量20m³/s、鹽質量濃度15kg/m³，向陸鹽通量QC=300kg/s；實際分層需積分uC。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform landward flow20m³/s and salt concentration15kg/m³. Landward flux QC=300kg/s; stratified flow requires section integration of uC. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 斷面鹽通量：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷面鹽通量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section salt transport” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。比較平均乘積與乘積平均的差異，標示未量區和外推方式，不以淨流量代替雙向交換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure velocity and concentration by section cell with direction and tidal phase, integrating before cycle averaging. Compare product-of-means with mean-product results, documenting unmeasured areas and extrapolation instead of replacing two-way exchange by net water flow alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。比較平均乘積與乘積平均的差異，標示未量區和外推方式，不以淨流量代替雙向交換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure velocity and concentration by section cell with direction and tidal phase, integrating before cycle averaging. Compare product-of-means with mean-product results, documenting unmeasured areas and extrapolation instead of replacing two-way exchange by net water flow alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：底層入侵與表層出流可在水量上相抵，若只看淨流量會誤以為沒有鹽輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bottom inflow and surface outflow can cancel volumetrically, making net-discharge records falsely suggest no salt input. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Salt storage and change rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 控制體內鹽庫存等於體積乘平均質量濃度，但當濃度和水量都變動時需完整微分。固定容積完全混合箱可由入出鹽通量算瞬時濃度變率，之後出口濃度也跟著變化；不能把初始變率長時間線性外推，或將觀測殘差全部歸為感測錯誤。 假設固定V=1000000m³、箱內C=2kg/m³，入出流各100m³/s、入流C=5，庫存2000000kg，瞬時dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s)。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鹽庫存與變化率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Salt storage is volume times mean mass concentration, requiring a full derivative if both change. A constant-volume mixed box converts net salt flux into an instantaneous concentration rate, but outlet concentration then evolves with the box. knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：初始濃度變化率可以無限制線性外推而不需更新出口鹽濃度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The initial concentration-change rate can be extrapolated indefinitely without updating outlet concentration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鹽庫存與變化率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Salt storage and change rate" is correct?
options: 控制體內鹽庫存等於體積乘平均質量濃度，但當濃度和水量都變動時需完整微分。
初始濃度變化率可以無限制線性外推而不需更新出口鹽濃度。
一個容積除流量的時間後所有原有鹽水都必定完全排出。
optionsEn: Salt storage is volume times mean mass concentration, requiring a full derivative if both change.
The initial concentration-change rate can be extrapolated indefinitely without updating outlet concentration.
After one volume-divided-by-flow interval, every original parcel of saltwater has certainly left.
quiz.explanation: 控制體內鹽庫存等於體積乘平均質量濃度，但當濃度和水量都變動時需完整微分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Salt storage is volume times mean mass concentration, requiring a full derivative if both change. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鹽庫存與變化率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Salt storage and change rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鹽庫存與變化率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Salt storage and change rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固定V=1000000m³、箱內C=2kg/m³，入出流各100m³/s、入流C=5，庫存2000000kg，瞬時dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s)。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed volume1000000m³,box concentration2kg/m³,equal flows100m³/s and input5kg/m³. Storage=2000000kg; instantaneous dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將容積變化與鹽濃度變化分開核對，確認進出流是否真的平衡，按每個時間步更新出口濃度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check volume and concentration changes separately and verify equal inflow-outflow before updating outlet concentration at every timestep.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鹽庫存與變化率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Salt storage and change rate", which statement holds?
options: 體積理查森數大於某個固定數字就證明整個河口完全沒有紊流。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
排口鹽濃度提高就能證明整個河口工程在所有功能上都更好。
optionsEn: A bulk Richardson number above one fixed value proves that the entire estuary is turbulence-free.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 鹽庫存與變化率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Salt storage and change rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鹽庫存與變化率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Salt storage and change rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將容積變化與鹽濃度變化分開核對，確認進出流是否真的平衡，按每個時間步更新出口濃度。以獨立剖面估庫存，保存未閉合收支並調查漏掉的側支流、底層或地下水交換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check volume and concentration changes separately and verify equal inflow-outflow before updating outlet concentration at every timestep. Estimate storage independently from profiles, retaining residuals while investigating missing tributaries, lower-layer exchange or groundwater rather than forcing numerical closure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將容積變化與鹽濃度變化分開核對，確認進出流是否真的平衡，按每個時間步更新出口濃度。以獨立剖面估庫存，保存未閉合收支並調查漏掉的側支流、底層或地下水交換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check volume and concentration changes separately and verify equal inflow-outflow before updating outlet concentration at every timestep. Estimate storage independently from profiles, retaining residuals while investigating missing tributaries, lower-layer exchange or groundwater rather than forcing numerical closure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略水位變化會把稀釋誤認為鹽移除，固定使用初始出口濃度又累積不守恆誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring changing volume confuses dilution with salt removal, while retaining initial outlet concentration accumulates nonconservative error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鹽庫存與變化率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Salt storage and change rate"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
多支感測器讀值相同就能排除共同校正偏差和轉換錯誤。
將容積變化與鹽濃度變化分開核對，確認進出流是否真的平衡，按每個時間步更新出口濃度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Agreement among sensors rules out any shared calibration bias or conversion error.
Check volume and concentration changes separately and verify equal inflow-outflow before updating outlet concentration at every timestep.

quiz.explanationEn: Check volume and concentration changes separately and verify equal inflow-outflow before updating outlet concentration at every timestep. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鹽庫存與變化率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Salt storage and change rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鹽庫存與變化率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Salt storage and change rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略水位變化會把稀釋誤認為鹽移除，固定使用初始出口濃度又累積不守恆誤差。未量到底層高鹽庫存時，即使表層感測穩定也不能宣告整體庫存不變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring changing volume confuses dilution with salt removal, while retaining initial outlet concentration accumulates nonconservative error. An unseen saline lower-layer reservoir can change even when surface sensors appear stable, invalidating a whole-estuary storage conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設固定V=1000000m³、箱內C=2kg/m³，入出流各100m³/s、入流C=5，庫存2000000kg，瞬時dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s)。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Storage=2000000kg; instantaneous dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s).
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「初始濃度變化率可以無限制線性外推而不需更新出口鹽濃度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The initial concentration-change rate can be extrapolated indefinitely without updating outlet concentration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略水位變化會把稀釋誤認為鹽移除，固定使用初始出口濃度又累積不守恆誤差。未量到底層高鹽庫存時，即使表層感測穩定也不能宣告整體庫存不變。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring changing volume confuses dilution with salt removal, while retaining initial outlet concentration accumulates nonconservative error. An unseen saline lower-layer reservoir can change even when surface sensors appear stable, invalidating a whole-estuary storage conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鹽庫存與變化率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Salt storage and change rate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略水位變化會把稀釋誤認為鹽移除，固定使用初始出口濃度又累積不守恆誤差。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
After one volume-divided-by-flow interval, every original parcel of saltwater has certainly left.

quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring changing volume confuses dilution with salt removal, while retaining initial outlet concentration accumulates nonconservative error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 理想沖淡時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ideal flushing time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理想沖淡時間」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ideal flushing time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沖淡速度取決於有效混合容積和交換路徑，完全混合箱會呈指數下降而不是每段時間去除固定鹽量。實際河口有死水區、再入侵和潮汐交換，單一停留尺度不能代表所有水團年齡；計算結果應是比較假設的基準，不是實際供水恢復時間保證。 假設完全混合固定V=1000000m³、淡水Q=100m³/s、無再入鹽，C由5降1kg/m³，t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想沖淡時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flushing depends on effective mixing volume and exchange pathways. A completely mixed box declines exponentially rather than losing a fixed salt mass each interval. Dead zones, renewed intrusion and tidal exchange create multiple residence times in an estuary, so one scale does not describe every parcel age. The calculation compares assumptions rather than guaranteeing when an actual water supply will recover. Assume a fixed mixed box1000000m³,fresh inflow100m³/s and no renewed salt input. Falling5to1kg/m³ takes t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal flushing time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個容積除流量的時間後所有原有鹽水都必定完全排出。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After one volume-divided-by-flow interval, every original parcel of saltwater has certainly left." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理想沖淡時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ideal flushing time", which statement holds?

阻鹽工程只影響鹽分而絕不可能改變排水能力和上游水位。

optionsEn: Every cubic metre entering on flood tide is a cubic metre of new freshwater supplied.
A salt-control structure affects salinity only and can never alter drainage capacity or upstream levels.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.title: 理想沖淡時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ideal flushing time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理想沖淡時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ideal flushing time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用時間序列檢查對數濃度是否近似線性，辨識淡水入口、出口與滯留區，核對有無潮汐再入。比較不同深度下降速率並報告模型殘差，不能用單點達標時間推定全部水體完成置換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether log concentration is approximately linear through time, locating inlet, outlet and stagnant zones and testing tidal re-entry. Compare decline at different depths and report residuals instead of using one sensor's threshold time to declare complete replacement of the water body. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用時間序列檢查對數濃度是否近似線性，辨識淡水入口、出口與滯留區，核對有無潮汐再入。比較不同深度下降速率並報告模型殘差，不能用單點達標時間推定全部水體完成置換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check whether log concentration is approximately linear through time, locating inlet, outlet and stagnant zones and testing tidal re-entry. Compare decline at different depths and report residuals instead of using one sensor's threshold time to declare complete replacement of the water body.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：快速表面通道可能讓出口很快變淡卻留下深層鹽水，後續混合又使濃度回升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A surface shortcut can freshen the outlet quickly while leaving deep saltwater that later remixes and raises concentration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理想沖淡時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ideal flushing time"?

steps.title: 理想沖淡時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ideal flushing time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理想沖淡時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ideal flushing time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 快速表面通道可能讓出口很快變淡卻留下深層鹽水，後續混合又使濃度回升。若只用名義總容積和流量估時間，會漏掉這種短路與長尾行為。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A surface shortcut can freshen the outlet quickly while leaving deep saltwater that later remixes and raises concentration. Nominal total volume divided by flow misses this short-circuiting and long-tail behavior within the actual estuary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設完全混合固定V=1000000m³、淡水Q=100m³/s、無再入鹽，C由5降1kg/m³，t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Falling5to1kg/m³ takes t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一個容積除流量的時間後所有原有鹽水都必定完全排出。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After one volume-divided-by-flow interval, every original parcel of saltwater has certainly left." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 快速表面通道可能讓出口很快變淡卻留下深層鹽水，後續混合又使濃度回升。若只用名義總容積和流量估時間，會漏掉這種短路與長尾行為。
knowledge.textEn: A surface shortcut can freshen the outlet quickly while leaving deep saltwater that later remixes and raises concentration. Nominal total volume divided by flow misses this short-circuiting and long-tail behavior within the actual estuary.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「理想沖淡時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ideal flushing time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
快速表面通道可能讓出口很快變淡卻留下深層鹽水，後續混合又使濃度回升。
內波速度與上下鹽水淡水層厚度無關只由重力決定。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A surface shortcut can freshen the outlet quickly while leaving deep saltwater that later remixes and raises concentration.
Internal-wave speed is independent of layer depths and depends only on gravity.
quiz.explanation: 快速表面通道可能讓出口很快變淡卻留下深層鹽水，後續混合又使濃度回升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A surface shortcut can freshen the outlet quickly while leaving deep saltwater that later remixes and raises concentration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.titleEn: Construction methods and stage control
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密度差與內波速度」與「分層與剪切競爭」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Density contrast and internal waves" and "Stratification versus shear": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密度差與內波速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Density contrast and internal waves: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度差與內波速度」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Density contrast and internal waves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淡鹹水密度差使界面能支持內波，其速度遠小於自由表面重力波且受上下層厚度控制。兩層淺水、剛蓋與小振幅模型只適合辨識尺度，不含剪切、摩擦及界面厚度；將它套到完全混合河段會失去物理意義，應先用量測確認垂向分層存在。 假設Δρ=20、參考ρ=1000kg/m³，g′=0.1962m/s²；兩層厚4與6m，c=√[g′h1h2/(h1+h2)]=0.6862m/s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度差與內波速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A density contrast supports internal waves with speeds much lower than free-surface waves and dependent on both layer thicknesses. A two-layer shallow-water rigid-lid small-amplitude model identifies a scale only, excluding shear, friction and finite interface thickness. Applying it to a well-mixed reach is physically inappropriate, so observed stratification must first justify the assumed two-layer representation. Assume density contrast20kg/m³,reference1000kg/m³,g′=0.1962m/s² and layers4and6m. Rigid-lid long-wave speed c=0.6862m/s. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Density contrast and internal waves” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「內波速度與上下鹽水淡水層厚度無關只由重力決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Internal-wave speed is independent of layer depths and depends only on gravity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度差與內波速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Density contrast and internal waves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密度差與內波速度
knowledge.text: 淡鹹水密度差使界面能支持內波，其速度遠小於自由表面重力波且受上下層厚度控制。兩層淺水、剛蓋與小振幅模型只適合辨識尺度，不含剪切、摩擦及界面厚度；將它套到完全混合河段會失去物理意義，應先用量測確認垂向分層存在。
knowledge.textEn: A density contrast supports internal waves with speeds much lower than free-surface waves and dependent on both layer thicknesses. A two-layer shallow-water rigid-lid small-amplitude model identifies a scale only, excluding shear, friction and finite interface thickness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：內波速度與上下鹽水淡水層厚度無關只由重力決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Internal-wave speed is independent of layer depths and depends only on gravity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度差與內波速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Density contrast and internal waves" is correct?
options: 內波速度與上下鹽水淡水層厚度無關只由重力決定。
體積理查森數大於某個固定數字就證明整個河口完全沒有紊流。
淡鹹水密度差使界面能支持內波，其速度遠小於自由表面重力波且受上下層厚度控制。
optionsEn: Internal-wave speed is independent of layer depths and depends only on gravity.
A bulk Richardson number above one fixed value proves that the entire estuary is turbulence-free.
A density contrast supports internal waves with speeds much lower than free-surface waves and dependent on both layer thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 淡鹹水密度差使界面能支持內波，其速度遠小於自由表面重力波且受上下層厚度控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δρ=20、參考ρ=1000kg/m³，g′=0.1962m/s²；兩層厚4與6m，c=√[g′h1h2/(h1+h2)]=0.6862m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume density contrast20kg/m³,reference1000kg/m³,g′=0.1962m/s² and layers4and6m. Rigid-lid long-wave speed c=0.6862m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測溫鹽密度剖面並確認界面和層厚，明列長波與剛蓋假設，核對背景剪切流。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Density contrast and internal waves” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測溫鹽密度剖面並確認界面和層厚，明列長波與剛蓋假設，核對背景剪切流。將界面移動時序與估計速度比較，保留界面模糊或完全混合的時段，不強行維持兩層參數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure temperature-salinity density profiles to identify interface and layer depths, stating long-wave and rigid-lid assumptions and checking shear. steps.instruction: 表層鹽度低不代表底層密度差固定，風混合可使界面消失。若仍用相同內波速度預測鹽楔回應，會錯估通量調整與感測器間訊號延遲。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objective: 說明「分層與剪切競爭」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stratification versus shear” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密度分層抵抗垂向混合，速度剪切提供擾動能量，體積理查森數可整理兩者量級。它不同於局部梯度理查森數，不能直接沿用理想線性穩定門檻，真實河口還有潮汐歷史及邊界混合；比值用來比較狀態，不是無紊流或零混合證明。 假設g′=0.1962m/s²、層尺度H=2m、速度差ΔU=0.50m/s，Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696；非局部穩定門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層與剪切競爭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stratification resists vertical exchange while shear supplies disturbance energy. A bulk Richardson number organizes their scales but differs from a local gradient Richardson number, so an ideal linear-stability threshold cannot be transferred directly. Tidal history and boundary mixing also matter. The ratio compares states rather than proving that turbulence or salt mixing is absent from the river or estuary. Assume g′=0.1962m/s²,layer scale2m and velocity difference0.50m/s. Bulk Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696, not a local stability threshold. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stratification versus shear” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bulk Richardson number above one fixed value proves that the entire estuary is turbulence-free." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層與剪切競爭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stratification versus shear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 大尺度分層強仍可能在薄界面出現高剪切，採樣間距太大會把局部不穩定平均掉。將體積數值與梯度門檻比較，可能錯誤宣稱沒有混合或入侵交換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Strong bulk stratification can coexist with intense shear in a thin interface, which coarse sampling averages away. Comparing the bulk number directly with a gradient threshold can therefore falsely declare that mixing or exchange relevant to intrusion is absent. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設g′=0.1962m/s²、層尺度H=2m、速度差ΔU=0.50m/s，Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696；非局部穩定門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bulk Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696, not a local stability threshold.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「體積理查森數大於某個固定數字就證明整個河口完全沒有紊流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bulk Richardson number above one fixed value proves that the entire estuary is turbulence-free." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 大尺度分層強仍可能在薄界面出現高剪切，採樣間距太大會把局部不穩定平均掉。將體積數值與梯度門檻比較，可能錯誤宣稱沒有混合或入侵交換。
knowledge.textEn: Strong bulk stratification can coexist with intense shear in a thin interface, which coarse sampling averages away. Comparing the bulk number directly with a gradient threshold can therefore falsely declare that mixing or exchange relevant to intrusion is absent.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分層與剪切競爭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stratification versus shear" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 大尺度分層強仍可能在薄界面出現高剪切，採樣間距太大會把局部不穩定平均掉。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
一個漲潮交換進來的水量全部等於系統獲得的新淡水量。
optionsEn: Strong bulk stratification can coexist with intense shear in a thin interface, which coarse sampling averages away.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Every cubic metre entering on flood tide is a cubic metre of new freshwater supplied.
quiz.explanation: 大尺度分層強仍可能在薄界面出現高剪切，採樣間距太大會把局部不穩定平均掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strong bulk stratification can coexist with intense shear in a thin interface, which coarse sampling averages away. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.titleEn: Testing, measurement and monitoring
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潮交換與淨輸送」與「選擇性排鹽效率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tidal exchange versus net transport" and "Selective salt-export efficiency": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潮交換與淨輸送：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tidal exchange versus net transport: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潮交換與淨輸送」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal exchange versus net transport” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潮汐流量正負交替，大量水體可往返交換而淨水量很小，這與潮混合輸鹽是不同統計量。正弦半週積分提供單向交換體積，不能當淡水沖洗量或新水替換量；被送出的水可能下一潮返回，因此水團追蹤與濃度仍不可省略。 假設Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s、T=43200s，正半週交換V=QmaxT/π=6875494m³，整週淨水量0。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮交換與淨輸送」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tidal discharge alternates sign, allowing large gross exchange with small net volume. This is statistically distinct from tide-driven salt transport. Integrating one positive sinusoidal half-cycle gives one-way exchanged volume, not freshwater flushing or completely new water. Exported parcels may return on the next tide, so concentration and parcel tracking remain necessary for interpreting the effective exchange of salt. Assume Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s with T=43200s. Positive half-cycle volume QmaxT/π=6875494m³; full-cycle net volume is0. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal exchange versus net transport” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個漲潮交換進來的水量全部等於系統獲得的新淡水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every cubic metre entering on flood tide is a cubic metre of new freshwater supplied." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潮交換與淨輸送」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tidal exchange versus net transport”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潮交換與淨輸送
knowledge.text: 潮汐流量正負交替，大量水體可往返交換而淨水量很小，這與潮混合輸鹽是不同統計量。正弦半週積分提供單向交換體積，不能當淡水沖洗量或新水替換量；被送出的水可能下一潮返回，因此水團追蹤與濃度仍不可省略。
knowledge.textEn: Tidal discharge alternates sign, allowing large gross exchange with small net volume. This is statistically distinct from tide-driven salt transport.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一個漲潮交換進來的水量全部等於系統獲得的新淡水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every cubic metre entering on flood tide is a cubic metre of new freshwater supplied. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潮交換與淨輸送」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tidal exchange versus net transport" is correct?
options: 一個漲潮交換進來的水量全部等於系統獲得的新淡水量。
潮汐流量正負交替，大量水體可往返交換而淨水量很小，這與潮混合輸鹽是不同統計量。
排口鹽濃度提高就能證明整個河口工程在所有功能上都更好。
optionsEn: Every cubic metre entering on flood tide is a cubic metre of new freshwater supplied.
Tidal discharge alternates sign, allowing large gross exchange with small net volume.
Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function.
quiz.explanation: 潮汐流量正負交替，大量水體可往返交換而淨水量很小，這與潮混合輸鹽是不同統計量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tidal discharge alternates sign, allowing large gross exchange with small net volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潮交換與淨輸送：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tidal exchange versus net transport: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「潮交換與淨輸送」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tidal exchange versus net transport” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s、T=43200s，正半週交換V=QmaxT/π=6875494m³，整週淨水量0。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s with T=43200s. Positive half-cycle volume QmaxT/π=6875494m³; full-cycle net volume is0. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s、T=43200s，正半週交換V=QmaxT/π=6875494m³，整週淨水量0。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s with T=43200s. Positive half-cycle volume QmaxT/π=6875494m³; full-cycle net volume is0.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潮交換與淨輸送」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tidal exchange versus net transport", which statement holds?
options: 多支感測器讀值相同就能排除共同校正偏差和轉換錯誤。
一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Agreement among sensors rules out any shared calibration bias or conversion error.
Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潮交換與淨輸送：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tidal exchange versus net transport: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「潮交換與淨輸送」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tidal exchange versus net transport” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。用水團或示蹤證據估返回比例，區分總交換與有效更新，不把大量往返流誤解為同量淡水供應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints. Estimate return fraction from parcel or tracer evidence, distinguishing gross exchange from renewal rather than interpreting large oscillatory flow as an equal freshwater supply. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。用水團或示蹤證據估返回比例，區分總交換與有效更新，不把大量往返流誤解為同量淡水供應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints. Estimate return fraction from parcel or tracer evidence, distinguishing gross exchange from renewal rather than interpreting large oscillatory flow as an equal freshwater supply.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只取半潮資料會把單向交換誤當淨流入，端點相位偏差也可製造假淨量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using only half a tide mistakes one-way exchange for net inflow, and endpoint phase error creates a false residual. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。用水團或示蹤證據估返回比例，區分總交換與有效更新，不把大量往返流誤解為同量淡水供應。
knowledge.textEn: Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints. Estimate return fraction from parcel or tracer evidence, distinguishing gross exchange from renewal rather than interpreting large oscillatory flow as an equal freshwater supply.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。用水團或示蹤證據估返回比例，區分總交換與有效更新，不把大量往返流誤解為同量淡水供應。
knowledge.textEn: Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints. Estimate return fraction from parcel or tracer evidence, distinguishing gross exchange from renewal rather than interpreting large oscillatory flow as an equal freshwater supply.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮交換與淨輸送」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tidal exchange versus net transport"?
options: 保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
一個容積除流量的時間後所有原有鹽水都必定完全排出。
optionsEn: Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
After one volume-divided-by-flow interval, every original parcel of saltwater has certainly left.
quiz.explanation: 保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Tidal exchange versus net transport: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮交換與淨輸送」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

quiz.question: 在「潮交換與淨輸送」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tidal exchange versus net transport" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只取半潮資料會把單向交換誤當淨流入，端點相位偏差也可製造假淨量。

Using only half a tide mistakes one-way exchange for net inflow, and endpoint phase error creates a false residual.
Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function.
quiz.explanation: 只取半潮資料會把單向交換誤當淨流入，端點相位偏差也可製造假淨量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using only half a tide mistakes one-way exchange for net inflow, and endpoint phase error creates a false residual. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 選擇性排鹽效率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Selective salt-export efficiency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「選擇性排鹽效率」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Selective salt-export efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底層較鹹時，選擇性取排可在同樣水量中帶走更多鹽，但混入淡水、界面吸升和潮向會改變效果。鹽通量比較只是局部效率，不代表整個水系供水、排洪和生態都改善；設施造成的阻力與新的運轉限制必須放入同一評估。 假設同樣Q=10m³/s，底層C=20與混合水C=5kg/m³，排鹽200與50kg/s，局部比例4；不含回流和排水限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「選擇性排鹽效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Preferential bottom withdrawal can export more salt per unit water where stratification persists, but freshwater entrainment, interface draw-up and tide alter effectiveness. Comparing salt flux is only a local efficiency measure, not proof of better water supply, drainage and ecology across the system. Added resistance and operational constraints must be assessed alongside the intended selective-export benefit. Assume equal withdrawal10m³/s from bottom concentration20 or mixed5kg/m³. Salt export is200versus50kg/s, ratio4, excluding return flow and drainage constraints. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Selective salt-export efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排口鹽濃度提高就能證明整個河口工程在所有功能上都更好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「選擇性排鹽效率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Selective salt-export efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 選擇性排鹽效率
knowledge.text: 底層較鹹時，選擇性取排可在同樣水量中帶走更多鹽，但混入淡水、界面吸升和潮向會改變效果。鹽通量比較只是局部效率，不代表整個水系供水、排洪和生態都改善；設施造成的阻力與新的運轉限制必須放入同一評估。
knowledge.textEn: Preferential bottom withdrawal can export more salt per unit water where stratification persists, but freshwater entrainment, interface draw-up and tide alter effectiveness. Comparing salt flux is only a local efficiency measure, not proof of better water supply, drainage and ecology across the system.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排口鹽濃度提高就能證明整個河口工程在所有功能上都更好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「選擇性排鹽效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Selective salt-export efficiency" is correct?
options: 排口鹽濃度提高就能證明整個河口工程在所有功能上都更好。
阻鹽工程只影響鹽分而絕不可能改變排水能力和上游水位。
底層較鹹時，選擇性取排可在同樣水量中帶走更多鹽，但混入淡水、界面吸升和潮向會改變效果。
optionsEn: Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function.
A salt-control structure affects salinity only and can never alter drainage capacity or upstream levels.
Preferential bottom withdrawal can export more salt per unit water where stratification persists, but freshwater entrainment, interface draw-up and tide alter effectiveness.
quiz.explanation: 底層較鹹時，選擇性取排可在同樣水量中帶走更多鹽，但混入淡水、界面吸升和潮向會改變效果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Preferential bottom withdrawal can export more salt per unit water where stratification persists, but freshwater entrainment, interface draw-up and tide alter effectiveness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 選擇性排鹽效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Selective salt-export efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「選擇性排鹽效率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Selective salt-export efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同樣Q=10m³/s，底層C=20與混合水C=5kg/m³，排鹽200與50kg/s，局部比例4；不含回流和排水限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume equal withdrawal10m³/s from bottom concentration20 or mixed5kg/m³. Salt export is200versus50kg/s, ratio4, excluding return flow and drainage constraints. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量排口深度、流量及濃度，追蹤界面隨排水變化，核對淡水夾帶和海側回流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure withdrawal depth, discharge and concentration together, tracking interface response, freshwater entrainment and seaward return.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同樣Q=10m³/s，底層C=20與混合水C=5kg/m³，排鹽200與50kg/s，局部比例4；不含回流和排水限制。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume equal withdrawal10m³/s from bottom concentration20 or mixed5kg/m³. Salt export is200versus50kg/s, ratio4, excluding return flow and drainage constraints.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「選擇性排鹽效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Selective salt-export efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。
初始濃度變化率可以無限制線性外推而不需更新出口鹽濃度。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake.
The initial concentration-change rate can be extrapolated indefinitely without updating outlet concentration.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 選擇性排鹽效率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Selective salt-export efficiency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「選擇性排鹽效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Selective salt-export efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量排口深度、流量及濃度，追蹤界面隨排水變化，核對淡水夾帶和海側回流。將排鹽量與上下游水位、排洪能力及生態指標並列，不能以單一高濃度排水作成功結論。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure withdrawal depth, discharge and concentration together, tracking interface response, freshwater entrainment and seaward return. Compare salt export with upstream-downstream levels, drainage capacity and ecological indicators rather than declaring success solely from a concentrated saline outflow at the outlet. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：同步量排口深度、流量及濃度，追蹤界面隨排水變化，核對淡水夾帶和海側回流。將排鹽量與上下游水位、排洪能力及生態指標並列，不能以單一高濃度排水作成功結論。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure withdrawal depth, discharge and concentration together, tracking interface response, freshwater entrainment and seaward return. Compare salt export with upstream-downstream levels, drainage capacity and ecological indicators rather than declaring success solely from a concentrated saline outflow at the outlet.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排量增加可能吸入較淡上層使選擇性下降，設施阻力又可能限制暴雨時排水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Higher withdrawal can entrain fresh upper water and reduce selectivity, while added resistance constrains drainage during rainfall. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量排口深度、流量及濃度，追蹤界面隨排水變化，核對淡水夾帶和海側回流。將排鹽量與上下游水位、排洪能力及生態指標並列，不能以單一高濃度排水作成功結論。

quiz.question: 要驗證「選擇性排鹽效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Selective salt-export efficiency"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步量排口深度、流量及濃度，追蹤界面隨排水變化，核對淡水夾帶和海側回流。
內波速度與上下鹽水淡水層厚度無關只由重力決定。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure withdrawal depth, discharge and concentration together, tracking interface response, freshwater entrainment and seaward return.
Internal-wave speed is independent of layer depths and depends only on gravity.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure withdrawal depth, discharge and concentration together, tracking interface response, freshwater entrainment and seaward return. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 選擇性排鹽效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Selective salt-export efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「選擇性排鹽效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Selective salt-export efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排量增加可能吸入較淡上層使選擇性下降，設施阻力又可能限制暴雨時排水。若只比較每立方米鹽量，會漏掉為排鹽付出的水位或供水代價。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher withdrawal can entrain fresh upper water and reduce selectivity, while added resistance constrains drainage during rainfall. Comparing only salt per cubic metre misses the water-level or supply costs incurred elsewhere in the managed system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 排量增加可能吸入較淡上層使選擇性下降，設施阻力又可能限制暴雨時排水。若只比較每立方米鹽量，會漏掉為排鹽付出的水位或供水代價。
knowledge.textEn: Higher withdrawal can entrain fresh upper water and reduce selectivity, while added resistance constrains drainage during rainfall. Comparing only salt per cubic metre misses the water-level or supply costs incurred elsewhere in the managed system.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「選擇性排鹽效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Selective salt-export efficiency" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

阻鹽工程只影響鹽分而絕不可能改變排水能力和上游水位。
排量增加可能吸入較淡上層使選擇性下降，設施阻力又可能限制暴雨時排水。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A salt-control structure affects salinity only and can never alter drainage capacity or upstream levels.
Higher withdrawal can entrain fresh upper water and reduce selectivity, while added resistance constrains drainage during rainfall.
quiz.explanation: 排量增加可能吸入較淡上層使選擇性下降，設施阻力又可能限制暴雨時排水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher withdrawal can entrain fresh upper water and reduce selectivity, while added resistance constrains drainage during rainfall. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.titleEn: Durability, maintenance and engineering handoff

steps.title: 阻鹽設施與排水損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Salt-control structure and drainage loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「阻鹽設施與排水損失」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Salt-control structure and drainage loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 阻鹽門檻或選擇性通道會改變水力連通，減少鹽入侵的同時可能增加排水水頭損失。固定局部係數僅示意速度平方關係，實際流場會受密度、開口與泵站互制影響；因此設計與驗證不能把排鹽和防洪各自視為完全獨立的系統。 假設局部係數K=2、參考速度1.5m/s，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294m；是合成清水基準，非艾默伊登量測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「阻鹽設施與排水損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A sill or selective channel changes hydraulic connectivity and can add drainage loss while addressing salt intrusion. A fixed local coefficient illustrates velocity-squared behavior only; density, openings and pumping interact in the real flow. Design and verification therefore cannot treat salt control and flood drainage as fully independent systems whose local successes automatically combine into successful overall performance. Assume K=2 and reference speed1.5m/s. hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294m is a synthetic clear-water baseline, not an IJmuiden measurement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Salt-control structure and drainage loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A salt-control structure affects salinity only and can never alter drainage capacity or upstream levels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「阻鹽設施與排水損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 阻鹽設施與排水損失
knowledge.text: 阻鹽門檻或選擇性通道會改變水力連通，減少鹽入侵的同時可能增加排水水頭損失。固定局部係數僅示意速度平方關係，實際流場會受密度、開口與泵站互制影響；因此設計與驗證不能把排鹽和防洪各自視為完全獨立的系統。
knowledge.textEn: A sill or selective channel changes hydraulic connectivity and can add drainage loss while addressing salt intrusion. A fixed local coefficient illustrates velocity-squared behavior only; density, openings and pumping interact in the real flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻鹽工程只影響鹽分而絕不可能改變排水能力和上游水位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A salt-control structure affects salinity only and can never alter drainage capacity or upstream levels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「阻鹽設施與排水損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
