steps.objective: 說明「情境比較與可追溯決策」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。單位供水能耗只是其中一項指標，仍需同時滿足水位、水壓、水質與設備限制；較低能耗若伴隨供水不足，不能視為等效服務下的改善。每次分析應保存模型版本、資料時間範圍、參數、假設和人工審查結果，使未來能重播同一情境。生成式助教可協助整理證據與解釋差異，但其文字結論不能代替可執行模型輸出或現場授權程序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「情境比較與可追溯決策」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. Specific energy is only one metric alongside level, pressure, quality and equipment constraints; lower energy with unmet demand is not equivalent service improvement. Preserve model version, data period, parameters, assumptions and reviewed conclusions for reproducible replay. A generative tutor can organize evidence and explain differences, but its prose does not replace executable model results or authorized operating procedures. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「情境比較與可追溯決策」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策
knowledge.text: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。單位供水能耗只是其中一項指標，仍需同時滿足水位、水壓、水質與設備限制；較低能耗若伴隨供水不足，不能視為等效服務下的改善。
knowledge.textEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. Specific energy is only one metric alongside level, pressure, quality and equipment constraints; lower energy with unmet demand is not equivalent service improvement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「情境比較與可追溯決策」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions" is correct?
options: 只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。
數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。
節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
optionsEn: Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints.
Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy.
A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
quiz.explanation: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「情境比較與可追溯決策」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Specific energy is 0.20 and 0.18 kWh/m³, a 10% reduction excluding tariff differences and equipment wear. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。
knowledge.textEn: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Specific energy is 0.20 and 0.18 kWh/m³, a 10% reduction excluding tariff differences and equipment wear.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「情境比較與可追溯決策」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions", which statement holds?
options: 兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。
最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。
教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh。
optionsEn: Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations.
A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data.
Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「情境比較與可追溯決策」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。用資料與模型雜湊記錄可重播版本，另列需求及參數敏感度，最後把待現場驗證的假設與已被量測支持的結論分開，避免把模擬排名直接當成操作命令。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Record replayable data and model hashes, evaluate demand sensitivity, and separate assumptions needing field confirmation from supported conclusions before converting a scenario ranking into an operational decision. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立兩方案比較表，包含供水量、能耗、單位能耗及限制是否滿足，再把其中一方案供水量減少一成。重算指標並說明為何原先節能結論需要重新判讀，最後列出第三人重播分析所需的最小檔案清單。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare volume, energy, specific energy and constraint compliance, then reduce the delivery of one strategy by ten percent. Recalculate and reconsider the claimed improvement, listing the minimum files another reviewer needs to reproduce the analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。用資料與模型雜湊記錄可重播版本，另列需求及參數敏感度，最後把待現場驗證的假設與已被量測支持的結論分開，避免把模擬排名直接當成操作命令。
knowledge.textEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Record replayable data and model hashes, evaluate demand sensitivity, and separate assumptions needing field confirmation from supported conclusions before converting a scenario ranking into an operational decision.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立兩方案比較表，包含供水量、能耗、單位能耗及限制是否滿足，再把其中一方案供水量減少一成。重算指標並說明為何原先節能結論需要重新判讀，最後列出第三人重播分析所需的最小檔案清單。
knowledge.textEn: Compare volume, energy, specific energy and constraint compliance, then reduce the delivery of one strategy by ten percent. Recalculate and reconsider the claimed improvement, listing the minimum files another reviewer needs to reproduce the analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「情境比較與可追溯決策」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions"?
options: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。
optionsEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact.
quiz.explanation: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「情境比較與可追溯決策」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。缺少版本與輸入紀錄的漂亮圖表也無法重現，因此不能在條件已改變後沿用舊排名而不重新計算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Attractive plots without versioned inputs cannot be reproduced, and old rankings should not be reused after conditions change without recalculation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：生成式助教可協助整理證據與解釋差異，但其文字結論不能代替可執行模型輸出或現場授權程序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A generative tutor can organize evidence and explain differences, but its prose does not replace executable model results or authorized operating procedures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。缺少版本與輸入紀錄的漂亮圖表也無法重現，因此不能在條件已改變後沿用舊排名而不重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Attractive plots without versioned inputs cannot be reproduced, and old rankings should not be reused after conditions change without recalculation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「情境比較與可追溯決策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。
節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency.
A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
quiz.explanation: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 台北捷運文湖線
summary: 以文湖線的都市中運量路網為背景，建立密站距、曲線與高架車站的縮尺營運實驗。課程從輪胎接觸和乘客舒適性延伸到進路互鎖及失去通訊後的安全狀態，對照班距縮短與折返瓶頸。
summaryEn: Use the Wenhu urban corridor to construct a scaled operational experiment with closely spaced stations, curves and elevated platforms. Begin with tyre contact and passenger comfort, then investigate route interlocking and the safe state after communication loss. Contrast shorter line headways with a terminal that cannot release routes quickly enough.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 rolling_power=109.08 kW；單元 2 得 jerk=0.2970297 m/s^3；單元 3 得 dwell=24.60417 s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 coefficient 的擾動測試，結果改為 119.988 kW；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以文湖線的都市中運量路網為背景，建立密站距、曲線與高架車站的縮尺營運實驗。課程從輪胎接觸和乘客舒適性延伸到進路互鎖及失去通訊後的安全狀態，對照班距縮短與折返瓶頸。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives rolling_power=109.08 kW; unit 2 gives jerk=0.2970297 m/s^3; unit 3 gives dwell=24.60417 s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing coefficient in the first unit changes its result to 119.988 kW. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Wenhu urban corridor to construct a scaled operational experiment with closely spaced stations, curves and elevated platforms. Begin with tyre contact and passenger comfort, then investigate route interlocking and the safe state after communication loss. Contrast shorter line headways with a terminal that cannot release routes quickly enough. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.

stages.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散與加速度斜坡與舒適性
stages.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss & Acceleration ramps and comfort
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」與「加速度斜坡與舒適性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rubber-tyre rolling loss" and "Acceleration ramps and comfort": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 膠輪變形造成遲滯能量損失，可用等效滾動阻力係數乘法向力估計阻力。胎壓、溫度和路面狀態都會改變係數；承載輪與導向輪的功能不同，不能用鋼輪系統的固定係數直接替代。 滾動阻力係數乘法向荷重得到阻力，再乘速度才是功率。輪胎壓力、溫度與變形影響係數；此模型沒有計入導向輪、風阻與加速能量，不能代表整車總耗電。 用相同輪載與速度比較輪胎滾動阻力功率，另列導向輪的功能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rubber deformation creates hysteretic energy loss, represented approximately by a rolling coefficient times normal force. Tyre pressure, temperature and running surface change the coefficient. Load-bearing and guidance wheels serve different functions, so a coefficient from a steel-wheel system cannot simply be substituted. Rolling-resistance coefficient times normal load gives force, and multiplying by speed gives power. Tyre inflation, temperature and deformation influence the coefficient. Guidance wheels, aerodynamic drag and acceleration are excluded, so this does not represent total vehicle electricity. Compare tyre rolling-resistance power at equal wheel load and speed, separately identifying guide-wheel functions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s；計算：rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s; calculation: rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膠輪與鋼輪的滾動阻力係數可以不經試驗直接互換」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rubber-tyre and steel-wheel rolling coefficients can be interchanged without testing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rubber-tyre rolling loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散
knowledge.text: 膠輪變形造成遲滯能量損失，可用等效滾動阻力係數乘法向力估計阻力。胎壓、溫度和路面狀態都會改變係數；承載輪與導向輪的功能不同，不能用鋼輪系統的固定係數直接替代。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：膠輪與鋼輪的滾動阻力係數可以不經試驗直接互換 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rubber-tyre and steel-wheel rolling coefficients can be interchanged without testing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rubber-tyre rolling loss" is correct?
options: 膠輪與鋼輪的滾動阻力係數可以不經試驗直接互換

optionsEn: Rubber-tyre and steel-wheel rolling coefficients can be interchanged without testing.
Rubber deformation creates hysteretic energy loss, represented approximately by a rolling coefficient times normal force.
Equal peak acceleration guarantees equal abruptness felt by passengers.

quiz.explanationEn: Rubber deformation creates hysteretic energy loss, represented approximately by a rolling coefficient times normal force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s；計算：rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW。敏感度：coefficient 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013332 1，其餘固定，結果為 119.988 kW。模型邊界：固定等效係數與定速；不含轉彎側滑、胎溫演化或驅動損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s; calculation: rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW. Sensitivity: coefficient, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013332 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 119.988 kW. Model boundary: Fixed effective coefficient and constant speed; curve scrub, tyre-temperature evolution and drive losses are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較相同負載下的牽引能量與胎溫，記錄胎壓、路面濕度及輪胎批次，並將導向輪磨耗獨立檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare traction energy and tyre temperature at equal load, record pressure, surface moisture and tyre batch, and inspect guidance-wheel wear separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: coefficient, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013332 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 119.988 kW. Model boundary: Fixed effective coefficient and constant speed; curve scrub, tyre-temperature evolution and drive losses are excluded.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s; calculation: rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較相同負載下的牽引能量與胎溫，記錄胎壓、路面濕度及輪胎批次，並將導向輪磨耗獨立檢查。 在已知輪載與穩定速度下量測牽引力，記錄胎壓及溫度，扣除可辨識的其他阻力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare traction energy and tyre temperature at equal load, record pressure, surface moisture and tyre batch, and inspect guidance-wheel wear separately. Measure tractive force at known normal load and steady speed, record tyre pressure and temperature, and remove identifiable other resistance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改變胎壓造成的假想滾阻係數，重算同速耗能，設計同時記錄輪溫與側向磨耗的對照試驗。 再以本單元 coefficient 的對照值重算 rolling_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change the hypothetical rolling coefficient associated with tyre pressure, recalculate energy at equal speed, and design a comparison recording tyre temperature and lateral wear. Also recalculate rolling_power for the alternative coefficient value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：胎壓偏低可能增加變形和熱累積，導向偏差又會造成額外磨耗；只看馬達電流無法區分兩種原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low tyre pressure can increase deformation and heat accumulation, while guidance misalignment adds wear; motor current alone cannot distinguish the causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較相同負載下的牽引能量與胎溫，記錄胎壓、路面濕度及輪胎批次，並將導向輪磨耗獨立檢查。 在已知輪載與穩定速度下量測牽引力，記錄胎壓及溫度，扣除可辨識的其他阻力。
knowledge.textEn: Compare traction energy and tyre temperature at equal load, record pressure, surface moisture and tyre batch, and inspect guidance-wheel wear separately. Measure tractive force at known normal load and steady speed, record tyre pressure and temperature, and remove identifiable other resistance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 改變胎壓造成的假想滾阻係數，重算同速耗能，設計同時記錄輪溫與側向磨耗的對照試驗。 再以本單元 coefficient 的對照值重算 rolling_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Change the hypothetical rolling coefficient associated with tyre pressure, recalculate energy at equal speed, and design a comparison recording tyre temperature and lateral wear. Also recalculate rolling_power for the alternative coefficient value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rubber-tyre rolling loss"?
options: 比較相同負載下的牽引能量與胎溫，記錄胎壓、路面濕度及輪胎批次，並將導向輪磨耗獨立檢查。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常
optionsEn: Compare traction energy and tyre temperature at equal load, record pressure, surface moisture and tyre batch, and inspect guidance-wheel wear separately.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
quiz.explanation: 比較相同負載下的牽引能量與胎溫，記錄胎壓、路面濕度及輪胎批次，並將導向輪磨耗獨立檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare traction energy and tyre temperature at equal load, record pressure, surface moisture and tyre batch, and inspect guidance-wheel wear separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rubber-tyre rolling loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rubber-tyre rolling loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 胎壓偏低可能增加變形和熱累積，導向偏差又會造成額外磨耗；只看馬達電流無法區分兩種原因。 胎壓下降可能提高滾阻，需以同速同載量測判別變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low tyre pressure can increase deformation and heat accumulation, while guidance misalignment adds wear; motor current alone cannot distinguish the causes. Lower inflation can raise rolling resistance; compare measurements at equal speed and load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用相同輪載與速度比較輪胎滾動阻力功率，另列導向輪的功能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare tyre rolling-resistance power at equal wheel load and speed, separately identifying guide-wheel functions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「膠輪與鋼輪的滾動阻力係數可以不經試驗直接互換」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rubber-tyre and steel-wheel rolling coefficients can be interchanged without testing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 胎壓偏低可能增加變形和熱累積，導向偏差又會造成額外磨耗；只看馬達電流無法區分兩種原因。 胎壓下降可能提高滾阻，需以同速同載量測判別變化。
knowledge.textEn: Low tyre pressure can increase deformation and heat accumulation, while guidance misalignment adds wear; motor current alone cannot distinguish the causes. Lower inflation can raise rolling resistance; compare measurements at equal speed and load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膠輪滾阻與熱耗散」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rubber-tyre rolling loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
胎壓偏低可能增加變形和熱累積，導向偏差又會造成額外磨耗；只看馬達電流無法區分兩種原因。
只要最大加速度相同乘客感受到的突然性就相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Low tyre pressure can increase deformation and heat accumulation, while guidance misalignment adds wear; motor current alone cannot distinguish the causes.
Equal peak acceleration guarantees equal abruptness felt by passengers.

quiz.explanationEn: Low tyre pressure can increase deformation and heat accumulation, while guidance misalignment adds wear; motor current alone cannot distinguish the causes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 加速度斜坡與舒適性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Acceleration ramps and comfort: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「加速度斜坡與舒適性」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceleration ramps and comfort” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同加速度峰值可以用不同建立時間達到，旅客感受到的突然性由加加速度描述。限制斜坡能減少站立乘客失衡，但也延長加速時間；行車時間、牽引功率及停準控制必須一起重新計算。 斜坡較緩時達到同一速度需要額外時間，且短站距可能沒有足夠時間維持最大加速度。控制器因此應以完整速度軌跡為輸出，而非只檢查單一加速度峰值。 把站立旅客的加速度斜坡與短站距加速時間一併記錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「加速度斜坡與舒適性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The same acceleration peak can be reached with different ramp durations. Jerk measures how abruptly acceleration changes. Limiting the ramp reduces sudden disturbance to standing passengers but extends acceleration time, so running time, traction power and stopping control must be reconsidered together. A gentler ramp takes more time to reach a target speed, and short station spacing may leave no interval at peak acceleration. The controller therefore needs a complete speed trajectory rather than acceptance based only on one acceleration peak. Record acceleration ramps for standing passengers together with acceleration time on short station spacing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Acceleration ramps and comfort” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 加速度斜坡與舒適性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceleration ramps and comfort: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「加速度斜坡與舒適性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceleration ramps and comfort” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：a=0.9 m/s^2; ramp=3.03 s；計算：jerk=a/ramp=0.2970297 m/s^3。敏感度：ramp 單獨增加百分之十至 3.333 s，其餘固定，結果為 0.270027 m/s^3。模型邊界：線性加速度斜坡；不把此值視為任何營運者的舒適性門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: a=0.9 m/s^2; ramp=3.03 s; calculation: jerk=a/ramp=0.2970297 m/s^3. Sensitivity: ramp, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 3.333 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.270027 m/s^3. Model boundary: Linear acceleration ramp; the result is not an operator comfort threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將加速度經已知頻寬濾波後再微分，保留原始資料，利用速度積分檢查濾波相位延遲沒有改變控制事件的先後。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Filter acceleration with a documented bandwidth before differentiating, retain raw data, and integrate it to check that phase delay has not reordered control events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 加速度斜坡與舒適性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceleration ramps and comfort: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「加速度斜坡與舒適性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Acceleration ramps and comfort” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將加速度經已知頻寬濾波後再微分，保留原始資料，利用速度積分檢查濾波相位延遲沒有改變控制事件的先後。 以已知時間基準檢查取樣間隔，並比較不同濾波頻寬對加加速度峰值的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Filter acceleration with a documented bandwidth before differentiating, retain raw data, and integrate it to check that phase delay has not reordered control events. Verify sampling intervals against a known time reference and compare how alternative filter bandwidths change the estimated jerk peak. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較快慢兩種斜坡在同一終速度下的時間與位移，提交含濾波頻寬及感測器安裝方向的分析紀錄。 再以本單元 ramp 的對照值重算 jerk，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare fast and slow ramps at the same final speed, calculate elapsed time and distance, and document filter bandwidth and sensor orientation with the analysis. Also recalculate jerk for the alternative ramp value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接微分含雜訊的加速度會放大高頻誤差，過度平滑又會掩蓋真實尖峰；兩者都可能造成錯誤的舒適性判定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Differentiating noisy acceleration amplifies high-frequency error, while excessive smoothing hides real peaks; either can produce a false comfort assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 加速度斜坡與舒適性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceleration ramps and comfort: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「加速度斜坡與舒適性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Acceleration ramps and comfort” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接微分含雜訊的加速度會放大高頻誤差，過度平滑又會掩蓋真實尖峰；兩者都可能造成錯誤的舒適性判定。 需查看原始加速度，判別峰值是否由數值微分產生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Differentiating noisy acceleration amplifies high-frequency error, while excessive smoothing hides real peaks; either can produce a false comfort assessment. Inspect raw acceleration to determine whether a peak was created by numerical differentiation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把站立旅客的加速度斜坡與短站距加速時間一併記錄。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 直接微分含雜訊的加速度會放大高頻誤差，過度平滑又會掩蓋真實尖峰；兩者都可能造成錯誤的舒適性判定。 需查看原始加速度，判別峰值是否由數值微分產生。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 車門交換與停站時間與速度限制轉換與預告距離
stages.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time & Speed-limit transition and warning distance
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車門交換與停站時間」與「速度限制轉換與預告距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Door exchange and dwell time" and "Speed-limit transition and warning distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 檢查小編組車門集中需求是否使某一門組決定停站尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Check whether concentrated demand in a short train makes one door group govern the dwell tail. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 車門交換與停站時間
knowledge.text: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。
knowledge.textEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Door exchange and dwell time" is correct?
options: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
optionsEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算

Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 267, to 267 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 25.90625 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：試驗與驗證

Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門交換與停站時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. steps.objective: 說明「速度限制轉換與預告距離」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 將自動運轉的目標停車點與速度監督包絡分開表示。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度限制轉換與預告距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Distinguish the automatic-operation target stop from the speed-supervision envelope. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 關於「速度限制轉換與預告距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Speed-limit transition and warning distance" is correct?
options: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=24.4 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=381.0462 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 26.84 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 477.2197 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=24.4 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=381.0462 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 26.84 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 477.2197 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 26.84 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 477.2197 m. knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度限制轉換與預告距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front.

Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「速度限制轉換與預告距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Speed-limit transition and warning distance"?
options: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
膠輪與鋼輪的滾動阻力係數可以不經試驗直接互換

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Rubber-tyre and steel-wheel rolling coefficients can be interchanged without testing.
quiz.explanation: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將自動運轉的目標停車點與速度監督包絡分開表示。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish the automatic-operation target stop from the speed-supervision envelope.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。
knowledge.textEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「速度限制轉換與預告距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Speed-limit transition and warning distance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.

stages.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證與通訊延遲與位置陳舊量
stages.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification & Communication delay and stale position
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「互斥進路與真值驗證」與「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" and "Communication delay and stale position": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 對相向折返與側線進入建立互斥進路的真值表。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Construct mutually exclusive route truth tables for reversing movements and siding entry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「互斥進路與真值驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 在無線封包延遲增加時檢查授權有效期，保留停止狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Check authority expiry as wireless packet delay grows, retaining a defined stopping state. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Communication delay and stale position” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3333 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.3325 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3333 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.3325 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Communication delay and stale position” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Communication delay and stale position” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在無線封包延遲增加時檢查授權有效期，保留停止狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check authority expiry as wireless packet delay grows, retaining a defined stopping state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.

stages.title: 折返作業與路徑占用與牽引饋線壓降
stages.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation & Traction feeder voltage drop
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「折返作業與路徑占用」與「牽引饋線壓降」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Turnback and route occupation" and "Traction feeder voltage drop": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「折返作業與路徑占用」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turnback and route occupation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。 只要有兩條路徑共享道岔或保護區，表面上分開的月台仍可能互相限制。時序模型應包含占用開始、列車清空和進路釋放三個不同時間，而非一個站停數字。 比較一列列車換端與另一列車進入終端時的道岔占用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「折返作業與路徑占用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks. A simple sum represents one declared serial path, rather than a universal minimum headway for every terminal layout. Platforms that appear separate can still constrain each other through shared points or protection zones. A sequence model needs distinct times for occupation, physical clearance and route release rather than representing all three by one station dwell value. Compare switch occupation during one train reversal with a following train entering the terminus. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Turnback and route occupation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「折返作業與路徑占用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Turnback and route occupation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 折返作業與路徑占用
knowledge.text: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。
knowledge.textEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「折返作業與路徑占用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數

optionsEn: Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.

Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折返作業與路徑占用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Turnback and route occupation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 83.325 s，其餘固定，結果為 143.325 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 83.325 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 143.325 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「牽引饋線壓降」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction feeder voltage drop” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 把最遠受電列車與同區段加速列車放入簡化供電模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牽引饋線壓降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Place the most distant receiving train and another accelerating train in a simplified supply model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Traction feeder voltage drop” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=90.9 V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「牽引饋線壓降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牽引饋線壓降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Traction feeder voltage drop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1666.5 A，其餘固定，結果為 99.99 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=90.9 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1666.5 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 99.99 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
