stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sound-energy addition and decibels" and "Backup battery endurance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聲能相加與分貝」如何影響台北捷運文湖線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sound-energy addition and decibels” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。非相干聲源需先還原相對聲能再合成，頻帶、量測位置及時間加權若不同，表面上相同的數值也不能直接比較。 分貝是對數量，聲源互不相干時應先轉回線性能量再相加。頻率加權和量測時間必須相同，否則兩個數字不能直接合成；有相干干涉時還需相位資訊。 在高架曲線旁區分輪胎滾動、設備與背景聲能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聲能相加與分貝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy. Different bands, measurement positions or time weightings prevent direct comparison even when displayed values happen to match. Decibels are logarithmic, so incoherent sources must be converted to linear energy before summation. Frequency weighting and observation duration must match. Coherent interference additionally requires phase information and is not captured by the energy-sum model. Separate tyre rolling, equipment and background acoustic energy beside an elevated curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sound-energy addition and decibels” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「聲能相加與分貝」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sound-energy addition and decibels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「聲能相加與分貝」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sound-energy addition and decibels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。敏感度：L1 聲級增加 3 dB，不代表數值百分比的功率增加至 74 dB，其餘固定，結果為 74.7901 dB。模型邊界：相同基準與加權的非相干聲源；不含相位干涉與背景扣除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB. Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 74 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 74.7901 dB. Model boundary: Incoherent sources with the same reference and weighting; phase interference and background subtraction are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backup battery endurance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Wenhu Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。低溫、老化及啟動電流會縮短可用時間；額定安時也不能直接當成瓦時。 可用電量應扣除允許放電深度與轉換損失，負載也可能隨時間變化。銘牌容量的測試溫度和放電倍率會影響實際結果，續航計算不能取代受控放電驗證。 驗證失去正常電源後通訊與疏散照明的負載分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「備援電池與可維持時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency. Dividing by load gives ideal endurance. Cold temperature, ageing and start-up current can shorten it; an ampere-hour rating must not be mistaken directly for watt-hours. Usable energy must account for permitted discharge depth and conversion losses, while load may vary over time. Test temperature and discharge rate influence rated capacity, so an endurance calculation cannot replace controlled discharge verification. Verify load allocation to communications and evacuation lighting after normal power is lost. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup battery endurance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.2 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.636 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.22 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 3.9996 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.2 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.636 h. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.22 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3.9996 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.textEn: Increase load and reduce usable capacity for an ageing case, recalculate endurance, and identify evidence required beyond terminal-voltage readings. Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「備援電池與可維持時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backup battery endurance"?
options: 定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數
optionsEn: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
quiz.explanation: 定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backup battery endurance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「備援電池與可維持時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backup battery endurance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Normal open-circuit voltage does not prove sufficient capacity; inspect the loaded discharge curve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗證失去正常電源後通訊與疏散照明的負載分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verify load allocation to communications and evacuation lighting after normal power is lost.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。
knowledge.textEn: An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Normal open-circuit voltage does not prove sufficient capacity; inspect the loaded discharge curve.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「備援電池與可維持時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backup battery endurance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。
膠輪與鋼輪的滾動阻力係數可以不經試驗直接互換
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks.
Rubber-tyre and steel-wheel rolling coefficients can be interchanged without testing.
quiz.explanation: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 台北捷運淡水信義線
summary: 以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。
summaryEn: Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 capacity=17647.06 persons/hour；單元 2 得 dwell=24.76042 s；單元 3 得 combined_sigma=0.08534378 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 headway 的擾動測試，結果改為 16042.78 persons/hour；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives capacity=17647.06 persons/hour; unit 2 gives dwell=24.76042 s; unit 3 gives combined_sigma=0.08534378 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing headway in the first unit changes its result to 16042.78 persons/hour. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 班距與有效運能與車門交換與停站時間
stages.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity & Door exchange and dwell time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「班距與有效運能」與「車門交換與停站時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Headway and usable capacity" and "Door exchange and dwell time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「班距與有效運能」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Headway and usable capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 讓尖峰轉乘需求與線上可用運能使用相同的時間窗比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「班距與有效運能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Compare peak interchange demand and usable line capacity over the same time window. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Headway and usable capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「班距與有效運能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Headway and usable capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 班距與有效運能
knowledge.text: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。
knowledge.textEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Headway and usable capacity" is correct?
options: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
optionsEn: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
quiz.explanation: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「班距與有效運能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Headway and usable capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16042.78 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16042.78 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16042.78 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16042.78 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「班距與有效運能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Headway and usable capacity", which statement holds?
options: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train。
optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距與有效運能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway and usable capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Headway and usable capacity"?
options: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距與有效運能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway and usable capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 把樓梯附近的車門視為獨立服務群，檢查不均勻上車。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Treat doors beside the stairs as a distinct service group and test uneven boarding. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車門交換與停站時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Door exchange and dwell time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車門交換與停站時間
knowledge.text: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。
knowledge.textEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移

optionsEn: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門交換與停站時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door exchange and dwell time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 270至 270 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.0625 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 270, to 270 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.0625 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門交換與停站時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Door exchange and dwell time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把樓梯附近的車門視為獨立服務群，檢查不均勻上車。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treat doors beside the stairs as a distinct service group and test uneven boarding.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位與月台暫存與隊列守恆
stages.titleEn: Stopping error and platform-door alignment & Platform storage and queue conservation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停準誤差與月台門對位」與「月台暫存與隊列守恆」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stopping error and platform-door alignment" and "Platform storage and queue conservation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stopping error and platform-door alignment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停準誤差與月台門對位」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。 停車、測量與門位置三個獨立零均值誤差以變異數相加，再取平方根得到合成標準差。這不是最大偏移保證，也不含共同系統偏差；機械淨空及容許對位範圍須另外核對。 將停準、門位和測量誤差分開，檢查月台門對位的不確定度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準誤差與月台門對位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately. Geometric alignment does not replace obstruction detection or the door-closure interlock. Three independent zero-mean errors in stopping, surveying and door position combine through summed variances. The square root gives a standard deviation, not a guaranteed maximum offset. Shared bias is excluded, and mechanical clearance and permitted alignment ranges require separate checks. Separate stopping, door-position and survey errors when checking platform-door alignment uncertainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停準誤差與月台門對位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stopping error and platform-door alignment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位
knowledge.text: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。
knowledge.textEn: Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

options: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。
停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移

A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.

steps.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stopping error and platform-door alignment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準誤差與月台門對位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.08976 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09317649 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m. Sensitivity: stop_sigma, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.08976 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.09317649 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean errors; not a maximum bound and no acceptance tolerance is specified. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.08976 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09317649 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stopping error and platform-door alignment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準誤差與月台門對位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。 以獨立基準重複量測停準與門位，檢查各誤差平均值、相關性和單位，再核對合成分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Repeat stopping and door-position measurements against an independent reference, check each mean, correlation and unit, and compare the combined distribution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把隨機誤差和固定偏移分開做誤差預算，畫出不同載重的停準分布，列出對位與互鎖需分別驗證的證據。 再以本單元 stop_sigma 的對照值重算 combined_sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build separate random-error and fixed-bias budgets, plot stopping distributions at different loads, and list distinct evidence for alignment and interlocking. Also recalculate combined_sigma for the alternative stop_sigma value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 把隨機誤差和固定偏移分開做誤差預算，畫出不同載重的停準分布，列出對位與互鎖需分別驗證的證據。 再以本單元 stop_sigma 的對照值重算 combined_sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。

quiz.question: 要驗證「停準誤差與月台門對位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stopping error and platform-door alignment"?

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.

Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stopping error and platform-door alignment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停準誤差與月台門對位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A shared positioning bias makes the root-sum-square model understate actual alignment offset. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將停準、門位和測量誤差分開，檢查月台門對位的不確定度。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform storage and queue conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 以轉乘列車批次到達測試等候區占用與通道淨寬。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台暫存與隊列守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Test waiting-area occupation and clear circulation width under batch arrivals from connecting trains. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform storage and queue conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=428 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.222857 persons/m^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=428 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.222857 persons/m^2.

Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform storage and queue conservation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=428 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.222857 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 471至 471 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.345714 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=428 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.222857 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 471, to 471 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.345714 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。
knowledge.textEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台暫存與隊列守恆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Platform storage and queue conservation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。
換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing.
Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
quiz.explanation: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 折返作業與路徑占用與再生煞車能量與受電條件
stages.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation & Regenerative energy and receptivity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「折返作業與路徑占用」與「再生煞車能量與受電條件」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Turnback and route occupation" and "Regenerative energy and receptivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「折返作業與路徑占用」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turnback and route occupation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。 只要有兩條路徑共享道岔或保護區，表面上分開的月台仍可能互相限制。時序模型應包含占用開始、列車清空和進路釋放三個不同時間，而非一個站停數字。 觀察終端進站、換端和離站哪個互斥事件控制下一班。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「折返作業與路徑占用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks. A simple sum represents one declared serial path, rather than a universal minimum headway for every terminal layout. Platforms that appear separate can still constrain each other through shared points or protection zones. A sequence model needs distinct times for occupation, physical clearance and route release rather than representing all three by one station dwell value. Identify which conflicting arrival, reversal or departure event controls the following service. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Turnback and route occupation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「折返作業與路徑占用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Turnback and route occupation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 折返作業與路徑占用
knowledge.text: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。
knowledge.textEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「折返作業與路徑占用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Turnback and route occupation" is correct?
options: 換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。
optionsEn: Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes.
quiz.explanation: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折返作業與路徑占用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Turnback and route occupation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 84.15 s，其餘固定，結果為 144.15 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 84.15 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 144.15 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 84.15 s，其餘固定，結果為 144.15 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 84.15 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 144.15 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「折返作業與路徑占用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Turnback and route occupation", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「折返作業與路徑占用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Turnback and route occupation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Cross-check occupation indication against actual rear-end clearance and list whether each task can overlap and which preceding events it requires. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出單月台與雙月台折返的甘特圖，標註不可同時使用的路徑，並以一班晚到列車檢查延誤是否傳到下一班。 再以本單元 reverse 的對照值重算 cycle，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw single-platform and dual-platform turnback timelines, mark mutually exclusive routes, and introduce one late train to test propagation into the next departure. Also recalculate cycle for the alternative reverse value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。
knowledge.textEn: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Cross-check occupation indication against actual rear-end clearance and list whether each task can overlap and which preceding events it requires.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出單月台與雙月台折返的甘特圖，標註不可同時使用的路徑，並以一班晚到列車檢查延誤是否傳到下一班。 再以本單元 reverse 的對照值重算 cycle，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Draw single-platform and dual-platform turnback timelines, mark mutually exclusive routes, and introduce one late train to test propagation into the next departure. Also recalculate cycle for the alternative reverse value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「折返作業與路徑占用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Turnback and route occupation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
quiz.explanation: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「折返作業與路徑占用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Turnback and route occupation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Cab-change completion cannot substitute for route-release evidence while the train rear remains uncleared. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：觀察終端進站、換端和離站哪個互斥事件控制下一班。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identify which conflicting arrival, reversal or departure event controls the following service.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。
knowledge.textEn: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Cab-change completion cannot substitute for route-release evidence while the train rear remains uncleared.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「折返作業與路徑占用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Turnback and route occupation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「再生煞車能量與受電條件」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Regenerative energy and receptivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 比較市區短站距煞車頻率與受電列車的時間重疊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「再生煞車能量與受電條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Compare frequent braking on urban station spacing with temporal overlap of receptive trains. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Regenerative energy and receptivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=244800 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.8125 kWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=244800 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.8125 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Regenerative energy and receptivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件

Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings.

quiz.question: 關於「再生煞車能量與受電條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Regenerative energy and receptivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=244800 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.8125 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 269280 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.19375 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=244800 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.8125 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 269280 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.19375 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=244800 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.8125 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 269280 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.19375 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=244800 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.8125 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 269280 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.19375 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
