steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「再生煞車能量與受電條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Regenerative energy and receptivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「再生煞車能量與受電條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Regenerative energy and receptivity"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移

Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs.

quiz.explanationEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Regenerative energy and receptivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較市區短站距煞車頻率與受電列車的時間重疊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare frequent braking on urban station spacing with temporal overlap of receptive trains.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.instruction: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 在地下站內分開一般換氣估算與火災排煙的設計問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Separate an underground station air-change estimate from the distinct design problem of smoke control. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 28.05 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 246.2658 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.05 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 246.2658 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. steps.title: 集水與排水容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水與排水容量」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 把入口集水範圍與抽水機啟停水位連成體積平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水與排水容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Connect the entrance catchment and pump switching levels through a volume balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水與排水容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.04e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31212 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.244e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.343332 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.04e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31212 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.244e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.343332 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水與排水容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水與排水容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把入口集水範圍與抽水機啟停水位連成體積平衡。

stages.title: 里程融合與不確定度與轉乘步行與銜接餘裕

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Position fusion and uncertainty" and "Transfer walking and connection margin": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「里程融合與不確定度」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position fusion and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 對連續地下區間加入里程誤差，說明校正標誌的重要性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「里程融合與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Introduce odometry error in a continuous underground section and examine correction references. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position fusion and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.488 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.826817 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.488 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.826817 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「里程融合與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Position fusion and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響台北捷運淡水信義線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 將垂直移動與平面步行分開，檢查轉乘時間的分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Separate vertical circulation from level walking and inspect the distribution of transfer times. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transfer walking and connection margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer walking and connection margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 m，其餘固定，結果為 53.04 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 53.04 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 m，其餘固定，結果為 53.04 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 53.04 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transfer walking and connection margin", which statement holds?
options: 停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移
換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s。
optionsEn: A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer walking and connection margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。
knowledge.textEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transfer walking and connection margin"?
options: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
optionsEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer walking and connection margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將垂直移動與平面步行分開，檢查轉乘時間的分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate vertical circulation from level walking and inspect the distribution of transfer times.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transfer walking and connection margin" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。
只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route.
Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高雄捷運紅線
summary: 以高雄紅線的南北都市走廊為背景，建立炎熱午後的站車負載案例。學徒需把冷房耗電、尖峰上車與加速電流放在同一時間軸，並在強降雨與單一電源失效下檢查服務降級和人員引導。
summaryEn: Use Kaohsiung’s north-south Red Line as the setting for a hot-afternoon station and train load case. Place cooling demand, peak boarding and acceleration current on one timeline. Under heavy rainfall and a single supply failure, examine degraded service and passenger guidance without assuming that comfortable room temperature alone demonstrates system resilience.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 air_rise=12.81095 K；單元 2 得 capacity=17475.73 persons/hour；單元 3 得 dwell=24.86458 s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 heat 的擾動測試，結果改為 14.09204 K；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以高雄紅線的南北都市走廊為背景，建立炎熱午後的站車負載案例。學徒需把冷房耗電、尖峰上車與加速電流放在同一時間軸，並在強降雨與單一電源失效下檢查服務降級和人員引導。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives air_rise=12.81095 K; unit 2 gives capacity=17475.73 persons/hour; unit 3 gives dwell=24.86458 s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing heat in the first unit changes its result to 14.09204 K. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Kaohsiung’s north-south Red Line as the setting for a hot-afternoon station and train load case. Place cooling demand, peak boarding and acceleration current on one timeline. Under heavy rainfall and a single supply failure, examine degraded service and passenger guidance without assuming that comfortable room temperature alone demonstrates system resilience. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升與班距與有效運能
stages.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat & Headway and usable capacity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風散熱與設備溫升」與「班距與有效運能」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" and "Headway and usable capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風散熱與設備溫升」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。設備房還存在短路循環和局部熱點，平均送排風溫差不能保證所有電子模組都在同樣環境中。 顯熱負載決定溫度改變需求，但高濕環境還有潛熱除濕與新風處理。冷卻量和耗電量也不同，兩者需要效率或性能係數連結，不能把熱量數字當作電表讀值。 把月台與車廂顯熱負載分開，避免用總冷量代替區域舒適度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風散熱與設備溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. Insufficient flow raises exhaust temperature. Equipment rooms also contain recirculation and hot spots, so an average supply-to-exhaust difference does not guarantee identical conditions around every electronic module. Sensible load describes temperature-related demand, while humidity introduces latent dehumidification and outdoor-air treatment. Cooling delivered and electricity consumed are different quantities, connected through efficiency or a performance coefficient rather than treated as identical meter readings. Separate platform and carriage sensible loads instead of substituting total cooling for local comfort. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20394 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.09204 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K. Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20394 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.09204 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通風散熱與設備溫升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 同步量測進出風溫度、流量和耗電，另記濕度與新風比例，確認顯熱邊界一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment. Measure inlet and outlet air temperature, airflow and electricity together, separately recording humidity and outdoor-air fraction to confirm consistent sensible boundaries. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較降低風量與增加設備負載兩種情況，建立溫升敏感度表，再選出能辨別旁通流和真正熱負荷增加的測點。 再以本單元 heat 的對照值重算 air_rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare reduced flow with increased equipment load, tabulate temperature sensitivity, and choose sensors distinguishing bypass flow from a genuine load increase. Also recalculate air_rise for the alternative heat value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：濾網堵塞或風道短路會降低有效冷卻，即使總風機轉速正常；散熱器積塵也可能提高晶片溫度而房間平均值不變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A blocked filter or airflow bypass reduces effective cooling despite normal fan speed; dusty heat sinks can raise chip temperature without changing the room average. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Headway and usable capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 在同一尖峰小時比較編組容量與實際逐車廂載客量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「班距與有效運能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Compare nominal train capacity with actual per-car loading within one peak hour. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Headway and usable capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Headway and usable capacity" is correct?
options: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。
optionsEn: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency.
quiz.explanation: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「班距與有效運能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Headway and usable capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=185.4 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17475.73 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 203.94 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 15887.03 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=185.4 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17475.73 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 203.94 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15887.03 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=185.4 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17475.73 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 203.94 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 15887.03 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=185.4 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17475.73 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 203.94 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15887.03 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「班距與有效運能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Headway and usable capacity", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=185.4 s/train。
量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=185.4 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17475.73 persons/hour。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=185.4 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17475.73 persons/hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距與有效運能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway and usable capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Headway and usable capacity"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.
quiz.explanation: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距與有效運能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway and usable capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在同一尖峰小時比較編組容量與實際逐車廂載客量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare nominal train capacity with actual per-car loading within one peak hour.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。
knowledge.textEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「班距與有效運能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Headway and usable capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail.
quiz.explanation: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 車門交換與停站時間與電流平方損耗與散熱
stages.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time & Current-squared losses and cooling
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車門交換與停站時間」與「電流平方損耗與散熱」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Door exchange and dwell time" and "Current-squared losses and cooling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 把空調門檻造成的停留與上車交換時間分開觀測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Separate hesitation near conditioned entrances from the time required for passenger exchange. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=247 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.86458 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=247 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.86458 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車門交換與停站時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Door exchange and dwell time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車門交換與停站時間
knowledge.text: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。
knowledge.textEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Door exchange and dwell time" is correct?
options: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
用平均電流代入平方損耗公式總能得到正確熱負荷
optionsEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Squaring average current always gives the correct resistive heat load.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門交換與停站時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door exchange and dwell time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=247 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.86458 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 272至 272 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.16667 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車門交換與停站時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Door exchange and dwell time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門交換與停站時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Door exchange and dwell time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把空調門檻造成的停留與上車交換時間分開觀測。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 電流平方損耗與散熱：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Current-squared losses and cooling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電流平方損耗與散熱」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Current-squared losses and cooling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導體與接點的焦耳熱與電流平方成正比，短時高電流可能主導熱循環而平均電流看不出來。散熱取決於環境與接觸表面，電氣損耗量不能直接當成最終溫升。 此式是導體焦耳熱，並不是列車全部耗電。電阻會隨溫度改變，而並聯饋電使電流重新分配；比較兩方案時應保持相同功率交付邊界，避免只移轉損失位置。 分析長供電路徑的電流平方損失與午後輔助負載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電流平方損耗與散熱」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joule heating in conductors and joints scales with current squared, so short current peaks can dominate thermal cycling even when mean current looks moderate. Heat rejection depends on environment and contact surfaces; electrical loss alone is not a final temperature prediction. The expression represents conductor Joule heat, not all train consumption. Resistance changes with temperature, and parallel feeding redistributes current. Compare schemes at the same delivered-power boundary to avoid reporting loss relocation as an actual reduction. Examine current-squared loss on long supply paths together with afternoon auxiliary demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current-squared losses and cooling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1236 A; resistance=0.025 ohm；計算：loss=current*current*resistance/1000=38.1924 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1236 A; resistance=0.025 ohm; calculation: loss=current*current*resistance/1000=38.1924 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「用平均電流代入平方損耗公式總能得到正確熱負荷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Squaring average current always gives the correct resistive heat load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電流平方損耗與散熱」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Joule heating in conductors and joints scales with current squared, so short current peaks can dominate thermal cycling even when mean current looks moderate. Heat rejection depends on environment and contact surfaces; electrical loss alone is not a final temperature prediction.

knowledge.text: 誤解：用平均電流代入平方損耗公式總能得到正確熱負荷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

optionsEn: Squaring average current always gives the correct resistive heat load.
Joule heating in conductors and joints scales with current squared, so short current peaks can dominate thermal cycling even when mean current looks moderate.

steps.title: 電流平方損耗與散熱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Current-squared losses and cooling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電流平方損耗與散熱」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Current-squared losses and cooling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1236 A; resistance=0.025 ohm；計算：loss=current*current*resistance/1000=38.1924 kW。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1359.6 A，其餘固定，結果為 46.2128 kW。模型邊界：恆定電阻且直流或等效均方根電流；不含散熱暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1236 A; resistance=0.025 ohm; calculation: loss=current*current*resistance/1000=38.1924 kW. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1359.6 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 46.2128 kW. Model boundary: Constant resistance with direct or equivalent RMS current; transient cooling is excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以均方根電流而非算術平均電流求熱負荷，同步記錄接頭溫度及環境；停電隔離後才由合格人員檢查接點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use RMS rather than arithmetic-mean current for thermal loading, log joint and ambient temperatures, and restrict physical inspection to qualified staff after isolation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 以均方根電流而非算術平均電流求熱負荷，同步記錄接頭溫度及環境；停電隔離後才由合格人員檢查接點。 由電流時間歷程積分損失，量測導體溫度以校正電阻，並比對兩端功率差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 鬆動接點會增加電阻並使熱量集中；熱像單次讀值偏低也可能只是量測時負載不高，不能否定間歇性過熱。 尖峰電流不能用平均電流取代，否則平方項損失被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「牽引饋線壓降」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction feeder voltage drop” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 檢查兩列列車同時加速時最遠端的受電電壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牽引饋線壓降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Check receiving voltage at the far end when two trains accelerate together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Traction feeder voltage drop” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「再生煞車能量與受電條件」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Regenerative energy and receptivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 以一列煞車和一列加速的時間差研究再生能量接受率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「再生煞車能量與受電條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Study receptivity through the time offset between a braking and an accelerating train. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Regenerative energy and receptivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=247200 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.94792 kWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=247200 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.94792 kWh.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=247200 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.94792 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 271920 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.34271 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
