Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 271920 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.34271 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「再生煞車能量與受電條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Regenerative energy and receptivity"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs.

quiz.explanationEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Regenerative energy and receptivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以一列煞車和一列加速的時間差研究再生能量接受率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Study receptivity through the time offset between a braking and an accelerating train.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「再生煞車能量與受電條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Regenerative energy and receptivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 集水與排水容量與隧道換氣與稀釋時間
stages.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity & Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集水與排水容量」與「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity" and "Tunnel air exchange and dilution time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水與排水容量」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 把短延時暴雨與站口集水量連結，標註泵浦失效情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水與排水容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Link a short intense storm to entrance runoff and mark the failed-pump scenario. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.06e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31518 m^3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.06e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31518 m^3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水與排水容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水與排水容量
knowledge.text: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。
knowledge.textEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水與排水容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity" is correct?
options: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
optionsEn: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水與排水容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.06e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31518 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.266e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.346698 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.06e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31518 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.266e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.346698 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.06e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31518 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.266e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.346698 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.06e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31518 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.266e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.346698 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集水與排水容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity", which statement holds?
options: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.06e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2。
optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
Original hypothetical exercise.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.06e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31518 m^3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水與排水容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。

steps.instruction: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 區分換氣帶走熱量與污染物稀釋所需的不同測點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Distinguish measurement points for heat removal from those for contaminant dilution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.75 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=268.2623 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.75 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=268.2623 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.75 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=268.2623 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 28.325 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 243.8749 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.75 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=268.2623 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.325 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 243.8749 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。
knowledge.textEn: Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：區分換氣帶走熱量與污染物稀釋所需的不同測點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish measurement points for heat removal from those for contaminant dilution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 備援電池與可維持時間與月台暫存與隊列守恆

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Backup battery endurance" and "Platform storage and queue conservation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backup battery endurance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「備援電池與可維持時間」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backup battery endurance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。低溫、老化及啟動電流會縮短可用時間；額定安時也不能直接當成瓦時。 可用電量應扣除允許放電深度與轉換損失，負載也可能隨時間變化。銘牌容量的測試溫度和放電倍率會影響實際結果，續航計算不能取代受控放電驗證。 分開列車牽引與車站緊急負載，核對備援能源邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「備援電池與可維持時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency. Dividing by load gives ideal endurance. Cold temperature, ageing and start-up current can shorten it; an ampere-hour rating must not be mistaken directly for watt-hours. Usable energy must account for permitted discharge depth and conversion losses, while load may vary over time. Test temperature and discharge rate influence rated capacity, so an endurance calculation cannot replace controlled discharge verification. Separate traction from station emergency loads when checking backup-energy boundaries. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup battery endurance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「備援電池與可維持時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backup battery endurance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 備援電池與可維持時間
knowledge.text: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。低溫、老化及啟動電流會縮短可用時間；額定安時也不能直接當成瓦時。
knowledge.textEn: Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency. Dividing by load gives ideal endurance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency.
Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.

quiz.explanation: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backup battery endurance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「備援電池與可維持時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backup battery endurance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.66 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 4.0788 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.66 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4.0788 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.66 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 4.0788 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。

Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.66 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4.0788 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backup battery endurance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「備援電池與可維持時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backup battery endurance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。 以受控負載記錄電池電壓、電流與溫度，積分可用電量，核對低壓切斷時刻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Record battery voltage, current and temperature under controlled load, integrate usable energy, and verify the low-voltage cut-off time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將負載增加一成並把可用容量降為老化假設值，重新計算時間，提出量測端電壓以外必須保留的證據。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 endurance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase load and reduce usable capacity for an ageing case, recalculate endurance, and identify evidence required beyond terminal-voltage readings. Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Record battery voltage, current and temperature under controlled load, integrate usable energy, and verify the low-voltage cut-off time.

knowledge.text: 將負載增加一成並把可用容量降為老化假設值，重新計算時間，提出量測端電壓以外必須保留的證據。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 endurance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。

Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy.

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backup battery endurance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「備援電池與可維持時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backup battery endurance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Normal open-circuit voltage does not prove sufficient capacity; inspect the loaded discharge curve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分開列車牽引與車站緊急負載，核對備援能源邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate traction from station emergency loads when checking backup-energy boundaries.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」如何影響高雄捷運紅線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform storage and queue conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kaohsiung MRT Red Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 將臨時停駛造成的累積人數分配到不同月台區域。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台暫存與隊列守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Distribute passengers accumulated during a temporary suspension across platform zones. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform storage and queue conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Platform storage and queue conservation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。
knowledge.textEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱
optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits.
Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform storage and queue conservation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 477至 477 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.362857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 477, to 477 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.362857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 477至 477 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.362857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。

Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 477, to 477 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.362857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。
knowledge.textEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台暫存與隊列守恆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Platform storage and queue conservation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。
風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing.
Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.
quiz.explanation: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 桃園機場捷運
summary: 以桃園機場捷運的機場、都市及沿線通勤需求為背景，建立快慢車共享走廊的時間表。旅客攜帶行李會同時影響車門交換、垂直移動與安檢服務；課程要求以事件表追蹤延誤傳播，而非只比較行車速度。
summaryEn: Use the Taoyuan airport corridor to build an express and commuter timetable on shared infrastructure. Baggage affects door exchange, vertical circulation and processing queues together. Track disruption propagation through event tables, including passengers arriving from flights, rather than comparing train speeds alone or assuming every passenger moves at the same rate.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 catch_time=1248 s；單元 2 得 equivalent_demand=199.2 equivalent persons；單元 3 得 dwell=25.02083 s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 gap 的擾動測試，結果改為 1372.8 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以桃園機場捷運的機場、都市及沿線通勤需求為背景，建立快慢車共享走廊的時間表。旅客攜帶行李會同時影響車門交換、垂直移動與安檢服務；課程要求以事件表追蹤延誤傳播，而非只比較行車速度。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives catch_time=1248 s; unit 2 gives equivalent_demand=199.2 equivalent persons; unit 3 gives dwell=25.02083 s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing gap in the first unit changes its result to 1372.8 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Taoyuan airport corridor to build an express and commuter timetable on shared infrastructure. Baggage affects door exchange, vertical circulation and processing queues together. Track disruption propagation through event tables, including passengers arriving from flights, rather than comparing train speeds alone or assuming every passenger moves at the same rate. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 快慢車追及與待避與行李旅客與等效交換需求
stages.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up & Luggage and effective passenger exchange
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「快慢車追及與待避」與「行李旅客與等效交換需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fast-slow train catch-up" and "Luggage and effective passenger exchange": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快慢車追及與待避」如何影響桃園機場捷運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast-slow train catch-up” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taoyuan Airport MRT”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 比較快車追上慢車的時刻與可用待避路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快慢車追及與待避」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration. The meeting point is not a permitted safe separation between trains. Catch-up time depends on starting separation and relative speed, not only the faster train’s speed. If either train stops or encounters signalling constraints, use piecewise speed functions and restore route occupation to the event diagram. Compare the time when an express catches a commuter train with available passing routes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fast-slow train catch-up” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快慢車追及與待避」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fast-slow train catch-up”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 快慢車追及與待避
knowledge.text: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。
knowledge.textEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「快慢車追及與待避」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fast-slow train catch-up" is correct?
options: 快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。
機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求
optionsEn: Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed.
Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand.
quiz.explanation: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快慢車追及與待避」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast-slow train catch-up” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13728 m，其餘固定，結果為 1372.8 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13728 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1372.8 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13728 m，其餘固定，結果為 1372.8 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13728 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1372.8 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「快慢車追及與待避」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fast-slow train catch-up", which statement holds?
options: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s。
optionsEn: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「快慢車追及與待避」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fast-slow train catch-up” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 以逐站到發時刻重建距離時間圖，核對起始間隔和各段速度，並標示待避占用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Rebuild a distance-time diagram from station arrivals and departures, verifying initial separation and segment speeds and marking passing occupation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加慢車停站與快車出發延後各一個情境，畫出時空圖，討論待避線能解決的衝突與仍存在的交叉進路限制。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 catch_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a slow-train stop and a delayed fast departure as separate cases, draw time-distance diagrams, and distinguish conflicts solved by a loop from remaining crossing-route restrictions. Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 以逐站到發時刻重建距離時間圖，核對起始間隔和各段速度，並標示待避占用。
knowledge.textEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Rebuild a distance-time diagram from station arrivals and departures, verifying initial separation and segment speeds and marking passing occupation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 增加慢車停站與快車出發延後各一個情境，畫出時空圖，討論待避線能解決的衝突與仍存在的交叉進路限制。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 catch_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Add a slow-train stop and a delayed fast departure as separate cases, draw time-distance diagrams, and distinguish conflicts solved by a loop from remaining crossing-route restrictions. Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「快慢車追及與待避」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fast-slow train catch-up"?
options: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
optionsEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
quiz.explanation: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快慢車追及與待避」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fast-slow train catch-up” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較快車追上慢車的時刻與可用待避路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare the time when an express catches a commuter train with available passing routes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。
knowledge.textEn: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「快慢車追及與待避」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fast-slow train catch-up" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。
機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train.
Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand.
quiz.explanation: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Luggage and effective passenger exchange: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「行李旅客與等效交換需求」如何影響桃園機場捷運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taoyuan Airport MRT”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。 等效需求把攜行李旅客依宣告係數換算為普通旅客負荷，不是把人數真的增加。係數需對應車門交換、通道占用等指定用途，不能拿一個值同時代表所有服務時間。 依門口交換負荷建立攜行李旅客的等效係數，與一般旅客分開計數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「行李旅客與等效交換需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. It must be calibrated from observation rather than stereotypes. Door width, level differences and travelling groups also alter passage time. Equivalent demand converts baggage travellers into ordinary-passenger load using a declared factor; it does not create additional people. The factor must correspond to a specified purpose such as door exchange or space occupation, not represent all service times simultaneously. Define baggage-passenger equivalents for doorway exchange load and count them separately from ordinary passengers. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person；計算：equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「行李旅客與等效交換需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Luggage and effective passenger exchange”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求
knowledge.text: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。係數應由觀察校準而非固定刻板印象；門寬、坡差與同行群體又會改變通過時間。
knowledge.textEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. It must be calibrated from observation rather than stereotypes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「行李旅客與等效交換需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Luggage and effective passenger exchange" is correct?
options: 機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。
optionsEn: Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand.
quiz.explanation: 機場旅客攜帶行李時占用更大空間且上下車較慢，可先以等效旅客係數整理交換需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Passengers with luggage often occupy more space and take longer to board, so an equivalent-passenger factor can organise exchange demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Luggage and effective passenger exchange: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行李旅客與等效交換需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person；計算：equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons。敏感度：luggage 將整數計數增加到 69至 69 persons，其餘固定，結果為 210.4 equivalent persons。模型邊界：線性加權的教學需求指標；不是正式容量標準或特定旅客評分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons. Sensitivity: luggage, increase the integer count to 69, to 69 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 210.4 equivalent persons. Model boundary: Linear teaching demand index; not a formal capacity standard or a rating of individual passengers. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：匿名觀察不同門口的通過時間與行李尺寸群組，保留空間配置差異，避免把環境障礙全歸因於旅客行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe door passage times and luggage-size groups anonymously, retain layout differences, and avoid attributing environmental barriers entirely to passenger behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person；計算：equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons。敏感度：luggage 將整數計數增加到 69至 69 persons，其餘固定，結果為 210.4 equivalent persons。模型邊界：線性加權的教學需求指標；不是正式容量標準或特定旅客評分。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons. Sensitivity: luggage, increase the integer count to 69, to 69 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 210.4 equivalent persons. Model boundary: Linear teaching demand index; not a formal capacity standard or a rating of individual passengers.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「行李旅客與等效交換需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Luggage and effective passenger exchange", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person。
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常

Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: plain=100 persons; luggage=62 persons; factor=1.6 equivalent/person; calculation: equivalent_demand=plain+luggage*factor=199.2 equivalent persons. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Luggage and effective passenger exchange: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「行李旅客與等效交換需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 匿名觀察不同門口的通過時間與行李尺寸群組，保留空間配置差異，避免把環境障礙全歸因於旅客行為。 分別計數一般旅客與行李旅客，以實測交換時間或占用面積校準係數，保留用途與區間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe door passage times and luggage-size groups anonymously, retain layout differences, and avoid attributing environmental barriers entirely to passenger behaviour. Count ordinary and baggage passengers separately, calibrate the factor against exchange time or occupied area, and retain its purpose and range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較集中行李區與分散行李區的等效需求，提出無障礙與一般旅客都可使用的導引方式，並列出需要實測校準的係數。 再以本單元 luggage 的對照值重算 equivalent_demand，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare concentrated and distributed luggage areas, propose guidance usable by passengers with different access needs, and list coefficients requiring measurement-based calibration. Also recalculate equivalent_demand for the alternative luggage value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李集中在少數車門會使全列停站時間由局部控制；同樣人數但不同分布可能造成完全不同的交換效率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage clustering at a few doors can control whole-train dwell; the same passenger total with a different distribution can have very different exchange efficiency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare concentrated and distributed luggage areas, propose guidance usable by passengers with different access needs, and list coefficients requiring measurement-based calibration. Also recalculate equivalent_demand for the alternative luggage value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「行李旅客與等效交換需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Luggage and effective passenger exchange"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
匿名觀察不同門口的通過時間與行李尺寸群組，保留空間配置差異，避免把環境障礙全歸因於旅客行為。
兩組平均班距相同就一定有相同平均等候時間

Observe door passage times and luggage-size groups anonymously, retain layout differences, and avoid attributing environmental barriers entirely to passenger behaviour.

steps.title: 行李旅客與等效交換需求：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「行李旅客與等效交換需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Luggage and effective passenger exchange” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行李集中在少數車門會使全列停站時間由局部控制；同樣人數但不同分布可能造成完全不同的交換效率。 相同人數可能有不同負荷，需保留行李比例而非只報總人數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Equal headcounts can impose different loads; retain baggage proportions rather than reporting total people only.
