steps.title: 軸承故障頻率與轉速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bearing signatures and rotational speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軸承故障頻率與轉速」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滾動軸承幾何決定故障衝擊相對轉速的頻率倍率，教學以已假設倍率乘轉速辨認階次。車速變動時固定頻率譜會展寬，階次追蹤可保留與轉速同步的訊號，但仍需排除輪軌激振。 幾何故障頻率是理想滾動關係，實際滑移會移動頻率或展寬峰值。量測頻譜需和當時轉速一起解讀，不能把固定頻率峰直接指派給某個故障部位。 以軸承頻譜與轉速比對建立狀態監測的頻率基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸承故障頻率與轉速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bearing geometry determines fault-impact orders relative to rotational speed. Multiplying an assumed order by rotation frequency illustrates diagnosis. Variable speed smears fixed-frequency spectra; order tracking retains speed-synchronous signatures but must still distinguish wheel-rail excitation from bearing faults. Geometric defect frequencies assume ideal rolling; slip can shift or broaden peaks. Interpret the measured spectrum together with contemporaneous rotation speed instead of assigning a fixed peak directly to a defect location. Use bearing spectra and rotation speed together to establish condition-monitoring frequency references. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev；計算：signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev; calculation: signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頻譜中出現一個週期峰就一定證明軸承已損壞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One periodic spectral peak necessarily proves that a bearing is damaged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軸承故障頻率與轉速」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bearing signatures and rotational speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Bearing geometry determines fault-impact orders relative to rotational speed. Multiplying an assumed order by rotation frequency illustrates diagnosis.

steps.title: 軸承故障頻率與轉速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bearing signatures and rotational speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軸承故障頻率與轉速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev；計算：signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz。敏感度：rpm 單獨增加百分之十至 693 rev/min，其餘固定，結果為 51.975 Hz。模型邊界：已知故障階次且轉速穩定；不代表某型軸承真實幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rpm=630 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev; calculation: signature=rpm/60*order=47.25 Hz. Sensitivity: rpm, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 693 rev/min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 51.975 Hz. Model boundary: Assumed fault order and steady rotation; not the geometry of a particular bearing type. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測振動與轉速脈波，對比負載改變後的階次峰，並用溫度與潤滑紀錄作獨立佐證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise vibration and tachometer pulses, compare order peaks under changing load, and use temperature and lubrication records as independent corroboration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 軸承故障頻率與轉速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bearing signatures and rotational speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軸承故障頻率與轉速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測振動與轉速脈波，對比負載改變後的階次峰，並用溫度與潤滑紀錄作獨立佐證。 以獨立轉速計核對每段資料，保留頻譜解析度和窗函數，並比較不同轉速的階次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise vibration and tachometer pulses, compare order peaks under changing load, and use temperature and lubrication records as independent corroboration. Verify each data segment with an independent tachometer, retain spectral resolution and window function, and compare orders across rotation speeds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用兩種轉速檢查同一峰是否維持固定階次，再加入輪軌接縫頻率，比較哪些特徵能區分故障來源。 再以本單元 rpm 的對照值重算 signature，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use two speeds to test whether a peak maintains constant order, add a rail-joint excitation frequency, and compare features that distinguish the sources. Also recalculate signature for the alternative rpm value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪扁或軌道接縫也能產生週期衝擊，單一頻譜峰不能唯一定位軸承損傷；速度估計錯誤則會使階次偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wheel flats and track joints also create periodic impacts, so one spectral peak cannot uniquely identify bearing damage; wrong speed estimates shift calculated orders. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

quiz.explanation: 輪扁或軌道接縫也能產生週期衝擊，單一頻譜峰不能唯一定位軸承損傷；速度估計錯誤則會使階次偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Wheel flats and track joints also create periodic impacts, so one spectral peak cannot uniquely identify bearing damage; wrong speed estimates shift calculated orders. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用度與修復時間」如何影響東海道新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokaido Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 將列車故障修復與檢修窗口分開，檢查服務可用性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Separate fault repair from maintenance windows when examining delivered service availability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用度與修復時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Availability and repair time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可用度與修復時間
knowledge.text: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。
knowledge.textEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Availability and repair time" is correct?
options: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
optionsEn: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用度與修復時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Availability and repair time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1386 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971223 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1386 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971223 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1386 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971223 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1386 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971223 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「可用度與修復時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量

Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Availability and repair time"?
options: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
optionsEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
quiz.explanation: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將列車故障修復與檢修窗口分開，檢查服務可用性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate fault repair from maintenance windows when examining delivered service availability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and repair time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 山陽新幹線
summary: 以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。
summaryEn: Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 travel=7.794118 s；單元 2 得 density=0.7914385 kg/m^3；單元 3 得 displacement_flow=190.8 m^3/s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 length 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.573529 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以山陽新幹線的跨區域高速運輸為背景，建立連續隧道、橋梁與車站的假想剖面。學徒把列車進洞壓力、受電品質與排水維修放在同一系統邊界，分析短隧道間露天段是否改變乘坐舒適與維修需求。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives travel=7.794118 s; unit 2 gives density=0.7914385 kg/m^3; unit 3 gives displacement_flow=190.8 m^3/s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing length in the first unit changes its result to 8.573529 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Sanyo high-speed corridor as the setting for an invented profile containing successive tunnels, bridges and stations. Place entry pressure, current collection and drainage maintenance inside one system boundary. Investigate how a short open section between tunnels can alter pressure exposure, track behaviour and access requirements without treating a simplified pressure estimate as a tunnel certification calculation. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞與高海拔壓力與氣體密度
stages.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel & Altitude pressure and air density
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隧道壓力波傳遞」與「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" and "Altitude pressure and air density": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道壓力波傳遞」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道壓力波傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道壓力波傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞
knowledge.text: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。
knowledge.textEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隧道壓力波傳遞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" is correct?
options: 隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。
空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
optionsEn: A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed.
Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道壓力波傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2915 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.573529 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2915 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.573529 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.794118 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2915 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.573529 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2915 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.573529 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「隧道壓力波傳遞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tunnel pressure-wave travel", which statement holds?
options: 速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成

optionsEn: A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
Original hypothetical exercise.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2650 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.794118 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道壓力波傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 在洞口與洞內配置同步壓力測點，對照列車頭部通過時刻，分辨首波與後續反射。
knowledge.textEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Synchronise pressure sensors at the portal and inside the tunnel with nose-passage time, distinguishing the first wave from later reflections.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較壓力波與列車兩種到達時間，加入一次端部反射畫出事件圖，說明單一延遲量無法判斷出口微壓波是否超標。 再以本單元 length 的對照值重算 travel，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare wave and train arrival times, add one end reflection to the event diagram, and explain why travel time alone cannot establish compliance of portal micro-pressure waves. Also recalculate travel for the alternative length value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隧道壓力波傳遞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tunnel pressure-wave travel"?
options: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隧道壓力波傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。
knowledge.textEn: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. A single peak cannot identify the first wave; inspect propagation delay between sensors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隧道壓力波傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tunnel pressure-wave travel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。

steps.instruction: 理想氣體密度由絕對壓力除氣體常數與絕對溫度決定，高海拔低壓會減少同體積空氣所攜帶的質量。這同時影響散熱和氣動力，但車廂供氧與醫療需求不能由密度公式單獨決定。 此理想氣體式以絕對壓力和絕對溫度估算空氣密度，壓力不代表氧氣比例。高原環境的密度可影響氣動和冷卻估算，但人員生理與主動加壓系統需要另外分析。 以隧道內外溫度和絕對壓力估算空氣密度，另列壓力波模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal-gas density is absolute pressure divided by gas constant and absolute temperature. Lower pressure at altitude reduces the mass carried in a fixed air volume, affecting cooling and aerodynamic loads. Cabin oxygen provision and medical needs cannot be determined by density alone. This ideal-gas expression estimates air density from absolute pressure and temperature; pressure is not an oxygen fraction. Altitude-dependent density can affect aerodynamic and cooling estimates, while human physiology and active pressurisation require separate analysis. steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「延遲與制動距離」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delay and braking distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 把隧道內制動後的位置與避難通道的里程分開標示。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「延遲與制動距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Mark the post-braking position and emergency-passage chainage separately inside a tunnel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delay and braking distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m。

knowledge.title: 延遲與制動距離
knowledge.text: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。
knowledge.textEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「延遲與制動距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Delay and braking distance" is correct?
options: 速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。
任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
optionsEn: A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲與制動距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delay and braking distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 81.62 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 4962.496 m。模型邊界：水平直線、定減速、無風；沒有建立黏著分布與煞車熱衰退。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=74.2 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=4118.1 m. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 81.62 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4962.496 m. Model boundary: Level straight track and constant deceleration; adhesion variation and thermal fade are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「延遲與制動距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delay and braking distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。 用獨立里程或地速核對輪速積分，報告濕乾軌差異及停車距離的重複試驗範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Identify command delay separately from steady deceleration and cross-check distance by integrating measured speed. Check integrated wheel speed against independent distance or ground speed, and report wet-dry differences and repeated stopping-distance ranges. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別增加延遲與初速，畫出兩條停車曲線；寫出哪個區段對各參數敏感，以及需要哪些現場資料才可建立保護曲線。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase delay and initial speed separately, plot both stopping curves, identify the sensitive phase, and list the field evidence needed before defining a protection curve. Also recalculate distance for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「延遲與制動距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delay and braking distance"?
options: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。

quiz.explanationEn: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「延遲與制動距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Delay and braking distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 應比較壓力建立與地速下降先後，避免誤判煞車故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把隧道內制動後的位置與避難通道的里程分開標示。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mark the post-braking position and emergency-passage chainage separately inside a tunnel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「延遲與制動距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.

stages.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度與橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度
stages.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration & Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」與「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cant and unbalanced acceleration" and "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 比較洞口附近曲線的平衡速度與低速維修列車工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare curve equilibrium speed near a portal with a slow maintenance-train condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 69.96 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.4388004 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 檢查短橋跨的靜態撓度並指出移動列車動力仍待分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Check static deflection of a short bridge and identify the remaining moving-train dynamic analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm。

quiz.explanationEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 29.15 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.678823 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 29.15 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.678823 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查短橋跨的靜態撓度並指出移動列車動力仍待分析。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check static deflection of a short bridge and identify the remaining moving-train dynamic analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and track kink” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 在路堤、橋台與隧道銜接處設計多點高程剖面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷差與軌道坡折」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Design multipoint elevation profiles across embankment, abutment and tunnel transitions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and track kink” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement and track kink” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013992 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.6996 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013992 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.6996 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013992 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.6996 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential settlement and track kink", which statement holds?
options: 煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m。
optionsEn: A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
Original hypothetical exercise.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and track kink” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
