Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and track kink"?
options: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
optionsEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and track kink” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在路堤、橋台與隧道銜接處設計多點高程剖面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design multipoint elevation profiles across embankment, abutment and tunnel transitions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。
knowledge.textEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉陷差與軌道坡折」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and track kink" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水與排水容量」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 將洞口雨水與隧道滲水分為兩個入流來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水與排水容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Separate portal runoff and tunnel seepage into two inflow sources. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水與排水容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水與排水容量
knowledge.text: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。
knowledge.textEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水與排水容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity" is correct?
options: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質
短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。
optionsEn: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient.
quiz.explanation: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水與排水容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.332e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.356796 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.332e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.356796 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.332e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.356796 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.12e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.32436 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.332e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.356796 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水與排水容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水與排水容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將洞口雨水與隧道滲水分為兩個入流來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate portal runoff and tunnel seepage into two inflow sources.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集水與排水容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause.
quiz.explanation: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 接觸線張力波速與煞車熱量與溫升
stages.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed & Brake heat and temperature rise
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接觸線張力波速」與「煞車熱量與溫升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contact-wire tension wave speed" and "Brake heat and temperature rise": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接觸線張力波速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接觸線張力波速」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact-wire tension wave speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。 線密度決定單位長度的慣性，張力提供恢復作用，因此波速平方與張力成正比。提高張力也改變支承受力；波速裕度只能作篩檢，不能推定接觸力必然均勻。 比較露天和隧道內支承條件改變時的架線動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸線張力波速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it. The ratio to train speed offers a dynamic clue, but multispan suspension, droppers and contact nonlinearity cannot be replaced by a single-string model. Linear density represents inertia per unit length and tension supplies restoring force, so squared wave speed scales with tension. Higher tension also changes support loading. A wave-speed margin is a screening measure, not proof of uniform contact force. Compare contact-line dynamics when support conditions change between open track and tunnel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contact-wire tension wave speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：tension=21200 N; density=1.1 kg/m；計算：wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=138.8262 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: tension=21200 N; density=1.1 kg/m; calculation: wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=138.8262 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接觸線張力波速」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Contact-wire tension wave speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接觸線張力波速
knowledge.text: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。
knowledge.textEn: Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接觸線張力波速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Contact-wire tension wave speed" is correct?
options: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。
只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質
煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
optionsEn: Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire.
Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
quiz.explanation: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接觸線張力波速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Contact-wire tension wave speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接觸線張力波速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contact-wire tension wave speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：tension=21200 N; density=1.1 kg/m；計算：wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=138.8262 m/s。敏感度：tension 單獨增加百分之十至 23320 N，其餘固定，結果為 145.6022 m/s。模型邊界：無彎曲剛度的均勻張弦；不是受流合格判定或允許車速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: tension=21200 N; density=1.1 kg/m; calculation: wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=138.8262 m/s. Sensitivity: tension, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 23320 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 145.6022 m/s. Model boundary: Uniform tensioned string without bending stiffness; not a current-collection acceptance rule or permitted train speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對補償裝置行程、線溫與張力紀錄，再量測受電弓接觸力統計及離線事件，辨別平均值正常但峰值異常。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check compensation travel, wire temperature and tension, then examine contact-force statistics and loss-of-contact events to distinguish acceptable means from abnormal peaks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「煞車熱量與溫升」如何影響山陽新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brake heat and temperature rise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sanyo Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 未回收的動能會在摩擦煞車與阻力路徑中轉成熱，平均溫升由分配到構件的能量除以熱容量決定。短時平均模型無法描述表面熱點、對流冷卻或熱裂紋，需要把能量分配與熱擴散分開。 有效受熱質量可以小於構件總質量，短時接觸表面的熱量也未必已傳到內部。能量平衡應先界定摩擦分配比例，再評估對流、輻射和間歇冷卻是否可忽略。 在連續減速情境下區分單次熱量與尚未散去的殘熱。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「煞車熱量與溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecovered kinetic energy becomes heat through friction brakes and resistance paths. Average temperature rise is allocated energy divided by thermal capacity. A short-duration lumped model cannot describe surface hot spots, cooling or thermal cracks; energy allocation and thermal diffusion are separate questions. The effective heated mass can be smaller than total component mass, and short-duration surface heat may not reach the interior. First define frictional energy allocation, then assess whether convection, radiation and cooling between events can be neglected. Distinguish one braking event’s heat from residual heat during repeated deceleration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Brake heat and temperature rise” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=1.272e+07 J; mass=220 kg; cp=460 J/(kg*K)；計算：rise=energy/(mass*cp)=125.6917 K。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。 在不同深度保留溫度曲線並核對感測器反應時間，用初末能量平衡檢查平均溫升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check temperature rise with thermocouples and infrared measurements, record braking energy, ambient temperature and cooling time, and calibrate infrared emissivity. Retain temperature histories at different depths, verify sensor response time, and use initial-to-final energy balance to check mean temperature rise. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同一能量分給兩種有效熱容量，計算平均溫升後設計能辨認熱點的量測網格，說明集中參數模型缺少哪些資訊。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 rise，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Allocate equal energy to two effective thermal capacities, calculate average rise, and design a measurement grid for hot spots while identifying information missing from the lumped model. Also recalculate rise for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「煞車熱量與溫升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Brake heat and temperature rise"?
options: 以熱電偶與紅外量測交叉檢查溫升，記錄煞車能量、環境溫度與冷卻時間，並校正紅外放射率。

steps.title: 煞車熱量與溫升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Brake heat and temperature rise: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「煞車熱量與溫升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Brake heat and temperature rise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。 若表面與內部溫差很大，集中熱容量假設便不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. A large surface-to-core temperature difference indicates that the lumped thermal-capacity assumption is insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在連續減速情境下區分單次熱量與尚未散去的殘熱。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish one braking event’s heat from residual heat during repeated deceleration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「煞車熱量與溫升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Brake heat and temperature rise" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
局部接觸不均會產生熱點，即使平均溫升不高仍可能形成熱裂紋；錯誤放射率也會掩蓋真實表面溫度。
隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature.
A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.

quiz.explanationEn: Uneven contact can create hot spots and thermal cracks despite a modest mean rise; incorrect emissivity can also conceal the actual surface temperature. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 東北新幹線
summary: 以東北新幹線向日本北部延伸的歷史為背景，設計積雪、低溫與側風並存的教學工況。分析防雪、黏著、道床熱量與輪軌監測之間的取捨，要求每項氣候假設均對應可量測的環境量。
summaryEn: Use the northward development of the Tohoku Shinkansen to frame a teaching scenario combining snow, low temperature and crosswind. Examine tradeoffs among snow management, adhesion, thermal demand and wheel-rail monitoring. Every weather assumption must correspond to a measurable environmental quantity, and a successful single-condition test must be distinguished from validation across a winter operating envelope.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 melt_power=13.36 kW；單元 2 得 traction=162 kN；單元 3 得 moment=67.5 kN*m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 snow 的擾動測試，結果改為 14.696 kW；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以東北新幹線向日本北部延伸的歷史為背景，設計積雪、低溫與側風並存的教學工況。分析防雪、黏著、道床熱量與輪軌監測之間的取捨，要求每項氣候假設均對應可量測的環境量。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives melt_power=13.36 kW; unit 2 gives traction=162 kN; unit 3 gives moment=67.5 kN*m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing snow in the first unit changes its result to 14.696 kW. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the northward development of the Tohoku Shinkansen to frame a teaching scenario combining snow, low temperature and crosswind. Examine tradeoffs among snow management, adhesion, thermal demand and wheel-rail monitoring. Every weather assumption must correspond to a measurable environmental quantity, and a successful single-condition test must be distinguished from validation across a winter operating envelope. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 融雪熱量與補給率與黏著限制與可用牽引力
stages.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate & Adhesion limit and usable traction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「融雪熱量與補給率」與「黏著限制與可用牽引力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Snow-melting heat and supply rate" and "Adhesion limit and usable traction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 融雪熱量與補給率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「融雪熱量與補給率」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把積雪融化需要先加熱到熔點再供應潛熱，若雪已在熔點則主要負荷是融化潛熱。積雪落在轉轍器附近會妨礙動作，融化後排水若再凍結也可能重新形成阻塞。 融雪至少要提供冰融化所需潛熱；若初溫低於冰點，還須先加熱到融點。此式僅算宣告的能量項，不能把理想加熱功率直接當成現場融雪產能。 把待融積雪質量與融雪能源分開量測，保留新雪補入量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「融雪熱量與補給率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Melting snow requires heating it to the melting point and supplying latent heat; snow already at that temperature mainly requires latent heat. Snow near point mechanisms can obstruct movement, while meltwater that refreezes may create another obstruction even after initial melting succeeds. Melting requires latent heat; snow initially below freezing must first be heated to the melting point. This expression includes only declared energy terms, so ideal heater power cannot be equated directly with field snow-removal capacity. Measure snow mass and melting energy separately while recording newly deposited snow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg；計算：melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg; calculation: melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要加熱器表面很熱就表示道岔冰雪問題已解決」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A hot heater surface proves that snow and ice obstruction at the points is resolved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「融雪熱量與補給率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Snow-melting heat and supply rate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 融雪熱量與補給率
knowledge.text: 把積雪融化需要先加熱到熔點再供應潛熱，若雪已在熔點則主要負荷是融化潛熱。積雪落在轉轍器附近會妨礙動作，融化後排水若再凍結也可能重新形成阻塞。
knowledge.textEn: Melting snow requires heating it to the melting point and supplying latent heat; snow already at that temperature mainly requires latent heat. Snow near point mechanisms can obstruct movement, while meltwater that refreezes may create another obstruction even after initial melting succeeds.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要加熱器表面很熱就表示道岔冰雪問題已解決 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A hot heater surface proves that snow and ice obstruction at the points is resolved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「融雪熱量與補給率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Snow-melting heat and supply rate" is correct?
options: 只要加熱器表面很熱就表示道岔冰雪問題已解決
把積雪融化需要先加熱到熔點再供應潛熱，若雪已在熔點則主要負荷是融化潛熱。
電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
optionsEn: A hot heater surface proves that snow and ice obstruction at the points is resolved.
Melting snow requires heating it to the melting point and supplying latent heat; snow already at that temperature mainly requires latent heat.
A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 把積雪融化需要先加熱到熔點再供應潛熱，若雪已在熔點則主要負荷是融化潛熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Melting snow requires heating it to the melting point and supplying latent heat; snow already at that temperature mainly requires latent heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 融雪熱量與補給率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「融雪熱量與補給率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg；計算：melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW。敏感度：snow 單獨增加百分之十至 0.044 kg/s，其餘固定，結果為 14.696 kW。模型邊界：雪初溫為熔點且無環境散熱；僅理論潛熱功率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: snow=0.04 kg/s; latent=334000 J/kg; calculation: melt_power=snow*latent/1000=13.36 kW. Sensitivity: snow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.044 kg/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.696 kW. Model boundary: Snow initially at melting point with no environmental losses; latent-heat power only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測進雪質量、融水流率及加熱電功率，記錄周圍溫度與風速，檢查能量帳和排水是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure snow mass input, meltwater flow and electrical heating power, log ambient temperature and wind, and check consistency of both the energy balance and drainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.title: 融雪熱量與補給率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Snow-melting heat and supply rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「融雪熱量與補給率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測進雪質量、融水流率及加熱電功率，記錄周圍溫度與風速，檢查能量帳和排水是否一致。 先稱量積雪並量測初溫，核對加熱時間與電量，另記融水、散熱及持續降雪。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure snow mass input, meltwater flow and electrical heating power, log ambient temperature and wind, and check consistency of both the energy balance and drainage. Weigh the snow and measure its initial temperature, verify heating time and electricity, and separately record meltwater, heat loss and continuing snowfall. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入初始低於冰點的顯熱與散熱兩項需求，重新列出能量收支，並為排水再凍結設計獨立的觀察點。 再以本單元 snow 的對照值重算 melt_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add sensible heating below freezing and environmental losses to the balance, then design an independent observation point for drainage refreezing. Also recalculate melt_power for the alternative snow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：加熱器正常卻排水結冰時仍可能阻塞道岔；只量加熱器溫度不能確認冰雪已從關鍵間隙移除。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A working heater can coexist with frozen drainage and obstructed points; heater temperature alone does not prove snow has cleared the critical gap. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「融雪熱量與補給率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Snow-melting heat and supply rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 加熱器正常卻排水結冰時仍可能阻塞道岔；只量加熱器溫度不能確認冰雪已從關鍵間隙移除。 新增降雪和散熱未計入時，融雪速度必然偏向理想值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A working heater can coexist with frozen drainage and obstructed points; heater temperature alone does not prove snow has cleared the critical gap. Omitting new snowfall and heat loss biases the melting-rate estimate toward ideal conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A hot heater surface proves that snow and ice obstruction at the points is resolved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion limit and usable traction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。 法向荷重應只取實際驅動接觸點的總量，不能自動使用整列重量。此上限也不描述黏著峰後的滑移控制；若輪重轉移，就要以每個接觸點重新分配。 用濕軌與雪後工況比較可用牽引力，保留輪重分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏著限制與可用牽引力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels. More motor torque does not guarantee more transmitted force; rain, leaves and speed alter contact conditions and limit the accuracy of a fixed coefficient. Normal load must include only the driven contacts, not automatically the weight of the whole train. This bound does not describe slip control beyond the adhesion peak. Wheel-load transfer requires a new allocation across individual contact points. Compare traction bounds on wet and post-snow track while retaining wheel-load distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adhesion limit and usable traction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.18 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=162 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.18 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=162 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.18 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=162 kN。敏感度：mu 單獨增加百分之十至 0.198 1，其餘固定，結果為 178.2 kN。模型邊界：準靜態庫倫上限與均勻輪重；未建模蠕滑曲線及動態減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.18 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=162 kN. Sensitivity: mu, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.198 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 178.2 kN. Model boundary: Quasi-static Coulomb bound with uniform wheel load; creep curves and dynamic unloading are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏著限制與可用牽引力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adhesion limit and usable traction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 以獨立地速校對輪周速度，核實輪徑設定，再按乾濕條件與軸荷分類比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Calibrate wheel-periphery speed against independent ground speed, verify wheel-diameter settings, and compare results by wetness condition and axle load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把黏著係數減半並比較動輪荷重調整，計算牽引上限，解釋為何撒砂或控制策略的效果需用試驗而不能只看馬達功率。 再以本單元 mu 的對照值重算 traction，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve adhesion and compare a change in driven-wheel load, calculate traction bounds, and explain why sanding or control performance requires tests rather than motor-power data alone. Also recalculate traction for the alternative mu value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 先查輪徑與地速誤差，避免把量測偏差當成真滑轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Check diameter and ground-speed errors before interpreting measurement bias as actual wheel slip. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用濕軌與雪後工況比較可用牽引力，保留輪重分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare traction bounds on wet and post-snow track while retaining wheel-load distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

stages.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩與隧道壓力波傳遞
stages.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment & Tunnel pressure-wave travel
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「隧道壓力波傳遞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crosswind force and overturning moment" and "Tunnel pressure-wave travel": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側風力與翻覆力矩」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crosswind force and overturning moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。 橫向力依側風分量平方變化，列車姿態和地形會改變受風面積及係數。此力尺度不直接給出傾覆門檻；還需重心、輪重減載、懸吊和陣風時間歷程。 把側風平均值與陣風峰值分開，檢查兩種量測時間尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側風力與翻覆力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold. Lateral force varies with squared crosswind component, while vehicle attitude and terrain change exposed area and coefficients. The force scale does not directly yield an overturning threshold; centre of gravity, wheel unloading, suspension and gust history remain necessary. Separate mean crosswind and gust peaks and examine their different measurement timescales. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crosswind force and overturning moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=67.5 kN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=67.5 kN*m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側風力與翻覆力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crosswind force and overturning moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩
knowledge.text: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側風力與翻覆力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crosswind force and overturning moment" is correct?
options: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。
側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度
隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
optionsEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment.
Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height.
A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
quiz.explanation: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側風力與翻覆力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crosswind force and overturning moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=67.5 kN*m。敏感度：wind 單獨增加百分之十至 27.5 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 81.675 kN*m。模型邊界：定常橫風與已假設氣動係數；不含陣風、列車運動與動態輪重減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=67.5 kN*m. Sensitivity: wind, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.5 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 81.675 kN*m. Model boundary: Steady crosswind and assumed aerodynamic coefficient; gusts, train motion and dynamic unloading are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=67.5 kN*m。敏感度：wind 單獨增加百分之十至 27.5 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 81.675 kN*m。模型邊界：定常橫風與已假設氣動係數；不含陣風、列車運動與動態輪重減載。

Sensitivity: wind, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.5 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 81.675 kN*m. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。 核對風速計高度與方向，保存陣風時序，將列車姿態與側向加速度放在同一時間軸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations. steps.observation: 現場實務：把風速與作用高度各增加一成，對比力矩敏感度，提出能區分地形加速與儀器誤差的多點量測配置。 再以本單元 wind 的對照值重算 moment，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase wind speed and load height separately by ten percent, compare moment sensitivity, and propose measurements distinguishing terrain acceleration from instrument error. Also recalculate moment for the alternative wind value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sheltered anemometer can understate exposure on a viaduct, and empty versus loaded vehicles have different restoring moments; the nearest sensor alone is insufficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側風力與翻覆力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crosswind force and overturning moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 日平均風速會掩蓋陣風，需檢查量測平均時間與峰值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sheltered anemometer can understate exposure on a viaduct, and empty versus loaded vehicles have different restoring moments; the nearest sensor alone is insufficient. Daily mean wind hides gusts; inspect averaging duration and the recorded peaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把側風平均值與陣風峰值分開，檢查兩種量測時間尺度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate mean crosswind and gust peaks and examine their different measurement timescales.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道壓力波傳遞」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車鼻部入隧道產生壓縮擾動，壓力波以接近音速傳播而不是跟著列車速度前進。入口緩衝設計影響波形上升率，波到達出口的時間與車身到達時間屬不同問題，須分開建立量測觸發。 波傳時間由傳播距離除以聲速決定，與列車走完整段的時間不同。此式只預測到達時序而不預測波幅；洞口形狀、列車頭型和反射決定的壓力變化須用其他流動模型。 在連續隧道與洞口測點之間比較聲波傳播時間和列車通過時間，另列波幅問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道壓力波傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train nose entering a tunnel creates a compression disturbance whose propagation speed is close to acoustic speed rather than train speed. Entrance treatments affect the rise of the waveform. Wave arrival and train arrival are different events and require separate measurement triggers. Wave travel time is propagation distance divided by sound speed, not the time for the train to traverse the section. This expression predicts arrival timing, not amplitude. Portal geometry, train-nose shape and reflections require additional flow models to predict pressure changes. Compare acoustic travel time with train-passage time between tunnel and portal sensors, treating wave amplitude as a separate problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2500 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.352941 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2500 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.352941 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道壓力波傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 隧道壓力波傳遞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tunnel pressure-wave travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道壓力波傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=2500 m; sound=340 m/s；計算：travel=length/sound=7.352941 s。敏感度：length 單獨增加百分之十至 2750 m，其餘固定，結果為 8.088235 s。模型邊界：一維線性聲學且音速均勻；不預測波幅、微壓波峰值或反射耗散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=2500 m; sound=340 m/s; calculation: travel=length/sound=7.352941 s. Sensitivity: length, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2750 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.088235 s. Model boundary: One-dimensional linear acoustics with uniform sound speed; amplitude, micro-pressure-wave peaks and reflection losses are not predicted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在入口與出口配置同步壓力計，用互相關估計傳遞時間，並用溫度估算音速；列車里程觸發另存一條通道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronised pressure sensors at both portals, estimate travel time by cross-correlation and sound speed from temperature, and retain train-position triggering separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tunnel pressure-wave travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間戳誤差會被誤認為波速變化；長隧道的反射波與多車事件也可能讓互相關找到錯誤的峰。 單點峰值不足以判別首波，須檢查測點間傳遞時差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Timestamp error can imitate a wave-speed change, while reflected waves and multiple train events can make cross-correlation select the wrong peak. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 地震偵測提前量與長軌溫升與受限熱應力

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震偵測提前量」與「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic detection lead time" and "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震偵測提前量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic detection lead time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地震偵測提前量」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seismic detection lead time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。距離太近時提前量可能為負，警報並不能讓列車瞬間停止。 此處以相同距離比較兩種波速，屬簡化幾何模型。實際感測站可能不在線路與震源之間；可用時間還包括資料品質檢查及保護命令發送，不能只比較波速。 在警報訊號鏈加入低溫設備延遲，與波到達時間比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震偵測提前量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. A nearby source may leave negative lead time. An alarm therefore cannot make a moving train stop instantaneously, even when the detection itself works correctly. The exercise compares two wave speeds over the same distance and therefore uses simplified geometry. A real sensor may not lie between the source and railway. Available time also includes data-quality checks and protection-command delivery, not only wave propagation. Add cold-equipment delay to the alarm chain and compare it with wave-arrival time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seismic detection lead time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=100000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=9.904762 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: distance=100000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s; calculation: lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=9.904762 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地震偵測提前量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seismic detection lead time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震偵測提前量
knowledge.text: 地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。距離太近時提前量可能為負，警報並不能讓列車瞬間停止。
knowledge.textEn: Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. A nearby source may leave negative lead time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震偵測提前量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seismic detection lead time" is correct?
options: 地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下
完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
地震警報的可用提前量來自較快波到達感測點與較慢強震波到達設施之間的差，再扣掉傳輸和判定延遲。
optionsEn: A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay.

quiz.explanationEn: Usable seismic lead time is the difference between faster-wave detection and slower damaging-wave arrival, less communication and decision delay. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震偵測提前量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seismic detection lead time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地震偵測提前量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seismic detection lead time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=100000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=9.904762 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 110000 m，其餘固定，結果為 11.09524 s。模型邊界：共線源站幾何與固定波速；不預測震度或實際地震動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: distance=100000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s; calculation: lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=9.904762 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 110000 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 11.09524 s. Model boundary: Collinear source-station geometry and constant wave speeds; neither intensity nor actual ground motion is predicted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：distance=100000 m; vp=6000 m/s; vs=3500 m/s; latency=2 s；計算：lead=distance/vs-distance/vp-latency=9.904762 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 110000 m，其餘固定，結果為 11.09524 s。模型邊界：共線源站幾何與固定波速；不預測震度或實際地震動。

Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 110000 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 11.09524 s. Model boundary: Collinear source-station geometry and constant wave speeds; neither intensity nor actual ground motion is predicted.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 地震偵測提前量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seismic detection lead time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地震偵測提前量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seismic detection lead time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。 以完整訊號重播核對每個時間戳，將總延遲分解成判定、網路與列車端處理。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution. Use full-chain signal replay to verify every timestamp and separate total delay into decision, network and train-side processing components. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將震源距離縮短並把通訊延遲加倍，計算剩餘提前量；與制動時間比較，提出只在模型範圍內成立的結論。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 lead，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shorten source distance and double communication delay, calculate remaining lead time, and compare it with braking time without extending the conclusion beyond the model. Also recalculate lead for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗證感測器觸發而不驗證下游通訊，可能高估提前量；設備共用電源也可能讓兩條名義獨立通道同時失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing the sensor without downstream communication overestimates lead time; a shared power supply can also defeat nominally independent channels simultaneously. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用歷史或合成波形重播整條訊號鏈，記錄偵測、判定、通訊及列車接收時間，量出漏警、誤警和延遲分布。 以完整訊號重播核對每個時間戳，將總延遲分解成判定、網路與列車端處理。
knowledge.textEn: Replay historical or synthetic waveforms through the complete chain, log detection, decision, communication and train receipt times, and measure missed alarms, false alarms and latency distribution. Use full-chain signal replay to verify every timestamp and separate total delay into decision, network and train-side processing components.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

steps.title: 地震偵測提前量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seismic detection lead time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地震偵測提前量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seismic detection lead time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗證感測器觸發而不驗證下游通訊，可能高估提前量；設備共用電源也可能讓兩條名義獨立通道同時失效。 感測成功不等於制動成功，須查列車收到命令後的動作。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing the sensor without downstream communication overestimates lead time; a shared power supply can also defeat nominally independent channels simultaneously. Successful detection is not successful braking; inspect the train response after command receipt. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
