steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。 溫差應相對於鋼軌實際無應力狀態，而非任意室溫。完全拘束估算給出軸向應力尺度；當扣件滑移或軌道彎曲出現時，需要位移相容和側向穩定分析。 檢查寒冬鋼軌降溫時應力方向與夏季熱壓縮的差別。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature. Fastener slip and lateral track resistance additionally govern stability, beyond the one-dimensional thermal-stress estimate. Temperature change must reference the rail’s actual stress-free state, not an arbitrary room temperature. Full restraint gives an axial stress scale. Fastener slip or track curvature requires displacement compatibility and lateral stability analysis beyond this expression. Examine the stress sign during winter cooling and contrast it with summer compression. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=72.45 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=72.45 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=72.45 MPa。敏感度：deltaT 單獨增加百分之十至 33 K，其餘固定，結果為 79.695 MPa。模型邊界：完全軸向拘束與線彈性；不計挫曲、初彎、殘留應力及塑性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=30 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=72.45 MPa. Sensitivity: deltaT, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 33 K, with all other inputs fixed, gives 79.695 MPa. Model boundary: Full axial restraint and linear elasticity; buckling, initial curvature, residual stress and plasticity are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。 以鋼軌接觸式溫度計校驗遙測值，核對應變零點，並保留日夜循環的升降溫路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出自由、部分拘束與完全拘束三種邊界，重算熱變形或應力，標明哪些輸入必須由鋼軌溫度及扣件試驗取得。 再以本單元 deltaT 的對照值重算 compression，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw free, partial and full restraint boundaries, recalculate expansion or stress, and identify inputs requiring rail-temperature measurements and fastener tests. Also recalculate compression for the alternative deltaT value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查寒冬鋼軌降溫時應力方向與夏季熱壓縮的差別。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Examine the stress sign during winter cooling and contrast it with summer compression.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率
optionsEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed.
quiz.explanation: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 空間波長與量測取樣與軸承故障頻率與轉速
stages.titleEn: Spatial wavelength and sampling & Bearing signatures and rotational speed
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「空間波長與量測取樣」與「軸承故障頻率與轉速」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spatial wavelength and sampling" and "Bearing signatures and rotational speed": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 空間波長與量測取樣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spatial wavelength and sampling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空間波長與量測取樣」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spatial wavelength and sampling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。要避免混疊，取樣率需高於訊號頻寬兩倍並搭配抗混疊濾波；提高取樣率本身不能修正輪滑造成的里程誤差。 取樣頻率超過訊號最高頻率兩倍是重建的必要起點，仍需要抗混疊濾波及足夠振幅精度。尖峰與非平穩事件的要求不同，應從量測目的回推頻寬與記錄長度。 用列車通過雪害監測點的訊號決定所需取樣頻率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空間波長與量測取樣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. Avoiding aliasing requires a sampling rate above twice the signal bandwidth and an antialias filter. A higher sample rate alone cannot correct distance errors caused by wheel slip. Sampling above twice the highest signal frequency is a starting condition for reconstruction, but anti-alias filtering and amplitude accuracy remain necessary. Peaks and nonstationary events have different needs; derive bandwidth and recording duration from the measurement objective. Use passage signals at a snow-monitoring point to determine the required sampling frequency. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spatial wavelength and sampling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=50 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=50 samples/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=50 m/s; wavelength=2 m; calculation: nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=50 samples/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空間波長與量測取樣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spatial wavelength and sampling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空間波長與量測取樣
knowledge.text: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。要避免混疊，取樣率需高於訊號頻寬兩倍並搭配抗混疊濾波；提高取樣率本身不能修正輪滑造成的里程誤差。
knowledge.textEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. Avoiding aliasing requires a sampling rate above twice the signal bandwidth and an antialias filter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空間波長與量測取樣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spatial wavelength and sampling" is correct?
options: 量測車速度提高時仍可永遠沿用原本取樣率
移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。
頻譜中出現一個週期峰就一定證明軸承已損壞
optionsEn: The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed.
A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength.
One periodic spectral peak necessarily proves that a bearing is damaged.
quiz.explanation: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空間波長與量測取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spatial wavelength and sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空間波長與量測取樣」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spatial wavelength and sampling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=50 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=50 samples/s。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 55 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 55 samples/s。模型邊界：單一最短波長的理想Nyquist下界；實務需留濾波與取樣裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=50 m/s; wavelength=2 m; calculation: nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=50 samples/s. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 55 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 55 samples/s. Model boundary: Ideal Nyquist lower bound for one shortest wavelength; practical filters and sampling need additional margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知波長的校驗訊號檢查量測鏈，對照獨立里程基準，並在不同車速下比較空間頻譜是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the chain with a known-wavelength reference, compare an independent distance datum, and inspect whether spatial spectra agree at different vehicle speeds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=50 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=50 samples/s。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 55 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 55 samples/s。模型邊界：單一最短波長的理想Nyquist下界；實務需留濾波與取樣裕度。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=50 m/s; wavelength=2 m; calculation: nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=50 samples/s. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 55 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 55 samples/s. Model boundary: Ideal Nyquist lower bound for one shortest wavelength; practical filters and sampling need additional margin.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「空間波長與量測取樣」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Original hypothetical exercise.

steps.title: 空間波長與量測取樣：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spatial wavelength and sampling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空間波長與量測取樣」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spatial wavelength and sampling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用已知波長的校驗訊號檢查量測鏈，對照獨立里程基準，並在不同車速下比較空間頻譜是否一致。 用已知頻率訊號測試整條量測鏈，檢查抗混疊濾波器、時鐘誤差與遺漏樣本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the chain with a known-wavelength reference, compare an independent distance datum, and inspect whether spatial spectra agree at different vehicle speeds. Test the complete measurement chain with a known-frequency signal, checking anti-alias filtering, clock error and missing samples. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把速度提高一成並把最短波長減半，計算取樣率需求，繪出混疊示意後提出抗混疊濾波的頻寬要求。 再以本單元 speed 的對照值重算 nyquist_lower_bound，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed by ten percent and halve the shortest wavelength, calculate sampling needs, illustrate aliasing, and specify the required antialias-filter bandwidth. Also recalculate nyquist_lower_bound for the alternative speed value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不足取樣會把短波缺陷偽裝成長波，里程跳動又會改變重採樣位置；兩者需分別診斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Undersampling disguises short-wave defects as long waves, while distance jumps alter resampling positions; the two mechanisms require separate diagnosis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Also recalculate nyquist_lower_bound for the alternative speed value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spatial wavelength and sampling"?

steps.instruction: 滾動軸承幾何決定故障衝擊相對轉速的頻率倍率，教學以已假設倍率乘轉速辨認階次。車速變動時固定頻率譜會展寬，階次追蹤可保留與轉速同步的訊號，但仍需排除輪軌激振。 幾何故障頻率是理想滾動關係，實際滑移會移動頻率或展寬峰值。量測頻譜需和當時轉速一起解讀，不能把固定頻率峰直接指派給某個故障部位。 把低溫黏度與軸承頻率特徵分開，避免直接由振幅推論損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸承故障頻率與轉速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bearing geometry determines fault-impact orders relative to rotational speed. Multiplying an assumed order by rotation frequency illustrates diagnosis. Variable speed smears fixed-frequency spectra; order tracking retains speed-synchronous signatures but must still distinguish wheel-rail excitation from bearing faults. Geometric defect frequencies assume ideal rolling; slip can shift or broaden peaks. Interpret the measured spectrum together with contemporaneous rotation speed instead of assigning a fixed peak directly to a defect location. Separate low-temperature lubrication effects from bearing frequency features instead of inferring damage from amplitude alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rpm=600 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev; calculation: signature=rpm/60*order=45 Hz.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rpm=600 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev；計算：signature=rpm/60*order=45 Hz。敏感度：rpm 單獨增加百分之十至 660 rev/min，其餘固定，結果為 49.5 Hz。模型邊界：已知故障階次且轉速穩定；不代表某型軸承真實幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rpm=600 rev/min; order=4.5 cycles/rev; calculation: signature=rpm/60*order=45 Hz. Sensitivity: rpm, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 660 rev/min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 49.5 Hz. Model boundary: Assumed fault order and steady rotation; not the geometry of a particular bearing type. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測振動與轉速脈波，對比負載改變後的階次峰，並用溫度與潤滑紀錄作獨立佐證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise vibration and tachometer pulses, compare order peaks under changing load, and use temperature and lubrication records as independent corroboration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bearing signatures and rotational speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測振動與轉速脈波，對比負載改變後的階次峰，並用溫度與潤滑紀錄作獨立佐證。 以獨立轉速計核對每段資料，保留頻譜解析度和窗函數，並比較不同轉速的階次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise vibration and tachometer pulses, compare order peaks under changing load, and use temperature and lubrication records as independent corroboration. steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪扁或軌道接縫也能產生週期衝擊，單一頻譜峰不能唯一定位軸承損傷；速度估計錯誤則會使階次偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wheel flats and track joints also create periodic impacts, so one spectral peak cannot uniquely identify bearing damage; wrong speed estimates shift calculated orders. quiz.explanation: 輪扁或軌道接縫也能產生週期衝擊，單一頻譜峰不能唯一定位軸承損傷；速度估計錯誤則會使階次偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Wheel flats and track joints also create periodic impacts, so one spectral peak cannot uniquely identify bearing damage; wrong speed estimates shift calculated orders. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 延遲與制動距離與濾網壓差與通風功率
stages.titleEn: Delay and braking distance & Filter pressure drop and fan power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「延遲與制動距離」與「濾網壓差與通風功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Delay and braking distance" and "Filter pressure drop and fan power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「延遲與制動距離」如何影響東北新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delay and braking distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tohoku Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 對降雪後低黏著情境重新估算制動距離的保守界限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「延遲與制動距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Re-estimate a conservative braking-distance bound for reduced adhesion after snowfall. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delay and braking distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=70 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3675 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=70 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3675 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「延遲與制動距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Delay and braking distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲與制動距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delay and braking distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=70 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3675 m。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 77 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 4427.5 m。模型邊界：水平直線、定減速、無風；沒有建立黏著分布與煞車熱衰退。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=70 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3675 m. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 77 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4427.5 m. Model boundary: Level straight track and constant deceleration; adhesion variation and thermal fade are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「延遲與制動距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delay and braking distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。 用獨立里程或地速核對輪速積分，報告濕乾軌差異及停車距離的重複試驗範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Identify command delay separately from steady deceleration and cross-check distance by integrating measured speed. Check integrated wheel speed against independent distance or ground speed, and report wet-dry differences and repeated stopping-distance ranges. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別增加延遲與初速，畫出兩條停車曲線；寫出哪個區段對各參數敏感，以及需要哪些現場資料才可建立保護曲線。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase delay and initial speed separately, plot both stopping curves, identify the sensitive phase, and list the field evidence needed before defining a protection curve. Also recalculate distance for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「延遲與制動距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instructionEn: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. steps.instruction: 風機必須克服風道與濾網壓差才能輸送空氣，輸入功率近似為壓差乘體積流率再除效率。積塵提高阻力但工作點會沿風機曲線改變，因此固定風量假設只是一種受控比較。 風機功率等於壓力差乘體積流率再除以宣告效率，壓力與流量必須使用同一工作點。積塵使阻力和風機工作點共同改變，固定流量算例不能預測未控制風量時的耗電。 比較進氣濾材積雪前後壓差，檢查量測是否受風量改變干擾。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾網壓差與通風功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fan must overcome duct and filter pressure losses to move air. Input power is approximately pressure rise times volume flow divided by efficiency. Dust raises resistance but shifts the operating point on the fan curve, so fixed flow is only a controlled comparison. Fan power equals pressure difference times volume flow divided by the declared efficiency. Pressure and flow must refer to one operating point. Dust changes resistance and the fan operating point together, so a fixed-flow example cannot predict consumption without airflow control. Compare intake-filter pressure drop before and after snow accumulation and control for airflow changes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter pressure drop and fan power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾網壓差與通風功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter pressure drop and fan power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=350 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1458.333 W。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 385 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 1604.167 W。模型邊界：固定風量與總效率；不包含風機曲線移動和馬達熱限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=350 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1458.333 W. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 385 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1604.167 W. Model boundary: Fixed flow and overall efficiency; fan-curve shifts and motor thermal limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾網壓差與通風功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter pressure drop and fan power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。 校正取壓點與風量計，同步量測電功率，核對效率是否包含馬達與驅動器損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing. Calibrate pressure taps and airflow measurement, record electric power simultaneously, and check whether efficiency includes motor and drive losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對堵塞與旁路兩個情境列出壓差、風量和粒子濃度的預期方向，設計三項量測共同判斷而非只靠單一數字。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 fan_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Predict pressure drop, airflow and particle concentration for clogging and bypass scenarios, then design a three-measurement diagnosis instead of relying on one number. Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濾網壓差與通風功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

title: 九州新幹線
summary: 以九州新幹線分期連接的歷史為背景，建立坡道、橋梁與城市車站交替的教學路線。學徒要比較爬坡功率和下坡制動的能量流向，並在地震、短時暴雨與設備停機時安排可驗證的降級營運。
summaryEn: Use the staged connection of the Kyushu Shinkansen to construct a teaching route alternating gradients, bridges and urban stops. Compare energy flow during climbing and downhill braking. Define verifiable degraded operation under an earthquake warning, short intense rainfall and equipment downtime, rather than treating rated traction power as evidence that every disrupted movement remains feasible.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 climbing=2377.944 kW；單元 2 得 traction=163.62 kN；單元 3 得 recovered=13.67708 kWh。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 mass 的擾動測試，結果改為 2615.738 kW；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以九州新幹線分期連接的歷史為背景，建立坡道、橋梁與城市車站交替的教學路線。學徒要比較爬坡功率和下坡制動的能量流向，並在地震、短時暴雨與設備停機時安排可驗證的降級營運。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives climbing=2377.944 kW; unit 2 gives traction=163.62 kN; unit 3 gives recovered=13.67708 kWh. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing mass in the first unit changes its result to 2615.738 kW. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the staged connection of the Kyushu Shinkansen to construct a teaching route alternating gradients, bridges and urban stops. Compare energy flow during climbing and downhill braking. Define verifiable degraded operation under an earthquake warning, short intense rainfall and equipment downtime, rather than treating rated traction power as evidence that every disrupted movement remains feasible. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率與黏著限制與可用牽引力
stages.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power & Adhesion limit and usable traction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」與「黏著限制與可用牽引力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gradient resistance and climbing power" and "Adhesion limit and usable traction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gradient resistance and climbing power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。 坡度以升高量除以水平距離表示，百分比與小數不可混用。此項只表示重力位能增加的速率，總牽引功率還要加上加速、滾動、氣動及轉換損失。 在同一坡道比較滿載與輕載的重力功率需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient. Multiplication by speed gives power, making faster climbing more demanding at equal force; descending requires continuous energy management rather than merely one stopping event. Gradient is rise divided by horizontal distance, so percentage and decimal representations must not be mixed. This term only gives the rate of gravitational potential-energy increase. Total traction demand also includes acceleration, rolling resistance, aerodynamics and conversion losses. Compare gravitational power demand for loaded and lightly loaded trains on one gradient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gradient resistance and climbing power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gradient resistance and climbing power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率
knowledge.text: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gradient resistance and climbing power" is correct?
options: 長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。
電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
optionsEn: One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
Climbing raises gravitational potential energy.
A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gradient resistance and climbing power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 333300 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2615.738 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 333300 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2615.738 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 333300 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2615.738 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 333300 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2615.738 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gradient resistance and climbing power", which statement holds?
options: 煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s。
optionsEn: A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gradient resistance and climbing power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gradient resistance and climbing power"?
options: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gradient resistance and climbing power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在同一坡道比較滿載與輕載的重力功率需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare gravitational power demand for loaded and lightly loaded trains on one gradient.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gradient resistance and climbing power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。
電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating.
A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion limit and usable traction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。 法向荷重應只取實際驅動接觸點的總量，不能自動使用整列重量。此上限也不描述黏著峰後的滑移控制；若輪重轉移，就要以每個接觸點重新分配。 檢查坡道起步時動輪荷重和接觸狀態能否傳遞要求牽引力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏著限制與可用牽引力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels. More motor torque does not guarantee more transmitted force; rain, leaves and speed alter contact conditions and limit the accuracy of a fixed coefficient. Normal load must include only the driven contacts, not automatically the weight of the whole train. This bound does not describe slip control beyond the adhesion peak. Wheel-load transfer requires a new allocation across individual contact points. Check whether driven-wheel load and contact condition can transmit the requested force during a gradient start. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adhesion limit and usable traction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adhesion limit and usable traction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力
knowledge.text: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。
knowledge.textEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「黏著限制與可用牽引力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Adhesion limit and usable traction" is correct?
options: 電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。
optionsEn: A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Traction reaches the track through contact patches.
quiz.explanation: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。敏感度：mu 單獨增加百分之十至 0.19998 1，其餘固定，結果為 179.982 kN。模型邊界：準靜態庫倫上限與均勻輪重；未建模蠕滑曲線及動態減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN. Sensitivity: mu, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.19998 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 179.982 kN. Model boundary: Quasi-static Coulomb bound with uniform wheel load; creep curves and dynamic unloading are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。敏感度：mu 單獨增加百分之十至 0.19998 1，其餘固定，結果為 179.982 kN。模型邊界：準靜態庫倫上限與均勻輪重；未建模蠕滑曲線及動態減載。

Sensitivity: mu, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.19998 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 179.982 kN. Model boundary: Quasi-static Coulomb bound with uniform wheel load; creep curves and dynamic unloading are not modelled.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏著限制與可用牽引力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adhesion limit and usable traction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 以獨立地速校對輪周速度，核實輪徑設定，再按乾濕條件與軸荷分類比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Calibrate wheel-periphery speed against independent ground speed, verify wheel-diameter settings, and compare results by wetness condition and axle load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把黏著係數減半並比較動輪荷重調整，計算牽引上限，解釋為何撒砂或控制策略的效果需用試驗而不能只看馬達功率。 再以本單元 mu 的對照值重算 traction，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve adhesion and compare a change in driven-wheel load, calculate traction bounds, and explain why sanding or control performance requires tests rather than motor-power data alone. Also recalculate traction for the alternative mu value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 以獨立地速校對輪周速度，核實輪徑設定，再按乾濕條件與軸荷分類比對。
knowledge.textEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Calibrate wheel-periphery speed against independent ground speed, verify wheel-diameter settings, and compare results by wetness condition and axle load.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把黏著係數減半並比較動輪荷重調整，計算牽引上限，解釋為何撒砂或控制策略的效果需用試驗而不能只看馬達功率。 再以本單元 mu 的對照值重算 traction，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Halve adhesion and compare a change in driven-wheel load, calculate traction bounds, and explain why sanding or control performance requires tests rather than motor-power data alone. Also recalculate traction for the alternative mu value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「黏著限制與可用牽引力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Adhesion limit and usable traction"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。
量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
quiz.explanation: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 先查輪徑與地速誤差，避免把量測偏差當成真滑轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Check diameter and ground-speed errors before interpreting measurement bias as actual wheel slip. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查坡道起步時動輪荷重和接觸狀態能否傳遞要求牽引力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check whether driven-wheel load and contact condition can transmit the requested force during a gradient start.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 先查輪徑與地速誤差，避免把量測偏差當成真滑轉。
knowledge.textEn: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Check diameter and ground-speed errors before interpreting measurement bias as actual wheel slip.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「黏著限制與可用牽引力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Adhesion limit and usable traction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction.
quiz.explanation: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.instruction: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 把下坡能量回送與電網可接受時段對齊，另列剩餘摩擦熱。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「再生煞車能量與受電條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Align downhill regenerative export with receptive intervals and separately record remaining friction heat. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Regenerative energy and receptivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Regenerative energy and receptivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=242400 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.67708 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 266640 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.04479 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=242400 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.67708 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 266640 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.04479 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「再生煞車能量與受電條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Regenerative energy and receptivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
