title: 法國東歐高速鐵路
summary: 以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。
summaryEn: Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 stale_distance=7.725 m；單元 2 得 sigma=1.799212 m；單元 3 得 transition=2768.008 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 latency 的擾動測試，結果改為 8.4975 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以法國東歐高速鐵路兩階段建設為背景，建立新舊路段銜接、模式轉換和供電邊界的教學案例。學徒必須以訊號有效期、定位誤差及速度曲線共同驗證列車如何通過介面，並區分通訊可用與安全授權有效。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives stale_distance=7.725 m; unit 2 gives sigma=1.799212 m; unit 3 gives transition=2768.008 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing latency in the first unit changes its result to 8.4975 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the two construction phases of LGV Est europeenne to frame a teaching case involving old-new route connections, mode transitions and supply boundaries. Verify passage through interfaces using authority validity, position error and speed curves together. Distinguish available communication from a valid movement authority, and require explicit evidence for each transition condition in the operational sequence. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量與里程融合與不確定度
stages.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position & Position fusion and uncertainty
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」與「里程融合與不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Communication delay and stale position" and "Position fusion and uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Communication delay and stale position” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 在模式轉換前後分別檢查封包年齡與授權到期時刻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Check packet age and authority expiry separately before and after a mode transition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Communication delay and stale position” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Communication delay and stale position”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量
knowledge.text: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。
knowledge.textEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Communication delay and stale position" is correct?
options: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。
兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差
optionsEn: A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
A moving train advances while a message is in transit.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
quiz.explanation: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Communication delay and stale position” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3399 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.4975 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3399 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.4975 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3399 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.4975 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3399 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.4975 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Communication delay and stale position", which statement holds?
options: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s。
optionsEn: Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Communication delay and stale position” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。
knowledge.textEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Communication delay and stale position"?
options: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
optionsEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Communication delay and stale position” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在模式轉換前後分別檢查封包年齡與授權到期時刻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check packet age and authority expiry separately before and after a mode transition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Communication delay and stale position" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。
兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.

quiz.explanationEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「里程融合與不確定度」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position fusion and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 將定位的不確定區間帶入路段邊界，檢查前端位置定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「里程融合與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Carry position uncertainty into the section boundary and verify the train-front reference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position fusion and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.12 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.799212 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.12 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.799212 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「里程融合與不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「里程融合與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position fusion and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.12 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.799212 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.532 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.829748 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.12 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.799212 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.532 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.829748 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.532 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.829748 m. knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「里程融合與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Position fusion and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。

Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「里程融合與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Position fusion and uncertainty"?

quiz.explanationEn: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「里程融合與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Position fusion and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將定位的不確定區間帶入路段邊界，檢查前端位置定義。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「里程融合與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Position fusion and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval.
quiz.explanation: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.instruction: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 連結目標速度限制和定位誤差，檢查保護距離是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度限制轉換與預告距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Connect target-speed restrictions and position error when checking protective distance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 79.31 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 3607.751 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=72.1 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2768.008 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 79.31 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3607.751 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度限制轉換與預告距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「速度限制轉換與預告距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Speed-limit transition and warning distance"?

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：連結目標速度限制和定位誤差，檢查保護距離是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 為新舊線交會設計進路互斥邏輯與故障狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Design route exclusion logic and fault states for the junction between new and old lines. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互斥進路與真值驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification"?
options: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
optionsEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.

quiz.explanationEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「互斥進路與真值驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：為新舊線交會設計進路互斥邏輯與故障狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design route exclusion logic and fault states for the junction between new and old lines.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「互斥進路與真值驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。
無電區長度改變不會影響列車離開時的速度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states.
Changing the length of an unpowered section cannot change exit speed.
quiz.explanation: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 無電區惰行與速度損失與接觸線張力波速
stages.titleEn: Coasting through an unpowered section & Contact-wire tension wave speed
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無電區惰行與速度損失」與「接觸線張力波速」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Coasting through an unpowered section" and "Contact-wire tension wave speed": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無電區惰行與速度損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Coasting through an unpowered section: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無電區惰行與速度損失」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coasting through an unpowered section” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車通過無電區時需依靠動能克服阻力，簡化恆阻力模型把阻力做功從初始動能扣除。區段長度、初速與坡度決定剩餘速度，供電切換邏輯和防誤合閘仍需獨立驗證。 無牽引不等於無運動，列車以動能克服所宣告的阻力。若距離超過此阻力下的可滑行距離，平方根將無實數解，表示通過情境不成立而非計算器錯誤。 在供電邊界比較不同入口速度下的滑行通過時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無電區惰行與速度損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train coasting through an unpowered section uses kinetic energy to overcome resistance. A constant-resistance model subtracts work from initial kinetic energy. Length, entry speed and gradient determine remaining speed, while switching logic and prevention of inappropriate re-energisation require separate verification. No traction does not mean no motion: kinetic energy overcomes the declared resistance. If the section exceeds the available coasting distance, the square root has no real solution, indicating an infeasible passage case rather than a calculator malfunction. Compare coasting passage time across a supply boundary for different entry speeds. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coasting through an unpowered section” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=50 m/s; force=15450 N; length=500 m; mass=250000 kg；計算：exit_speed=(v*v-2*force*length/mass)**0.5=49.37813 m/s。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact-wire tension wave speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受電弓擾動會沿接觸線傳播，張力提高使橫波速度上升而線密度增加使波速下降。波速與列車速度的比值提供動態風險線索，但多跨懸掛、吊弦和接觸非線性不能由單根弦模型取代。 線密度決定單位長度的慣性，張力提供恢復作用，因此波速平方與張力成正比。提高張力也改變支承受力；波速裕度只能作篩檢，不能推定接觸力必然均勻。 檢查高速段架線波速與支承變化對受電的限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸線張力波速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pantograph disturbances propagate along the contact wire. Greater tension raises transverse wave speed, whereas greater mass per length lowers it. The ratio to train speed offers a dynamic clue, but multispan suspension, droppers and contact nonlinearity cannot be replaced by a single-string model. Linear density represents inertia per unit length and tension supplies restoring force, so squared wave speed scales with tension. Higher tension also changes support loading. A wave-speed margin is a screening measure, not proof of uniform contact force. Inspect contact-wire wave speed and support changes as limits on high-speed collection. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：tension=20600 N; density=1.1 kg/m；計算：wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=136.8476 m/s。敏感度：tension 單獨增加百分之十至 22660 N，其餘固定，結果為 143.527 m/s。模型邊界：無彎曲剛度的均勻張弦；不是受流合格判定或允許車速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: tension=20600 N; density=1.1 kg/m; calculation: wave_speed=(tension/density)**0.5=136.8476 m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 核對補償裝置行程、線溫與張力紀錄，再量測受電弓接觸力統計及離線事件，辨別平均值正常但峰值異常。 核對接觸線張力、單位長度質量及量測位置，並用接觸力和離線事件檢查動態品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：補償裝置卡滯會讓溫度變化改變張力，吊弦鬆弛又會改變局部動態剛度；只讀取靜態高度難以辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「側風力與翻覆力矩」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crosswind force and overturning moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。 橫向力依側風分量平方變化，列車姿態和地形會改變受風面積及係數。此力尺度不直接給出傾覆門檻；還需重心、輪重減載、懸吊和陣風時間歷程。 將開闊地段側風方向分解為列車橫向作用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側風力與翻覆力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold. Lateral force varies with squared crosswind component, while vehicle attitude and terrain change exposed area and coefficients. The force scale does not directly yield an overturning threshold; centre of gravity, wheel unloading, suspension and gust history remain necessary. Resolve open-country wind direction into the component acting across the train. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crosswind force and overturning moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m。敏感度：wind 單獨增加百分之十至 28.325 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 86.64901 kN*m。模型邊界：定常橫風與已假設氣動係數；不含陣風、列車運動與動態輪重減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=25.75 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=71.61075 kN*m. Sensitivity: wind, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.325 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 86.64901 kN*m. Model boundary: Steady crosswind and assumed aerodynamic coefficient; gusts, train motion and dynamic unloading are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。 核對風速計高度與方向，保存陣風時序，將列車姿態與側向加速度放在同一時間軸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations. Verify anemometer height and orientation, retain gust histories, and align vehicle attitude with lateral acceleration on one timeline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把風速與作用高度各增加一成，對比力矩敏感度，提出能區分地形加速與儀器誤差的多點量測配置。 再以本單元 wind 的對照值重算 moment，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase wind speed and load height separately by ten percent, compare moment sensitivity, and propose measurements distinguishing terrain acceleration from instrument error. Also recalculate moment for the alternative wind value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sheltered anemometer can understate exposure on a viaduct, and empty versus loaded vehicles have different restoring moments; the nearest sensor alone is insufficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic drag and traction power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空氣阻力與牽引功率」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。有效阻力面積包含外形與附屬物影響；會車、隧道及側風會使定常自由場模型失效。 阻力是速度平方關係，而牽引功率還要乘一次速度。把逆風納入時應使用相對空氣速度；滾動阻力與坡度功率是另外的能量途徑，不能被此氣動項取代。 比較高速與降速工況的氣動功率，說明降速的能源效果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空氣阻力與牽引功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aerodynamic drag scales with speed squared, and the power needed to overcome it adds another speed factor. Effective drag area includes shape and attachments. Passing trains, tunnels and crosswinds can invalidate the steady open-air approximation even when the nominal speed remains unchanged. Drag varies with squared speed, while traction power introduces another speed factor. Headwind requires relative air speed. Rolling resistance and gradient power are separate energy paths and cannot be replaced by this aerodynamic term. Compare aerodynamic power in fast and restricted operation to explain the energy effect of reduced speed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aerodynamic drag and traction power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.1 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2248.832 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.1 m/s; calculation: power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2248.832 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空氣阻力與牽引功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。 同步紀錄風向風速與地速，將穩速段牽引功率扣除可辨識的坡度和輔助負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance. Record wind vector and ground speed together, then remove identifiable gradient and auxiliary loads from steady-running traction power. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 空間波長與量測取樣：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「空間波長與量測取樣」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spatial wavelength and sampling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “LGV Est europeenne”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。要避免混疊，取樣率需高於訊號頻寬兩倍並搭配抗混疊濾波；提高取樣率本身不能修正輪滑造成的里程誤差。 取樣頻率超過訊號最高頻率兩倍是重建的必要起點，仍需要抗混疊濾波及足夠振幅精度。尖峰與非平穩事件的要求不同，應從量測目的回推頻寬與記錄長度。 以模式切換事件時間寬度檢查記錄器的取樣需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空間波長與量測取樣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. Avoiding aliasing requires a sampling rate above twice the signal bandwidth and an antialias filter. A higher sample rate alone cannot correct distance errors caused by wheel slip. Sampling above twice the highest signal frequency is a starting condition for reconstruction, but anti-alias filtering and amplitude accuracy remain necessary. Peaks and nonstationary events have different needs; derive bandwidth and recording duration from the measurement objective. Use mode-transition event duration to check recorder sampling requirements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spatial wavelength and sampling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=51.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=51.5 samples/s。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The original sampling rate remains sufficient at every increased inspection speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 不足取樣會把短波缺陷偽裝成長波，里程跳動又會改變重採樣位置；兩者需分別診斷。 降低取樣率後出現新低頻峰值，應先查混疊而非機械故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「並聯備援與共同原因」如何影響法國東歐高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 辨認通訊與電源共因，避免把兩個設備當作完全獨立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「並聯備援與共同原因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Identify shared communication and power causes instead of assuming two devices are independent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel redundancy and common cause” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 依「並聯備援與共同原因」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Parallel redundancy and common cause", which statement holds?
options: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
無電區長度改變不會影響列車離開時的速度
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0206 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000618 1。

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「並聯備援與共同原因」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel redundancy and common cause” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
