stages.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證與重複荷載與線性損傷帳
stages.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification & Repeated loading and linear damage account
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「互斥進路與真值驗證」與「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" and "Repeated loading and linear damage account": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響馬德里—塞維亞高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Madrid–Seville high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 在新舊控制邊界注入不一致狀態，檢查進路是否保持禁止。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Inject inconsistent states at an old-new control boundary and check that the route remains prohibited. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「互斥進路與真值驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互斥進路與真值驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 7 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 128 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「互斥進路與真值驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在新舊控制邊界注入不一致狀態，檢查進路是否保持禁止。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inject inconsistent states at an old-new control boundary and check that the route remains prohibited.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」如何影響馬德里—塞維亞高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeated loading and linear damage account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Madrid–Seville high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。此帳務能比較荷載譜，卻忽略順序效應、腐蝕與裂紋成長，損傷和為一不是對任何構件的通用失效保證。 線性累積損傷不保留載重順序，也不能自行描述腐蝕、裂紋閉合和超載效應。疲勞曲線的適用材料與應力定義必須一致，否則算出的壽命比例沒有可比性。 對更新後構件區分已累積循環和新設備的起算點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count. Linear accumulation sums the fraction of life consumed at each level. This accounting compares load spectra but omits sequence effects, corrosion and crack growth; a sum of one is not a universal failure guarantee for every component. Linear cumulative damage does not retain load order and cannot independently describe corrosion, crack closure or overload effects. The fatigue curve must match the material and stress definition; otherwise calculated life fractions are not comparable. Distinguish accumulated cycles in retained components from the starting point of new equipment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated loading and linear damage account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=210000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.41 1。

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=210000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.41 1。敏感度：n1 將整數計數增加到 231001至 231001 cycles，其餘固定，結果為 0.431001 1。模型邊界：兩級循環的Miner帳務且壽命輸入已假設；不外推真實剩餘壽命。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Sensitivity: n1, increase the integer count to 231001, to 231001 cycles, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.431001 1. Model boundary: Two-level Miner accounting with assumed life values; no real residual-life prediction is made. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=210000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.41 1。敏感度：n1 將整數計數增加到 231001至 231001 cycles，其餘固定，結果為 0.431001 1。模型邊界：兩級循環的Miner帳務且壽命輸入已假設；不外推真實剩餘壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: n1=210000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles; calculation: damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.41 1. Sensitivity: n1, increase the integer count to 231001, to 231001 cycles, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.431001 1. Model boundary: Two-level Miner accounting with assumed life values; no real residual-life prediction is made.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeated loading and linear damage account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。 從原始應變檢查應力換算與循環計數，核對各級距的次數總和及疲勞曲線來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves. Check stress conversion and cycle counting from raw strain, verifying total counts across bins and the source of the fatigue curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持總循環數不變，將部分低應力循環移到高應力級，重算損傷帳並說明需要何種檢測來支持剩餘壽命判讀。 再以本單元 n1 的對照值重算 damage_index，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep total cycles fixed while moving some cycles to the higher-stress level, recalculate damage, and identify inspections needed to support any remaining-life interpretation. Also recalculate damage_index for the alternative n1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏記少量大應力循環可能比漏記大量小循環更嚴重；焊趾局部應力也不能直接由遠處名義應變代表。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves. Check stress conversion and cycle counting from raw strain, verifying total counts across bins and the source of the fatigue curve.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持總循環數不變，將部分低應力循環移到高應力級，重算損傷帳並說明需要何種檢測來支持剩餘壽命判讀。 再以本單元 n1 的對照值重算 damage_index，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Keep total cycles fixed while moving some cycles to the higher-stress level, recalculate damage, and identify inspections needed to support any remaining-life interpretation. Also recalculate damage_index for the alternative n1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.

steps.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated loading and linear damage account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複荷載與線性損傷帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated loading and linear damage account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏記少量大應力循環可能比漏記大量小循環更嚴重；焊趾局部應力也不能直接由遠處名義應變代表。 若應力級距漏計，累積損傷偏低不能證明構件仍完好。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress. Understated damage caused by omitted stress bins is not evidence that the component remains sound. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對更新後構件區分已累積循環和新設備的起算點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish accumulated cycles in retained components from the starting point of new equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏記少量大應力循環可能比漏記大量小循環更嚴重；焊趾局部應力也不能直接由遠處名義應變代表。 若應力級距漏計，累積損傷偏低不能證明構件仍完好。
knowledge.textEn: Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress. Understated damage caused by omitted stress bins is not evidence that the component remains sound.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

stages.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量與可用度與修復時間
stages.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work & Availability and repair time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工窗口與可完成工作量」與「可用度與修復時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Possession window and achievable work" and "Availability and repair time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工窗口與可完成工作量」如何影響馬德里—塞維亞高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Possession window and achievable work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Madrid–Seville high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。 可施工時間等於總窗口扣掉保護設置、測試及還路等必要活動。這些活動可能有不可重疊的安全依賴；趕工不能直接刪除，應以資源和先後順序改變排程。 把夜間施工窗口拆成保護、作業、檢查與還路時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工窗口與可完成工作量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path. Coordination of dependencies may matter more than nominal production speed. Usable work time equals the possession window minus protection, testing and handback activities. These can have nonoverlapping safety dependencies and cannot simply be deleted to accelerate work. Change scheduling through resources and legitimate task order. Split an overnight possession into protection, work, inspection and handback time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Possession window and achievable work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=47.25 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=551 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=47.25 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=551 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Possession window and achievable work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量
knowledge.text: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。
knowledge.textEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工窗口與可完成工作量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Possession window and achievable work" is correct?
options: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。

optionsEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins.

High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
quiz.explanation: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Possession window and achievable work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=47.25 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=551 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 51.975 min，其餘固定，結果為 532.1 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=47.25 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=551 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 51.975 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 532.1 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=47.25 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=551 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 51.975 min，其餘固定，結果為 532.1 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Possession window and achievable work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Possession window and achievable work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用度與修復時間」如何影響馬德里—塞維亞高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Madrid–Seville high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 把計畫性停機與非預期故障分列，避免混用可用性口徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Separate planned outages from unexpected faults rather than mixing availability definitions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用度與修復時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Availability and repair time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1386 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971223 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1260 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968354 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1386 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971223 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Availability and repair time"?
options: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把計畫性停機與非預期故障分列，避免混用可用性口徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate planned outages from unexpected faults rather than mixing availability definitions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and repair time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。
完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable.
A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 北京—上海高速鐵路
summary: 以北京至上海高速鐵路為背景，建立長距離橋梁、路基與多城市車站組成的教學網路。重點是把局部沉陷和橋梁撓度與高速車輛反應聯繫，同時檢查多站停靠造成的班表差異、風險監測與修復後的服務恢復。
summaryEn: Use Beijing–Shanghai high-speed rail to construct a teaching network of bridges, earthworks and stations in several cities. Relate local settlement and bridge deflection to vehicle response at speed. At the same time, inspect differing stopping patterns, environmental monitoring and service restoration after repair, distinguishing an average network metric from a critical local defect.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 deflection=1.146659 mm；單元 2 得 gradient=0.636 mm/m；單元 3 得 frequency=1.338745 Hz。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 L 的擾動測試，結果改為 1.678823 mm；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以北京至上海高速鐵路為背景，建立長距離橋梁、路基與多城市車站組成的教學網路。重點是把局部沉陷和橋梁撓度與高速車輛反應聯繫，同時檢查多站停靠造成的班表差異、風險監測與修復後的服務恢復。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives deflection=1.146659 mm; unit 2 gives gradient=0.636 mm/m; unit 3 gives frequency=1.338745 Hz. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing L in the first unit changes its result to 1.678823 mm. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Beijing–Shanghai high-speed rail to construct a teaching network of bridges, earthworks and stations in several cities. Relate local settlement and bridge deflection to vehicle response at speed. At the same time, inspect differing stopping patterns, environmental monitoring and service restoration after repair, distinguishing an average network metric from a critical local defect. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度與沉陷差與軌道坡折
stages.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity & Differential settlement and track kink
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」與「沉陷差與軌道坡折」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" and "Differential settlement and track kink": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」如何影響北京—上海高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 以跨中和支點同步位移辨識高架橋靜態剛度而非單點位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Identify viaduct static stiffness through simultaneous midspan and support displacement rather than one reading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度
knowledge.text: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。
knowledge.textEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" is correct?
options: 橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 29.15 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.678823 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 29.15 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.678823 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.instruction: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」如何影響北京—上海高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and track kink” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 對橋路過渡區畫出多點沉陷槽，檢查短基長坡折。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷差與軌道坡折」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Plot a multipoint settlement trough at a bridge-earthwork transition and inspect short-baseline kinks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and track kink” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013992 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.6996 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and track kink” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and track kink” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對橋路過渡區畫出多點沉陷槽，檢查短基長坡折。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Plot a multipoint settlement trough at a bridge-earthwork transition and inspect short-baseline kinks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。
knowledge.textEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉陷差與軌道坡折」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
量到固有頻率不變就能證明阻尼器沒有劣化

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An unchanged natural frequency proves that the damper has not deteriorated.
A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact.

quiz.explanationEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振與曲線超高與未平衡加速度
stages.titleEn: Suspension frequency and excitation & Cant and unbalanced acceleration
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸吊固有頻率與激振」與「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Suspension frequency and excitation" and "Cant and unbalanced acceleration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Suspension frequency and excitation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「懸吊固有頻率與激振」如何影響北京—上海高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspension frequency and excitation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 彈簧與質量的組合決定垂向固有頻率，增加質量降低頻率而提高剛度使頻率升高。軌道不平順被車速轉換成時間激振；因此相同軌道波長在不同速度下可能接近或遠離共振。 固有頻率和振幅不是同一資訊，阻尼主要影響峰值和衰減。空車與滿載質量不同時，軌道某一波長可能落在不同激振頻率比，應同時考慮速度與載重。 把軌道變形波長轉成列車所見激振頻率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「懸吊固有頻率與激振」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spring stiffness and supported mass determine vertical natural frequency. Added mass lowers frequency, while increased stiffness raises it. Train speed converts spatial track irregularity into temporal excitation, so the same wavelength may approach or leave resonance as speed changes. Natural frequency and amplitude contain different information; damping primarily affects peaks and decay. Empty and loaded masses can place one track wavelength at different excitation-frequency ratios. Speed and loading therefore need to be considered together. Convert track-deformation wavelength into the excitation frequency experienced by a moving train. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Suspension frequency and excitation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：k=900000 N/m; mass=12720 kg；計算：frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.338745 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: k=900000 N/m; mass=12720 kg; calculation: frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.338745 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到固有頻率不變就能證明阻尼器沒有劣化」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An unchanged natural frequency proves that the damper has not deteriorated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「懸吊固有頻率與激振」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Suspension frequency and excitation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振
knowledge.text: 彈簧與質量的組合決定垂向固有頻率，增加質量降低頻率而提高剛度使頻率升高。軌道不平順被車速轉換成時間激振；因此相同軌道波長在不同速度下可能接近或遠離共振。
knowledge.textEn: Spring stiffness and supported mass determine vertical natural frequency. Added mass lowers frequency, while increased stiffness raises it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到固有頻率不變就能證明阻尼器沒有劣化 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An unchanged natural frequency proves that the damper has not deteriorated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸吊固有頻率與激振」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Suspension frequency and excitation" is correct?
options: 彈簧與質量的組合決定垂向固有頻率，增加質量降低頻率而提高剛度使頻率升高。
量到固有頻率不變就能證明阻尼器沒有劣化
任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
optionsEn: Spring stiffness and supported mass determine vertical natural frequency.
An unchanged natural frequency proves that the damper has not deteriorated.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 彈簧與質量的組合決定垂向固有頻率，增加質量降低頻率而提高剛度使頻率升高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Spring stiffness and supported mass determine vertical natural frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Suspension frequency and excitation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸吊固有頻率與激振」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suspension frequency and excitation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：k=900000 N/m; mass=12720 kg；計算：frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.338745 Hz。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 13992 kg，其餘固定，結果為 1.276443 Hz。模型邊界：單自由度無阻尼模型；不含俯仰、側滾與輪軌接觸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: k=900000 N/m; mass=12720 kg; calculation: frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.338745 Hz. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13992 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.276443 Hz. Model boundary: Undamped single-degree-of-freedom model; pitch, roll and wheel-rail contact are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測已知質量下的自由衰減與頻率響應，對照不同載客狀態；同步記錄軌道波長和速度，避免混淆激振頻率與固有頻率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure free decay and frequency response at known mass, repeat for different passenger loading, and log track wavelength and speed to distinguish excitation from natural frequency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：k=900000 N/m; mass=12720 kg；計算：frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.338745 Hz。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 13992 kg，其餘固定，結果為 1.276443 Hz。模型邊界：單自由度無阻尼模型；不含俯仰、側滾與輪軌接觸。

Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13992 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.276443 Hz. steps.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Suspension frequency and excitation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測已知質量下的自由衰減與頻率響應，對照不同載客狀態；同步記錄軌道波長和速度，避免混淆激振頻率與固有頻率。 由自由衰減同時辨識頻率及衰減率，檢查感測器是否位於同一振型的有效位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure free decay and frequency response at known mass, repeat for different passenger loading, and log track wavelength and speed to distinguish excitation from natural frequency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較空車與滿載頻率，計算一個指定波長對應的激振速度，並列出阻尼與行程限制對判斷的影響。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 frequency，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare empty and loaded frequencies, calculate the speed corresponding to one irregularity wavelength, and explain the influence of damping and suspension travel limits. Also recalculate frequency for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只調剛度追求低頻隔振可能增加行程需求；阻尼器失效可能保持固有頻率近似不變，卻大幅增加共振振幅。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Softening springs for low-frequency isolation increases travel demand; a failed damper may barely change natural frequency while greatly increasing resonant amplitude. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Suspension frequency and excitation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「懸吊固有頻率與激振」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Suspension frequency and excitation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只調剛度追求低頻隔振可能增加行程需求；阻尼器失效可能保持固有頻率近似不變，卻大幅增加共振振幅。 需量測衰減率，不能以峰值頻率不變排除阻尼故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Softening springs for low-frequency isolation increases travel demand; a failed damper may barely change natural frequency while greatly increasing resonant amplitude. Measure decay rate; an unchanged peak frequency cannot exclude a damping fault. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把軌道變形波長轉成列車所見激振頻率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Convert track-deformation wavelength into the excitation frequency experienced by a moving train.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量到固有頻率不變就能證明阻尼器沒有劣化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An unchanged natural frequency proves that the damper has not deteriorated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只調剛度追求低頻隔振可能增加行程需求；阻尼器失效可能保持固有頻率近似不變，卻大幅增加共振振幅。 需量測衰減率，不能以峰值頻率不變排除阻尼故障。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」如何影響北京—上海高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 比較不同速度等級服務通過同一曲線時的超高需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare cant demand when services of different speed classes pass through one curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cant and unbalanced acceleration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度
knowledge.text: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。
knowledge.textEn: On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cant and unbalanced acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲線超高與未平衡加速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cant and unbalanced acceleration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 69.96 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.4388004 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69.96 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.4388004 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

stages.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩與快慢車追及與待避

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「側風力與翻覆力矩」與「快慢車追及與待避」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crosswind force and overturning moment" and "Fast-slow train catch-up": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crosswind force and overturning moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側風力與翻覆力矩」如何影響北京—上海高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crosswind force and overturning moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。 橫向力依側風分量平方變化，列車姿態和地形會改變受風面積及係數。此力尺度不直接給出傾覆門檻；還需重心、輪重減載、懸吊和陣風時間歷程。 在高架開闊段使用陣風而非日平均風速檢查側向力尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側風力與翻覆力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold. Lateral force varies with squared crosswind component, while vehicle attitude and terrain change exposed area and coefficients. The force scale does not directly yield an overturning threshold; centre of gravity, wheel unloading, suspension and gust history remain necessary. Use gusts rather than daily mean wind to inspect the lateral-force scale on an exposed viaduct. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crosswind force and overturning moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=26.5 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=75.843 kN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=26.5 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=75.843 kN*m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側風力與翻覆力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crosswind force and overturning moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩
knowledge.text: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側風力與翻覆力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crosswind force and overturning moment" is correct?
options: 側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度
