steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將鋼軌熱應力與路基凍土熱狀態分為不同物理問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treat rail thermal stress and the thermal condition of permafrost as distinct physical problems.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。
兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading.
Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差與高海拔壓力與氣體密度
stages.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals & Altitude pressure and air density
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與獨立量測殘差」與「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Survey control and independent residuals" and "Altitude pressure and air density": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「控制網與獨立量測殘差」如何影響青藏鐵路凍土地段的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey control and independent residuals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinghai–Tibet Railway permafrost sections”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。共同基點錯誤會同時影響兩套結果，控制網需要閉合檢查及外部基準才能發現系統偏差。 兩座標差的歐氏長度表示平面殘差大小，不是隨機標準差。先把兩套座標轉到相同基準和單位，再檢查各方向偏差；共同平移可能讓相對殘差很小但絕對位置仍錯。 用穩定外部基點檢查長期高程趨勢，避免基點同時移動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制網與獨立量測殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. A shared control-point error affects both results. Network closure and an external datum are needed to reveal systematic bias that agreement alone can conceal. The Euclidean length of two coordinate differences measures planar residual, not random standard deviation. Transform both coordinate sets to one datum and unit before inspecting directional differences. Common translation can leave a small relative residual while absolute position remains wrong. Check long-term elevation trends against a stable external datum rather than a moving local reference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Survey control and independent residuals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.00303 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.018057 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.00303 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.018057 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「控制網與獨立量測殘差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Survey control and independent residuals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差
knowledge.text: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。共同基點錯誤會同時影響兩套結果，控制網需要閉合檢查及外部基準才能發現系統偏差。
knowledge.textEn: The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. A shared control-point error affects both results.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與獨立量測殘差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey control and independent residuals" is correct?
options: 兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確
空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同
兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。
optionsEn: Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy.
Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude.
The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制網與獨立量測殘差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Survey control and independent residuals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.00303 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.018057 mm。敏感度：dx 單獨增加百分之十至 0.003333 m，其餘固定，結果為 5.20662 mm。模型邊界：平面兩分量殘差；不含座標轉換協方差和垂直誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.00303 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.018057 mm. Sensitivity: dx, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.003333 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5.20662 mm. Model boundary: Planar two-component residual; transformation covariance and vertical error are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.00303 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.018057 mm。敏感度：dx 單獨增加百分之十至 0.003333 m，其餘固定，結果為 5.20662 mm。模型邊界：平面兩分量殘差；不含座標轉換協方差和垂直誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.00303 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.018057 mm. Sensitivity: dx, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.003333 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5.20662 mm. Model boundary: Planar two-component residual; transformation covariance and vertical error are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與獨立量測殘差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Survey control and independent residuals", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.00303 m; dy=0.004 m。
電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低

A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.00303 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.018057 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey control and independent residuals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「控制網與獨立量測殘差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Survey control and independent residuals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。 以反向觀測、閉合路線和外部基準交叉檢核，分開報告平面殘差與可疑共同偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias. Cross-check reversed observations, closed loops and external references, reporting planar residual separately from suspected shared bias. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入一個共同平移偏差，檢查兩儀器殘差與外部基準差異，提出能辨識系統誤差的控制網配置。 再以本單元 dx 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a shared translation bias, compare inter-instrument residual with error to an external datum, and propose a control network that can reveal systematic error. Also recalculate residual for the alternative dx value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Altitude pressure and air density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinghai–Tibet Railway permafrost sections”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想氣體密度由絕對壓力除氣體常數與絕對溫度決定，高海拔低壓會減少同體積空氣所攜帶的質量。這同時影響散熱和氣動力，但車廂供氧與醫療需求不能由密度公式單獨決定。 此理想氣體式以絕對壓力和絕對溫度估算空氣密度，壓力不代表氧氣比例。高原環境的密度可影響氣動和冷卻估算，但人員生理與主動加壓系統需要另外分析。 以高原絕對氣壓與溫度計算空氣密度，另列含氧與生理議題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal-gas density is absolute pressure divided by gas constant and absolute temperature. Lower pressure at altitude reduces the mass carried in a fixed air volume, affecting cooling and aerodynamic loads. Cabin oxygen provision and medical needs cannot be determined by density alone. This ideal-gas expression estimates air density from absolute pressure and temperature; pressure is not an oxygen fraction. Altitude-dependent density can affect aerodynamic and cooling estimates, while human physiology and active pressurisation require separate analysis. Calculate air density from altitude pressure and temperature, separately identifying oxygen and physiological questions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Altitude pressure and air density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=60600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K；計算：density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7541065 kg/m^3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=60600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K; calculation: density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7541065 kg/m^3.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=60600 Pa; Rair=287 J/(kg*K); temperature=280 K；計算：density=pressure/(Rair*temperature)=0.7541065 kg/m^3。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 66660 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 0.8295172 kg/m^3。模型邊界：乾空氣理想氣體、均勻壓溫；不計濕度與生理反應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 高海拔壓力與氣體密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Altitude pressure and air density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高海拔壓力與氣體密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Altitude pressure and air density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把攝氏溫度直接代入氣體公式會產生巨大誤差；低密度時沿用海平面風量又可能不足以移除同一熱負載。 若使用攝氏溫度直接作分母，空氣密度會失去正確物理意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using Celsius directly in the gas equation creates a large error; at low density, sea-level volume flow may not remove the same heat load. Using Celsius temperature directly in the denominator produces a physically incorrect air density. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以高原絕對氣壓與溫度計算空氣密度，另列含氧與生理議題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Calculate air density from altitude pressure and temperature, separately identifying oxygen and physiological questions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空氣體積流率相同就表示任何海拔的散熱質量流率相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal volumetric airflow guarantees equal cooling mass flow at every altitude." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率與黏著限制與可用牽引力
stages.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power & Adhesion limit and usable traction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」與「黏著限制與可用牽引力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gradient resistance and climbing power" and "Adhesion limit and usable traction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」如何影響青藏鐵路凍土地段的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gradient resistance and climbing power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinghai–Tibet Railway permafrost sections”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。 坡度以升高量除以水平距離表示，百分比與小數不可混用。此項只表示重力位能增加的速率，總牽引功率還要加上加速、滾動、氣動及轉換損失。 比較高原坡道的重力功率與額外阻力，不把海拔當成坡度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient. Multiplication by speed gives power, making faster climbing more demanding at equal force; descending requires continuous energy management rather than merely one stopping event. Gradient is rise divided by horizontal distance, so percentage and decimal representations must not be mixed. This term only gives the rate of gravitational potential-energy increase. Total traction demand also includes acceleration, rolling resistance, aerodynamics and conversion losses. Compare gradient power with other resistance at altitude without treating elevation itself as gradient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gradient resistance and climbing power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gradient resistance and climbing power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率
knowledge.text: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gradient resistance and climbing power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 333300 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2615.738 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 333300 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2615.738 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gradient resistance and climbing power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」如何影響青藏鐵路凍土地段的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion limit and usable traction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinghai–Tibet Railway permafrost sections”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。 法向荷重應只取實際驅動接觸點的總量，不能自動使用整列重量。此上限也不描述黏著峰後的滑移控制；若輪重轉移，就要以每個接觸點重新分配。 在凍結或融水條件下比較黏著上限，保留試驗範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏著限制與可用牽引力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels. More motor torque does not guarantee more transmitted force; rain, leaves and speed alter contact conditions and limit the accuracy of a fixed coefficient. Normal load must include only the driven contacts, not automatically the weight of the whole train. This bound does not describe slip control beyond the adhesion peak. Wheel-load transfer requires a new allocation across individual contact points. Compare adhesion bounds under freezing or meltwater conditions while retaining the experimental range. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adhesion limit and usable traction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adhesion limit and usable traction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。敏感度：mu 單獨增加百分之十至 0.19998 1，其餘固定，結果為 179.982 kN。模型邊界：準靜態庫倫上限與均勻輪重；未建模蠕滑曲線及動態減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN. Sensitivity: mu, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.19998 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 179.982 kN. Model boundary: Quasi-static Coulomb bound with uniform wheel load; creep curves and dynamic unloading are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏著限制與可用牽引力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adhesion limit and usable traction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 以獨立地速校對輪周速度，核實輪徑設定，再按乾濕條件與軸荷分類比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Calibrate wheel-periphery speed against independent ground speed, verify wheel-diameter settings, and compare results by wetness condition and axle load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把黏著係數減半並比較動輪荷重調整，計算牽引上限，解釋為何撒砂或控制策略的效果需用試驗而不能只看馬達功率。 再以本單元 mu 的對照值重算 traction，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve adhesion and compare a change in driven-wheel load, calculate traction bounds, and explain why sanding or control performance requires tests rather than motor-power data alone. Also recalculate traction for the alternative mu value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spatial wavelength and sampling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinghai–Tibet Railway permafrost sections”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 移動量測車把軌道空間波長轉成時間頻率，速度除波長得到激振頻率。要避免混疊，取樣率需高於訊號頻寬兩倍並搭配抗混疊濾波；提高取樣率本身不能修正輪滑造成的里程誤差。 取樣頻率超過訊號最高頻率兩倍是重建的必要起點，仍需要抗混疊濾波及足夠振幅精度。尖峰與非平穩事件的要求不同，應從量測目的回推頻寬與記錄長度。 選擇足以分辨日夜熱循環與列車振動的不同取樣頻率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空間波長與量測取樣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving inspection vehicle converts track wavelength into temporal frequency through speed divided by wavelength. Avoiding aliasing requires a sampling rate above twice the signal bandwidth and an antialias filter. A higher sample rate alone cannot correct distance errors caused by wheel slip. Sampling above twice the highest signal frequency is a starting condition for reconstruction, but anti-alias filtering and amplitude accuracy remain necessary. Peaks and nonstationary events have different needs; derive bandwidth and recording duration from the measurement objective. Choose different sampling rates for daily thermal cycles and train-induced vibration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spatial wavelength and sampling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 空間波長與量測取樣：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spatial wavelength and sampling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=50.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m；計算：nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=50.5 samples/s。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 55.55 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 55.55 samples/s。模型邊界：單一最短波長的理想Nyquist下界；實務需留濾波與取樣裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=50.5 m/s; wavelength=2 m; calculation: nyquist_lower_bound=2*speed/wavelength=50.5 samples/s. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 55.55 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 55.55 samples/s. Model boundary: Ideal Nyquist lower bound for one shortest wavelength; practical filters and sampling need additional margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知波長的校驗訊號檢查量測鏈，對照獨立里程基準，並在不同車速下比較空間頻譜是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the chain with a known-wavelength reference, compare an independent distance datum, and inspect whether spatial spectra agree at different vehicle speeds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.explanation: 不足取樣會把短波缺陷偽裝成長波，里程跳動又會改變重採樣位置；兩者需分別診斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Undersampling disguises short-wave defects as long waves, while distance jumps alter resampling positions; the two mechanisms require separate diagnosis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用度與修復時間」如何影響青藏鐵路凍土地段的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinghai–Tibet Railway permafrost sections”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 把遠距維修交通時間與實際修復工時分開記錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Record travel time for remote maintenance separately from the hands-on repair duration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用度與修復時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Availability and repair time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用度與修復時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Availability and repair time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1333.2 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970087 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1212 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967105 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1333.2 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970087 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1333.2 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970087 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把遠距維修交通時間與實際修復工時分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Record travel time for remote maintenance separately from the hands-on repair duration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

計算出的凍土融化厚度必定等於路基沉陷量

Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable.

title: 首爾—釜山高速鐵路
summary: 以京釜高速鐵路及韓國高速列車演進為背景，建立不同車輛世代共用走廊的教學時刻表。課程比較牽引、制動、懸吊與受電特性改變後的介面需求，要求以共同量測基準評估車輛更新，而非只比較額定最高速度。
summaryEn: Use the Gyeongbu corridor and Korean high-speed train development to construct a teaching timetable shared by different vehicle generations. Compare interface demands after changes in traction, braking, suspension and current collection. Evaluate renewal using common measurement references, rather than only rated top speed, and track whether differences in dwell or maintenance alter delivered passenger service.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 climbing=2401.488 kW；單元 2 得 distance=3819.9 m；單元 3 得 frequency=1.364742 Hz。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 mass 的擾動測試，結果改為 2641.637 kW；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以京釜高速鐵路及韓國高速列車演進為背景，建立不同車輛世代共用走廊的教學時刻表。課程比較牽引、制動、懸吊與受電特性改變後的介面需求，要求以共同量測基準評估車輛更新，而非只比較額定最高速度。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives climbing=2401.488 kW; unit 2 gives distance=3819.9 m; unit 3 gives frequency=1.364742 Hz. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing mass in the first unit changes its result to 2641.637 kW. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Gyeongbu corridor and Korean high-speed train development to construct a teaching timetable shared by different vehicle generations. Compare interface demands after changes in traction, braking, suspension and current collection. Evaluate renewal using common measurement references, rather than only rated top speed, and track whether differences in dwell or maintenance alter delivered passenger service. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率與延遲與制動距離
stages.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power & Delay and braking distance
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」與「延遲與制動距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gradient resistance and climbing power" and "Delay and braking distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」如何影響首爾—釜山高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gradient resistance and climbing power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gyeongbu high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。 坡度以升高量除以水平距離表示，百分比與小數不可混用。此項只表示重力位能增加的速率，總牽引功率還要加上加速、滾動、氣動及轉換損失。 以相同坡度和總質量比較不同牽引方案的需求功率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient. Multiplication by speed gives power, making faster climbing more demanding at equal force; descending requires continuous energy management rather than merely one stopping event. Gradient is rise divided by horizontal distance, so percentage and decimal representations must not be mixed. This term only gives the rate of gravitational potential-energy increase. Total traction demand also includes acceleration, rolling resistance, aerodynamics and conversion losses. Compare required power for alternative traction arrangements at equal gradient and total mass. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gradient resistance and climbing power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gradient resistance and climbing power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率
knowledge.text: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gradient resistance and climbing power" is correct?
options: 長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。
速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
optionsEn: One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
Climbing raises gravitational potential energy.
A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gradient resistance and climbing power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 336600 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2641.637 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 336600 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2641.637 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 336600 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2641.637 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 336600 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2641.637 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gradient resistance and climbing power", which statement holds?
options: 只要靜態接觸線高度正確就能保證高速受流品質
快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s。
optionsEn: Correct static contact-wire height alone guarantees good current collection at high speed.
Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=306000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2401.488 kW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gradient resistance and climbing power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gradient resistance and climbing power"?
options: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
optionsEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
quiz.explanation: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gradient resistance and climbing power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以相同坡度和總質量比較不同牽引方案的需求功率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare required power for alternative traction arrangements at equal gradient and total mass.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gradient resistance and climbing power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。
速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating.
A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「延遲與制動距離」如何影響首爾—釜山高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delay and braking distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gyeongbu high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車在控制命令傳遞與煞車建立期間仍向前行駛，減速段才把動能耗散；因此停車距離包含延遲距離與減速距離。速度平方項說明高速時少量速度誤差會被放大，固定減速度只能作第一輪界限估算。 延遲項與速度成正比，減速項與速度平方成正比；把兩項分開後，才能選擇改善控制延遲或增加有效制動的方案。若存在坡度，應另加沿坡重力，不能只改總距離。 把不同車輛的制動建立時間與穩態減速度分開辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「延遲與制動距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term. The squared speed dependence amplifies speed uncertainty; constant deceleration is only an initial bounding approximation. The delay term is linear in speed and the deceleration term is quadratic. Separating them reveals whether control latency or effective braking deserves attention. A gradient requires an added gravitational component, not an arbitrary adjustment to the final distance. Identify brake build-up time separately from steady deceleration for different vehicles. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delay and braking distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=71.4 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3819.9 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=71.4 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3819.9 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「延遲與制動距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Delay and braking distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 延遲與制動距離

knowledge.textEn: A train continues moving while the command propagates and brake force builds. Only the deceleration phase removes kinetic energy, so stopping distance includes both a delay term and a braking term.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

An unchanged natural frequency proves that the damper has not deteriorated.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲與制動距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delay and braking distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=71.4 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2；計算：distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3819.9 m。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 78.54 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 4602.444 m。模型邊界：水平直線、定減速、無風；沒有建立黏著分布與煞車熱衰退。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=71.4 m/s; delay=2.5 s; a=0.7 m/s^2; calculation: distance=v*delay+v*v/(2*a)=3819.9 m. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 78.54 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4602.444 m. Model boundary: Level straight track and constant deceleration; adhesion variation and thermal fade are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「延遲與制動距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delay and braking distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。 用獨立里程或地速核對輪速積分，報告濕乾軌差異及停車距離的重複試驗範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Identify command delay separately from steady deceleration and cross-check distance by integrating measured speed. Check integrated wheel speed against independent distance or ground speed, and report wet-dry differences and repeated stopping-distance ranges. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別增加延遲與初速，畫出兩條停車曲線；寫出哪個區段對各參數敏感，以及需要哪些現場資料才可建立保護曲線。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase delay and initial speed separately, plot both stopping curves, identify the sensitive phase, and list the field evidence needed before defining a protection curve. Also recalculate distance for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。 用獨立里程或地速核對輪速積分，報告濕乾軌差異及停車距離的重複試驗範圍。

knowledge.textEn: Increase delay and initial speed separately, plot both stopping curves, identify the sensitive phase, and list the field evidence needed before defining a protection curve. Also recalculate distance for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「延遲與制動距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delay and braking distance"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對齊速度、煞車缸壓力與里程的時間戳，分開辨識命令延遲及穩態減速度，再以積分速度的距離交叉檢查。
頻譜中出現一個週期峰就一定證明軸承已損壞

Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps.
One periodic spectral peak necessarily proves that a bearing is damaged.

quiz.explanationEn: Align speed, brake-cylinder pressure and distance timestamps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 延遲與制動距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delay and braking distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「延遲與制動距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Delay and braking distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 應比較壓力建立與地速下降先後，避免誤判煞車故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把不同車輛的制動建立時間與穩態減速度分開辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identify brake build-up time separately from steady deceleration for different vehicles.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度增加一成時制動距離必定也只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ten percent speed increase must increase braking distance by only ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 輪滑保護介入與濕軌會降低實際減速度；感測時間不同步也能製造假延遲，須以第二個時鐘和輪速紀錄區分。 應比較壓力建立與地速下降先後，避免誤判煞車故障。
knowledge.textEn: Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration; unsynchronised sensors can imitate a delay, requiring an independent clock and wheel-speed records. Compare pressure build-up with ground-speed decay before diagnosing a brake fault.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「延遲與制動距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

量到固有頻率不變就能證明阻尼器沒有劣化

An unchanged natural frequency proves that the damper has not deteriorated.
Wheel-slide protection and wet rails can reduce deceleration.

steps.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振：機制與系統路徑
