steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。 以鋼軌接觸式溫度計校驗遙測值，核對應變零點，並保留日夜循環的升降溫路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出自由、部分拘束與完全拘束三種邊界，重算熱變形或應力，標明哪些輸入必須由鋼軌溫度及扣件試驗取得。 再以本單元 deltaT 的對照值重算 compression，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw free, partial and full restraint boundaries, recalculate expansion or stress, and identify inputs requiring rail-temperature measurements and fastener tests. Also recalculate compression for the alternative deltaT value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress"?
options: 量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-rail temperature and restrained stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-rail temperature and restrained stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將鋼軌溫度和維修後拘束狀態作為熱應力的獨立輸入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treat rail temperature and post-maintenance restraint as independent thermal-stress inputs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長軌溫升與受限熱應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-rail temperature and restrained stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tangier–Kenitra high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 把轉乘步行與候車分開，檢查班表銜接對總旅程的效果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Separate transfer walking from waiting and examine timetable coordination over the complete journey. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transfer walking and connection margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=187.2 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=67.8 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=187.2 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=67.8 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transfer walking and connection margin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕
knowledge.text: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。
knowledge.textEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transfer walking and connection margin" is correct?
options: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。
optionsEn: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs.
quiz.explanation: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 49.08 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=187.2 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=67.8 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 49.08 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer walking and connection margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transfer walking and connection margin"?

Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer walking and connection margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把轉乘步行與候車分開，檢查班表銜接對總旅程的效果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate transfer walking from waiting and examine timetable coordination over the complete journey.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transfer walking and connection margin" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route.
quiz.explanation: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求與可用度與修復時間
stages.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size & Availability and repair time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「周轉時間與車隊需求」與「可用度與修復時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Round-trip time and fleet size" and "Availability and repair time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「周轉時間與車隊需求」如何影響摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip time and fleet size” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tangier–Kenitra high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 讓慢速接續段時間進入完整車組循環，避免低估用車數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「周轉時間與車隊需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Include time on the slower connecting section in the complete fleet cycle. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip time and fleet size” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「周轉時間與車隊需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Round-trip time and fleet size”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求
knowledge.text: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。
knowledge.textEn: Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「周轉時間與車隊需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Round-trip time and fleet size" is correct?
options: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定

Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
quiz.explanation: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「周轉時間與車隊需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip time and fleet size” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6177.6 s，其餘固定，結果為 35 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6177.6 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 35 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6177.6 s，其餘固定，結果為 35 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6177.6 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 35 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「周轉時間與車隊需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Round-trip time and fleet size", which statement holds?
options: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s。
量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常
optionsEn: Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
Original hypothetical exercise.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「周轉時間與車隊需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip time and fleet size” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「周轉時間與車隊需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Round-trip time and fleet size"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成
逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「周轉時間與車隊需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Round-trip time and fleet size” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：讓慢速接續段時間進入完整車組循環，避免低估用車數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Include time on the slower connecting section in the complete fleet cycle.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。
knowledge.textEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「周轉時間與車隊需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Round-trip time and fleet size" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
optionsEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
quiz.explanation: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用度與修復時間」如何影響摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tangier–Kenitra high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 比較高速專用段和共同設備的停機事件對全程服務的影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Compare how outages on the dedicated fast section and shared equipment affect end-to-end service. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用度與修復時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Availability and repair time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可用度與修復時間
knowledge.text: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。
knowledge.textEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Availability and repair time" is correct?
options: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。
快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
optionsEn: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time.
Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
quiz.explanation: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用度與修復時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Availability and repair time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1372.8 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970947 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1372.8 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970947 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Availability and repair time"?
options: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長
optionsEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
quiz.explanation: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較高速專用段和共同設備的停機事件對全程服務的影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare how outages on the dedicated fast section and shared equipment affect end-to-end service.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and repair time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。
快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable.
Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 雅萬高速鐵路
summary: 以雅加達至萬隆高速鐵路為背景，建立熱帶丘陵中的橋隧連續路線及接駁旅程。學徒從降雨、坡度和曲線開始，延伸到車站轉乘與需求批次到達，要求把列車行車時間和門到門旅程時間分別驗證。
summaryEn: Use the Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway to construct a tropical hillside route with successive bridges, tunnels and feeder journeys. Begin with rainfall, gradients and curves, then extend the analysis to station interchange and batch arrivals. Verify train running time separately from door-to-door journey time so that fast line-haul service is not mistaken for a complete passenger-experience result.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 deflection=1.103997 mm；單元 2 得 gradient=0.63 mm/m；單元 3 得 flow=0.3213 m^3/s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 L 的擾動測試，結果改為 1.616362 mm；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以雅加達至萬隆高速鐵路為背景，建立熱帶丘陵中的橋隧連續路線及接駁旅程。學徒從降雨、坡度和曲線開始，延伸到車站轉乘與需求批次到達，要求把列車行車時間和門到門旅程時間分別驗證。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives deflection=1.103997 mm; unit 2 gives gradient=0.63 mm/m; unit 3 gives flow=0.3213 m^3/s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing L in the first unit changes its result to 1.616362 mm. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway to construct a tropical hillside route with successive bridges, tunnels and feeder journeys. Begin with rainfall, gradients and curves, then extend the analysis to station interchange and batch arrivals. Verify train running time separately from door-to-door journey time so that fast line-haul service is not mistaken for a complete passenger-experience result. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度與沉陷差與軌道坡折
stages.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity & Differential settlement and track kink
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」與「沉陷差與軌道坡折」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" and "Differential settlement and track kink": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」如何影響雅萬高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 在高架橋量測跨中及支點位移，區分彎曲與基礎移動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Measure viaduct midspan and support displacement to distinguish bending from foundation movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度
knowledge.text: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。
knowledge.textEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bridge deflection and span sensitivity" is correct?
options: 橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge deflection and span sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge deflection and span sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 28.875 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.616362 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.25 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.103997 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.875 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.616362 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷差與軌道坡折」如何影響雅萬高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and track kink” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 追蹤橋台與填土路基之間的差異沉陷長度尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷差與軌道坡折」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Track the length scale of differential settlement between an abutment and filled earthworks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and track kink” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and track kink” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and track kink"?

steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and track kink” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：追蹤橋台與填土路基之間的差異沉陷長度尺度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Track the length scale of differential settlement between an abutment and filled earthworks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。
knowledge.textEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact.

quiz.explanationEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 集水與排水容量與坡度阻力與爬坡功率
stages.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity & Gradient resistance and climbing power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集水與排水容量」與「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity" and "Gradient resistance and climbing power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水與排水容量」如何影響雅萬高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 比較短時強降雨與長時降雨對集水估算的不同假設。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水與排水容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Compare assumptions for short intense rainfall and longer rainfall in catchment estimates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.1e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.3213 m^3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.1e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.3213 m^3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水與排水容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水與排水容量
knowledge.text: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。
knowledge.textEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水與排水容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity" is correct?
options: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
optionsEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
quiz.explanation: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水與排水容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.1e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.3213 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.31e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.35343 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.1e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.3213 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.31e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.35343 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.1e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.3213 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.31e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.35343 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.1e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.3213 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.31e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.35343 m^3/s. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水與排水容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較短時強降雨與長時降雨對集水估算的不同假設。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare assumptions for short intense rainfall and longer rainfall in catchment estimates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

quiz.explanationEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」如何影響雅萬高速鐵路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gradient resistance and climbing power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jakarta–Bandung high-speed railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。 坡度以升高量除以水平距離表示，百分比與小數不可混用。此項只表示重力位能增加的速率，總牽引功率還要加上加速、滾動、氣動及轉換損失。 把山區坡度帶來的持續功率與加速功率分別列出。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient. Multiplication by speed gives power, making faster climbing more demanding at equal force; descending requires continuous energy management rather than merely one stopping event. Gradient is rise divided by horizontal distance, so percentage and decimal representations must not be mixed. This term only gives the rate of gravitational potential-energy increase. Total traction demand also includes acceleration, rolling resistance, aerodynamics and conversion losses. List sustained gradient power separately from acceleration power on a hillside section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gradient resistance and climbing power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=315000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2472.12 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=315000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2472.12 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gradient resistance and climbing power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率
knowledge.text: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
