steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「周轉時間與車隊需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip time and fleet size” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。
knowledge.textEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「周轉時間與車隊需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Round-trip time and fleet size"?
options: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
隧道壓力波必定與列車以相同速度到達出口
optionsEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A tunnel pressure wave necessarily reaches the portal at the same speed as the train.
quiz.explanation: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「周轉時間與車隊需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Round-trip time and fleet size” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把接駁與高速列車班距分開排程，檢查整體銜接需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Schedule feeder and high-speed headways separately and inspect connection requirements.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。
knowledge.textEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「周轉時間與車隊需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Round-trip time and fleet size" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 倫敦伊莉莎白線
summary: 以倫敦伊莉莎白線連接既有鐵路與新建中央隧道的情境為背景，建立多運轉區段的教學案例。課程把定位、通訊、車門及轉乘人流串成事件鏈，要求先證明每個邊界的允許狀態，再討論端到端班距與乘客便利。
summaryEn: Use the Elizabeth line’s connection of existing railways through a new central tunnel as the setting for a multi-section teaching case. Link localisation, communication, doors and interchange flows in an event chain. Establish permissible states at each boundary before discussing end-to-end headway or passenger convenience, and explicitly distinguish test readiness from the commencement of revenue service.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 sigma=1.808863 m；單元 2 得 stale_distance=7.95 m；單元 3 得 transition=366.1538 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 s1 的擾動測試，結果改為 1.838127 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以倫敦伊莉莎白線連接既有鐵路與新建中央隧道的情境為背景，建立多運轉區段的教學案例。課程把定位、通訊、車門及轉乘人流串成事件鏈，要求先證明每個邊界的允許狀態，再討論端到端班距與乘客便利。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives sigma=1.808863 m; unit 2 gives stale_distance=7.95 m; unit 3 gives transition=366.1538 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing s1 in the first unit changes its result to 1.838127 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Elizabeth line’s connection of existing railways through a new central tunnel as the setting for a multi-section teaching case. Link localisation, communication, doors and interchange flows in an event chain. Establish permissible states at each boundary before discussing end-to-end headway or passenger convenience, and explicitly distinguish test readiness from the commencement of revenue service. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.

stages.title: 里程融合與不確定度與通訊延遲與位置陳舊量
stages.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty & Communication delay and stale position
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「里程融合與不確定度」與「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Position fusion and uncertainty" and "Communication delay and stale position": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「里程融合與不確定度」如何影響倫敦伊莉莎白線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position fusion and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “London Elizabeth line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 在中央隧道與地面接續處追蹤位置誤差包絡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「里程融合與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Track the position-error envelope at the connection between central tunnel and surface sections. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position fusion and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.24 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.808863 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.24 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.808863 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「里程融合與不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Position fusion and uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error.

knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「里程融合與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position fusion and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.24 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.808863 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.664 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.838127 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.24 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.808863 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.664 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.838127 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「里程融合與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Position fusion and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Position fusion and uncertainty"?

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「里程融合與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Position fusion and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在中央隧道與地面接續處追蹤位置誤差包絡。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。

steps.instruction: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 對每次運轉模式轉換記錄封包年齡與授權狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Record packet age and authority state for every operating-mode transition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Communication delay and stale position” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Communication delay and stale position” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.318 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.95 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3498 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.745 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.318 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.95 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3498 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.745 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Communication delay and stale position” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Communication delay and stale position” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對每次運轉模式轉換記錄封包年齡與授權狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Record packet age and authority state for every operating-mode transition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離與停準誤差與月台門對位
stages.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance & Stopping error and platform-door alignment
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「速度限制轉換與預告距離」與「停準誤差與月台門對位」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Speed-limit transition and warning distance" and "Stopping error and platform-door alignment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速度限制轉換與預告距離」如何影響倫敦伊莉莎白線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “London Elizabeth line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 用相同距離基準檢查目標速度和保護曲線的關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度限制轉換與預告距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=24 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=366.1538 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 26.4 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 459.2 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。 停車、測量與門位置三個獨立零均值誤差以變異數相加，再取平方根得到合成標準差。這不是最大偏移保證，也不含共同系統偏差；機械淨空及容許對位範圍須另外核對。 分開停準、車門位置與測量誤差，核對平台對位的合成標準差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準誤差與月台門對位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately. Geometric alignment does not replace obstruction detection or the door-closure interlock. Three independent zero-mean errors in stopping, surveying and door position combine through summed variances. The square root gives a standard deviation, not a guaranteed maximum offset. Shared bias is excluded, and mechanical clearance and permitted alignment ranges require separate checks. Separate stopping, door-position and survey errors when checking combined alignment standard deviation. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0848 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08840837 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.09328 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09657204 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0848 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08840837 m. Sensitivity: stop_sigma, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.09328 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.09657204 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean errors; not a maximum bound and no acceptance tolerance is specified. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準誤差與月台門對位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。 以獨立基準重複量測停準與門位，檢查各誤差平均值、相關性和單位，再核對合成分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build separate random-error and fixed-bias budgets, plot stopping distributions at different loads, and list distinct evidence for alignment and interlocking. Also recalculate combined_sigma for the alternative stop_sigma value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響倫敦伊莉莎白線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “London Elizabeth line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 檢查長月台上旅客分布不均如何影響最慢門組。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Inspect how uneven distribution along a long platform affects the slowest door group. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Door exchange and dwell time" is correct?
options: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。
optionsEn: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門交換與停站時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door exchange and dwell time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=254 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.22917 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 280至 280 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.58333 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=254 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.22917 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 280, to 280 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.58333 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 280, to 280 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.58333 s. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車門交換與停站時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Door exchange and dwell time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Door exchange and dwell time"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.

quiz.explanationEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門交換與停站時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Door exchange and dwell time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查長月台上旅客分布不均如何影響最慢門組。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inspect how uneven distribution along a long platform affects the slowest door group.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車門交換與停站時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Door exchange and dwell time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail.

quiz.explanationEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」如何影響倫敦伊莉莎白線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform storage and queue conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “London Elizabeth line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 以轉乘批次到達比較平均密度與局部通道壅塞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台暫存與隊列守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Compare mean density with local passage congestion under interchange batch arrivals. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform storage and queue conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=445 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.271429 persons/m^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=445 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.271429 persons/m^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=445 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.271429 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 490至 490 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.4 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=445 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.271429 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 490, to 490 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.4 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台暫存與隊列守恆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform storage and queue conservation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Platform storage and queue conservation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以轉乘批次到達比較平均密度與局部通道壅塞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare mean density with local passage congestion under interchange batch arrivals.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台暫存與隊列守恆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.

stages.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間與轉乘步行與銜接餘裕
stages.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time & Transfer walking and connection margin
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」與「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tunnel air exchange and dilution time" and "Transfer walking and connection margin": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」如何影響倫敦伊莉莎白線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “London Elizabeth line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 分開隧道活塞風和車站一般換氣的量測邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Separate measurement boundaries for tunnel piston airflow and normal station ventilation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=26.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=260.67 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=26.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=260.67 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間
knowledge.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
knowledge.text: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。
knowledge.textEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tunnel air exchange and dilution time" is correct?
options: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
optionsEn: A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=26.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=260.67 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 29.15 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 236.9727 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=26.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=260.67 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 29.15 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 236.9727 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.instruction: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響倫敦伊莉莎白線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “London Elizabeth line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 把電扶梯與深層步行連通道分開計算轉乘時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Calculate transfer time separately for escalators and deep-level walking connections. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transfer walking and connection margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer walking and connection margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer walking and connection margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證與可用度與修復時間
stages.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification & Availability and repair time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「互斥進路與真值驗證」與「可用度與修復時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" and "Availability and repair time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響倫敦伊莉莎白線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “London Elizabeth line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 在接續區段以進路狀態表確認衝突移動不能同時授權。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Use a route-state table to confirm conflicting movements cannot receive simultaneous authority. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=8 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=256 states。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=8 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=256 states.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「互斥進路與真值驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互斥進路與真值驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=8 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=256 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 9 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 512 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=8 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=256 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 9 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 512 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「互斥進路與真值驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在接續區段以進路狀態表確認衝突移動不能同時授權。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Use a route-state table to confirm conflicting movements cannot receive simultaneous authority.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
