quiz.explanationEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用度與修復時間」如何影響倫敦伊莉莎白線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “London Elizabeth line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 區分中央區段設備可用性與整條跨城服務的可用性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Distinguish central-section equipment availability from availability of the complete cross-city service. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1272 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968652 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1272 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968652 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用度與修復時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Availability and repair time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可用度與修復時間
knowledge.text: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。
knowledge.textEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Availability and repair time" is correct?
options: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。
兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差
optionsEn: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
quiz.explanation: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用度與修復時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Availability and repair time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1272 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968652 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1399.2 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971494 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1272 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968652 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1399.2 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971494 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1272 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968652 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1399.2 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9971494 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1272 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968652 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1399.2 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9971494 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Availability and repair time"?
options: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
optionsEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：區分中央區段設備可用性與整條跨城服務的可用性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish central-section equipment availability from availability of the complete cross-city service.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and repair time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。
兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 巴黎 RER A 線
summary: 以巴黎 RER A 的都會區域運輸背景，建立分支線列車進入共同核心段的教學模型。學徒比較列車合流、月台交換與下游延誤恢復，並以逐列隊列檢查高頻服務中平均班距容易掩蓋的局部擁擠。
summaryEn: Use Paris RER A as a metropolitan regional-rail setting for a teaching model in which branch trains enter a common core. Compare merging, platform exchange and downstream recovery. Track queues train by train to expose local crowding hidden by average headway, and separate a higher scheduled frequency from the ability of the busiest doors to complete passenger exchange.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 catch_time=1200 s；單元 2 得 capacity=18000 persons/hour；單元 3 得 dwell=24.5 s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 gap 的擾動測試，結果改為 1320 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以巴黎 RER A 的都會區域運輸背景，建立分支線列車進入共同核心段的教學模型。學徒比較列車合流、月台交換與下游延誤恢復，並以逐列隊列檢查高頻服務中平均班距容易掩蓋的局部擁擠。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives catch_time=1200 s; unit 2 gives capacity=18000 persons/hour; unit 3 gives dwell=24.5 s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing gap in the first unit changes its result to 1320 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Paris RER A as a metropolitan regional-rail setting for a teaching model in which branch trains enter a common core. Compare merging, platform exchange and downstream recovery. Track queues train by train to expose local crowding hidden by average headway, and separate a higher scheduled frequency from the ability of the busiest doors to complete passenger exchange. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 快慢車追及與待避與班距與有效運能
stages.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up & Headway and usable capacity
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「快慢車追及與待避」與「班距與有效運能」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fast-slow train catch-up" and "Headway and usable capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快慢車追及與待避」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast-slow train catch-up” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 讓兩條分支的列車到達時間競爭同一核心段進路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快慢車追及與待避」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration. The meeting point is not a permitted safe separation between trains. Catch-up time depends on starting separation and relative speed, not only the faster train’s speed. If either train stops or encounters signalling constraints, use piecewise speed functions and restore route occupation to the event diagram. Make arrival times from two branches compete for the same core-section route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fast-slow train catch-up” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1200 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1200 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快慢車追及與待避」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fast-slow train catch-up”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 快慢車追及與待避
knowledge.text: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。
knowledge.textEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「快慢車追及與待避」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fast-slow train catch-up" is correct?
options: 快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。
只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
optionsEn: Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed.
Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快慢車追及與待避」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast-slow train catch-up” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1200 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13200 m，其餘固定，結果為 1320 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1200 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13200 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1320 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1200 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13200 m，其餘固定，結果為 1320 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1200 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13200 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1320 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「快慢車追及與待避」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fast-slow train catch-up", which statement holds?
options: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s。
optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1200 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12000 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1200 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「快慢車追及與待避」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fast-slow train catch-up” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 以逐站到發時刻重建距離時間圖，核對起始間隔和各段速度，並標示待避占用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Rebuild a distance-time diagram from station arrivals and departures, verifying initial separation and segment speeds and marking passing occupation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加慢車停站與快車出發延後各一個情境，畫出時空圖，討論待避線能解決的衝突與仍存在的交叉進路限制。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 catch_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a slow-train stop and a delayed fast departure as separate cases, draw time-distance diagrams, and distinguish conflicts solved by a loop from remaining crossing-route restrictions. Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「快慢車追及與待避」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fast-slow train catch-up"?
options: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快慢車追及與待避」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fast-slow train catch-up” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：讓兩條分支的列車到達時間競爭同一核心段進路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Make arrival times from two branches compete for the same core-section route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。
knowledge.textEn: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「快慢車追及與待避」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fast-slow train catch-up" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。
只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train.
Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「班距與有效運能」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Headway and usable capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 以核心段逐列負載驗算運能，保留無法登車的隊列。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「班距與有效運能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Check core capacity train by train and retain the queue unable to board. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Headway and usable capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=18000 persons/hour。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=18000 persons/hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「班距與有效運能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Headway and usable capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 班距與有效運能
knowledge.text: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。
knowledge.textEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Headway and usable capacity" is correct?
options: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。
optionsEn: Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency.
quiz.explanation: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「班距與有效運能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Headway and usable capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=18000 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 198 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16363.64 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=18000 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 198 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16363.64 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=18000 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 198 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16363.64 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=18000 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 198 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16363.64 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「班距與有效運能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Headway and usable capacity", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train。
平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊
換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time.
Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=18000 persons/hour。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=180 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=18000 persons/hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距與有效運能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway and usable capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「班距與有效運能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Headway and usable capacity"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 班距與有效運能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway and usable capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距與有效運能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway and usable capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以核心段逐列負載驗算運能，保留無法登車的隊列。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check core capacity train by train and retain the queue unable to board.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。
knowledge.textEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「班距與有效運能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Headway and usable capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail.
quiz.explanation: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 車門交換與停站時間與月台暫存與隊列守恆
stages.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time & Platform storage and queue conservation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車門交換與停站時間」與「月台暫存與隊列守恆」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Door exchange and dwell time" and "Platform storage and queue conservation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 把轉乘樓梯附近門組與其他門組分開記錄交換時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Record exchange time separately for doors beside interchange stairs and other doors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車門交換與停站時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Door exchange and dwell time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車門交換與停站時間
knowledge.text: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。
knowledge.textEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Door exchange and dwell time" is correct?
options: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
optionsEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門交換與停站時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door exchange and dwell time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.5 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 264至 264 persons，其餘固定，結果為 25.75 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.5 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 264, to 264 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 25.75 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.5 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 264至 264 persons，其餘固定，結果為 25.75 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.5 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 264, to 264 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 25.75 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「車門交換與停站時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Door exchange and dwell time", which statement holds?
options: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s。
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
optionsEn: Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
Original hypothetical exercise.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.5 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=240 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.5 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車門交換與停站時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Door exchange and dwell time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。
knowledge.textEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Door exchange and dwell time"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門交換與停站時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Door exchange and dwell time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把轉乘樓梯附近門組與其他門組分開記錄交換時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Record exchange time separately for doors beside interchange stairs and other doors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform storage and queue conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 將月台等候面積扣除通行與設備占用，辨認有效區域。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台暫存與隊列守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Subtract circulation and equipment occupation from waiting area to identify usable platform space. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform storage and queue conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Platform storage and queue conservation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊
optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits.
Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time.
quiz.explanation: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform storage and queue conservation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 463至 463 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.322857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 463, to 463 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.322857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 463至 463 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.322857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。

Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 463, to 463 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.322857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台暫存與隊列守恆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform storage and queue conservation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
