steps.observation: 連結機制：將月台等候面積扣除通行與設備占用，辨認有效區域。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Subtract circulation and equipment occupation from waiting area to identify usable platform space.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。
knowledge.textEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台暫存與隊列守恆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Platform storage and queue conservation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。
平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing.
Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time.
quiz.explanation: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕與互斥進路與真值驗證
stages.titleEn: Merging flow and bottleneck margin & Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」與「互斥進路與真值驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Merging flow and bottleneck margin" and "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Merging flow and bottleneck margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Merging flow and bottleneck margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩支線人流或列車流匯入同一通道時，總需求需與下游服務率比較。差值為正只代表平均有餘裕，突發到達仍會形成隊列；服務率降低時積壓以需求和服務的差累積。 容量減去兩支流給出平均服務餘裕，負值表示隊列會累積而非負人數。此代數式不描述人群密度與速度的關係；要算實際隊列長度，必須把淨流量隨時間積分。 把兩個轉乘入口流量與共同出口容量比較，追蹤隊列守恆。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When two passenger or train streams merge, their combined demand must be compared with downstream service. Positive average margin does not prevent queues after bursts. If service falls below demand, backlog accumulates at the difference between their rates. Capacity minus two incoming streams gives mean service margin; a negative value indicates accumulating queues, not negative people. This algebra does not describe the density-speed relationship. Physical queue length requires integrating net flow over time. Compare two interchange inflows with shared exit capacity and track queue conservation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Merging flow and bottleneck margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min；計算：margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=20 persons/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min; calculation: margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=20 persons/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Merging flow and bottleneck margin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕
knowledge.text: 兩支線人流或列車流匯入同一通道時，總需求需與下游服務率比較。差值為正只代表平均有餘裕，突發到達仍會形成隊列；服務率降低時積壓以需求和服務的差累積。
knowledge.textEn: When two passenger or train streams merge, their combined demand must be compared with downstream service. Positive average margin does not prevent queues after bursts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Merging flow and bottleneck margin" is correct?
options: 平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
兩支線人流或列車流匯入同一通道時，總需求需與下游服務率比較。
optionsEn: Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
When two passenger or train streams merge, their combined demand must be compared with downstream service.
quiz.explanation: 兩支線人流或列車流匯入同一通道時，總需求需與下游服務率比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When two passenger or train streams merge, their combined demand must be compared with downstream service. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Merging flow and bottleneck margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Merging flow and bottleneck margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min；計算：margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=20 persons/min。敏感度：flow1 單獨增加百分之十至 49.5 persons/min，其餘固定，結果為 15.5 persons/min。模型邊界：定常平均流量；不包含隨機到達、優先權和實體隊列長度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min; calculation: margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=20 persons/min. Sensitivity: flow1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 49.5 persons/min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.5 persons/min. Model boundary: Steady mean flows; random arrivals, priority rules and physical queue length are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄兩個入口和下游出口，將資料用相同時間窗聚合，檢查需求尖峰是否被過大的平均窗隱藏。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record both inlets and the downstream outlet synchronously, aggregate with equal windows, and check whether long averaging periods hide demand peaks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min；計算：margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=20 persons/min。敏感度：flow1 單獨增加百分之十至 49.5 persons/min，其餘固定，結果為 15.5 persons/min。模型邊界：定常平均流量；不包含隨機到達、優先權和實體隊列長度。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min; calculation: margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=20 persons/min. Sensitivity: flow1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 49.5 persons/min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.5 persons/min. Model boundary: Steady mean flows; random arrivals, priority rules and physical queue length are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Merging flow and bottleneck margin", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min。
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min；計算：margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=20 persons/min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min; calculation: margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=20 persons/min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Merging flow and bottleneck margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Merging flow and bottleneck margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄兩個入口和下游出口，將資料用相同時間窗聚合，檢查需求尖峰是否被過大的平均窗隱藏。 同步量測兩入口與出口流量，採相同時間窗並以人數守恆核對區域內隊列的增減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record both inlets and the downstream outlet synchronously, aggregate with equal windows, and check whether long averaging periods hide demand peaks. Measure both inlet flows and outlet flow synchronously, use identical time windows, and check queue changes through conservation of people. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持平均需求相同但把一支線改成脈衝到達，逐分鐘更新隊列，提出分流或節流措施並檢查其上游影響。 再以本單元 flow1 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep mean demand fixed while making one branch arrive in pulses, update the queue minute by minute, and assess upstream consequences of rerouting or metering. Also recalculate margin for the alternative flow1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一支線延誤後集中釋放會造成瞬時過載，即使全天平均需求較小；下游出口短暫阻塞則可能向上游回堵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed branch can release a concentrated surge despite modest daily demand; a brief downstream blockage can spill a queue back upstream. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時記錄兩個入口和下游出口，將資料用相同時間窗聚合，檢查需求尖峰是否被過大的平均窗隱藏。 同步量測兩入口與出口流量，採相同時間窗並以人數守恆核對區域內隊列的增減。
knowledge.textEn: Record both inlets and the downstream outlet synchronously, aggregate with equal windows, and check whether long averaging periods hide demand peaks. Measure both inlet flows and outlet flow synchronously, use identical time windows, and check queue changes through conservation of people.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持平均需求相同但把一支線改成脈衝到達，逐分鐘更新隊列，提出分流或節流措施並檢查其上游影響。 再以本單元 flow1 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Keep mean demand fixed while making one branch arrive in pulses, update the queue minute by minute, and assess upstream consequences of rerouting or metering. Also recalculate margin for the alternative flow1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Merging flow and bottleneck margin"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
同時記錄兩個入口和下游出口，將資料用相同時間窗聚合，檢查需求尖峰是否被過大的平均窗隱藏。
只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Record both inlets and the downstream outlet synchronously, aggregate with equal windows, and check whether long averaging periods hide demand peaks.
Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 同時記錄兩個入口和下游出口，將資料用相同時間窗聚合，檢查需求尖峰是否被過大的平均窗隱藏。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record both inlets and the downstream outlet synchronously, aggregate with equal windows, and check whether long averaging periods hide demand peaks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Merging flow and bottleneck margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Merging flow and bottleneck margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一支線延誤後集中釋放會造成瞬時過載，即使全天平均需求較小；下游出口短暫阻塞則可能向上游回堵。 平均餘裕為正仍可能短時超載，須核對脈衝到達。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A delayed branch can release a concentrated surge despite modest daily demand; a brief downstream blockage can spill a queue back upstream. Positive mean margin can coexist with short overloads; inspect pulsed arrivals. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把兩個轉乘入口流量與共同出口容量比較，追蹤隊列守恆。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare two interchange inflows with shared exit capacity and track queue conservation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 一支線延誤後集中釋放會造成瞬時過載，即使全天平均需求較小；下游出口短暫阻塞則可能向上游回堵。 平均餘裕為正仍可能短時超載，須核對脈衝到達。
knowledge.textEn: A delayed branch can release a concentrated surge despite modest daily demand; a brief downstream blockage can spill a queue back upstream. Positive mean margin can coexist with short overloads; inspect pulsed arrivals.

quiz.question: 在「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Merging flow and bottleneck margin" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 為分支合流建立互斥進路，注入一班晚到列車。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Build mutually exclusive routes at a branch merge and inject one late train. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「互斥進路與真值驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互斥進路與真值驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 7 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 128 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 7 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 128 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 7 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 128 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。

Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.

knowledge.text: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification"?

quiz.explanationEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「互斥進路與真值驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：為分支合流建立互斥進路，注入一班晚到列車。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Build mutually exclusive routes at a branch merge and inject one late train.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。

optionsEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.

quiz.explanationEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 折返作業與路徑占用與再生煞車能量與受電條件

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「折返作業與路徑占用」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Turnback and route occupation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。 只要有兩條路徑共享道岔或保護區，表面上分開的月台仍可能互相限制。時序模型應包含占用開始、列車清空和進路釋放三個不同時間，而非一個站停數字。 檢查短線折返列車是否占用核心區段的必要進路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「折返作業與路徑占用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks. A simple sum represents one declared serial path, rather than a universal minimum headway for every terminal layout. Platforms that appear separate can still constrain each other through shared points or protection zones. A sequence model needs distinct times for occupation, physical clearance and route release rather than representing all three by one station dwell value. Check whether a short-turn service occupies routes needed by the core service. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Turnback and route occupation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「折返作業與路徑占用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Turnback and route occupation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 折返作業與路徑占用

knowledge.textEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「折返作業與路徑占用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
quiz.explanation: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折返作業與路徑占用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Turnback and route occupation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 82.5 s，其餘固定，結果為 142.5 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 82.5 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 142.5 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 82.5 s，其餘固定，結果為 142.5 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。

Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 82.5 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 142.5 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「折返作業與路徑占用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Turnback and route occupation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Cross-check occupation indication against actual rear-end clearance and list whether each task can overlap and which preceding events it requires. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出單月台與雙月台折返的甘特圖，標註不可同時使用的路徑，並以一班晚到列車檢查延誤是否傳到下一班。 再以本單元 reverse 的對照值重算 cycle，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw single-platform and dual-platform turnback timelines, mark mutually exclusive routes, and introduce one late train to test propagation into the next departure. Also recalculate cycle for the alternative reverse value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。
knowledge.textEn: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Cross-check occupation indication against actual rear-end clearance and list whether each task can overlap and which preceding events it requires.

knowledge.text: 畫出單月台與雙月台折返的甘特圖，標註不可同時使用的路徑，並以一班晚到列車檢查延誤是否傳到下一班。 再以本單元 reverse 的對照值重算 cycle，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Draw single-platform and dual-platform turnback timelines, mark mutually exclusive routes, and introduce one late train to test propagation into the next departure. Also recalculate cycle for the alternative reverse value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「折返作業與路徑占用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Turnback and route occupation"?
options: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence.

Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.

quiz.explanationEn: Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 折返作業與路徑占用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Turnback and route occupation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「折返作業與路徑占用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Turnback and route occupation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Cab-change completion cannot substitute for route-release evidence while the train rear remains uncleared. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查短線折返列車是否占用核心區段的必要進路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check whether a short-turn service occupies routes needed by the core service.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。
knowledge.textEn: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Cab-change completion cannot substitute for route-release evidence while the train rear remains uncleared.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「折返作業與路徑占用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Turnback and route occupation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「再生煞車能量與受電條件」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Regenerative energy and receptivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 比較核心段密集煞車與相鄰列車加速的時間重疊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「再生煞車能量與受電條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Compare frequent core-section braking with the acceleration timing of neighbouring trains. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Regenerative energy and receptivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=240000 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.54167 kWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=240000 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.54167 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件
knowledge.text: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。
knowledge.textEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「再生煞車能量與受電條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。
optionsEn: Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery.
quiz.explanation: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Regenerative energy and receptivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=240000 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.54167 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 264000 kg，其餘固定，結果為 14.89583 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=240000 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.54167 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 264000 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.89583 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「再生煞車能量與受電條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Regenerative energy and receptivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice.

knowledge.text: 比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「再生煞車能量與受電條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Regenerative energy and receptivity"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。
平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊

steps.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Regenerative energy and receptivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「再生煞車能量與受電條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Regenerative energy and receptivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較核心段密集煞車與相鄰列車加速的時間重疊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare frequent core-section braking with the acceleration timing of neighbouring trains.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕與周轉時間與車隊需求

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transfer walking and connection margin" and "Round-trip time and fleet size": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 分開同月台換車與垂直轉乘，避免使用單一平均時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Separate cross-platform changes from vertical transfers instead of one mean time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transfer walking and connection margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=180 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=75 s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transfer walking and connection margin" is correct?
options: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
optionsEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
quiz.explanation: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer walking and connection margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=180 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=75 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 198 m，其餘固定，結果為 57 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=180 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=75 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 198 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 57 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 198 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 57 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer walking and connection margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.

knowledge.text: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transfer walking and connection margin"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求

Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer walking and connection margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分開同月台換車與垂直轉乘，避免使用單一平均時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate cross-platform changes from vertical transfers instead of one mean time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「周轉時間與車隊需求」如何影響巴黎 RER A 線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip time and fleet size” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Paris RER Line A”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 將不同分支往返時間分別納入循環車組估算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「周轉時間與車隊需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Include different branch round-trip durations separately in circulating fleet estimates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip time and fleet size” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5400 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=30 trains。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5400 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=30 trains.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「周轉時間與車隊需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
